s01-v01.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v01.question: Must love wait for method?
premises: Neither the non-meditator nor the non-mutterer is barred: it may dawn for him, with no rule first.
Just so — to Śiva's light, to the love-possessor — we bow.
s01-v01.inference: Rule-free dawn saluted: love needs no prior method.

s01-v02.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v02.question: How does the self stay young?
premises: My self stays young, drinking Thy love-nectar.
Greyed only as if with road-dust — dust that is passion (rāga).
s01-v02.inference: Love-nectar keeps the self young; world-dust merely greys it.
uncertainties: rāga double sense (passion/dust-redness) kept double.

s01-v03.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v03.question: What of lovers' world-walking?
premises: For wealth-winners homed in Thy city — lovers —
even market-road walking is that same unfolding.
s01-v03.inference: The city-dweller's errands unfold as devotion.

s01-v04.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v04.question: Where is the lover's ground?
premises: Where world-in-world stands face to face with Thee —
nothing is not ground; no prayer fails.

s01-v05.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v05.question: Who wins?
premises: The drunk on love-nectar-wine win.
Second to none, yet never without Thee beside — dvitīyāḥ double.
s01-v05.inference: Love-drunkards win: matchless, yet never Thee-less.
uncertainties: dvitīyāḥ holds predicative (second to none) and possessive (having-You-second); L3 keeps both.

s01-v06.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v06.question: Who knows the bliss-sea Lord?
premises: Only the flooded know: thick-drenched in love-bliss-nectar.

s01-v07.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v07.question: What grounds love?
premises: Thou alone, self's Lord, art all beings' nature; all love within the self.
So love stands self-grounded (svabhāvasiddhā).
Knowing this by drowning (samāveśayuktyā) — let him conquer.
s01-v07.inference: Proof: self-nature loves self-nature; immersion-knowing conquers.
uncertainties: samāveśayuktyā via Kṣemarāja (by immersion's means); union-means reading equivalent — settled.

s01-v08.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v08.question: Where is He seen?
premises: Known destroyed — who would not see Thee standing all alone?
Even in known-knower churn, lovers find Thee easy (sudarśana).
s01-v08.inference: Past the known, He stands obvious; lovers find Him easy.

s01-v09.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v09.question: What love is asked?
premises: As the Goddess, bliss-lake, dearest, stands unparted from Thee —
so may one love of mine stand — unparted.
s01-v09.inference: Unparted Goddess-love asked as the model.

s01-v10.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v10.question: What causes Him?
premises: For lovers, everything causes gaining Thee.
The knowing-road stands threefold: joy, sorrow, bewilderment.
s01-v10.inference: All roads lead in: joy, sorrow, bewilderment alike.

s01-v11.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v11.question: What of bare knowing?
premises: From tasting love-nectar, Master —
even knowing's highest state turns unwine-sour (nāsava) in my mouth.
s01-v11.inference: Against love's taste, peak knowing sours to vinegar.
uncertainties: nāsava as un-wine (anti-wine answering v05's wine); vinegar-sense kept.

s01-v12.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v12.question: Who knows the real?
premises: Those whose love-lore came as practice —
they alone know: knowing, unknowing, both.
s01-v12.inference: Practice-lovers alone know both knowing and unknowing.

s01-v13.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v13.question: What of this speech?
premises: Speech-creeper from root, opening in order —
love-nectar-sprinkled — may its fruit sap-swell for me.

s01-v14.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v14.question: What of becoming and sacrifice?
premises: 'Be Śiva, then sacrifice'; 'become, the lover' — so declared.
Thou alone art the body's pith, by lovers assayed in oneness.
s01-v14.inference: Becoming precedes rite; Thy body-pith assayed in oneness.
uncertainties: Lakshmanjoo witness: activity-embrace, not shunning — yaj kept as sacrifice.

s01-v15.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v15.question: What proves, what veils?
premises: For lovers, what is not proof toward oneness?
For the lowest, what but veils — heaped toward failure.
s01-v15.inference: All proves for lovers; veils heap for the lowest.

s01-v16.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v16.question: Is He gotten by yoga's where-when?
premises: 'Sometime, somewhere, by yoga got' — Lord, that's the cheat (vañcanā).
Else how blaze here in every state for lovers?
s01-v16.inference: Localization refused: He blazes in every state.

s01-v17.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v17.question: What sets lovers past yogins?
premises: Untouched by breath-withdrawal and the rest — the great difference.
Love's portion-takers stay gathered even waking — past yogins.
s01-v17.inference: Waking gatheredness: devotion's edge over yoga.

s01-v18.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v18.question: What is prescribed?
premises: No yoga bidden, no self-burning, no rite-rule prescribed.
On the straight Śiva-road, love alone is praised.

s01-v19.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v19.question: What perishes?
premises: Cover fire-shattered all round by love's light-play —
I facing all things bare — may even thoughts perish.
s01-v19.inference: Cover burned, thoughts prayed to perish.

s01-v20.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v20.question: What of the Name?
premises: One word Śiva camped on tongue-tip always — every sense-thing tasted.
In lovers only — whatever that is — ah!
s01-v20.inference: The Name camped on tongue tastes all senses — lovers-only wonder.

s01-v21.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v21.question: Who counts?
premises: In the calm-waved love-nectar sea — tasting otherworld sap, steady —
who is counted a nobody (anāma)?
uncertainties: anāma (no-name) as status-inversion; of-no-account reading kept.

option_choices.reason: L2 keeps the mystic register (the diver, not the dropout); the social reading survives as the live alternative — crux left open per C1 boundary, do not freeze.

s01-v22.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v22.question: Why not chew?
premises: Why would the likes of us not chew love's great herb?
Whose next taste is called freedom.

s01-v23.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v23.question: What counts as wealth?
premises: Those alone count wealth, by the good's measure —
whatever fattens trusted feasting on love's sap.

s01-v24.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v24.question: Who stays unsmeared?
premises: Some love-nectar-pith caught — fallen in passion-mud and all —
come up unsmeared.

s01-v25.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v25.question: What of powers?
premises: Powers to freedom — fruit a limb-name on love's ripe creeper.
In some (keṣu cit).
s01-v25.inference: Powers reframed as limbs; fruition for some.

s01-v26.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s01-v26.question: What of the mind?
premises: Strange: mind pain-seed by nature (duḥkhabīja) —
love-sap-sprinkled, ripens to freedom's great fruit.
uncertainties: duḥkhabīja botany kept (seed, not stain).

s02-v01.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v01.question: What stuff is He?
premises: Fire, moon, sun, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, still, moving — His very stuff.
To the many-shaped, to knowing-shaped Thee — bow.
s02-v01.inference: All stuff is His stuff; the many-shaped is knowing-shaped.

s02-v02.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v02.question: What burns?
premises: Great fire, universe for fuel, bright with pure ash-smeared.
To Thee, the Becoming, whose one offering is the world — bow.
s02-v02.inference: The world fuels His fire; His fire's oblation is the world.

s02-v03.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v03.question: What cools?
premises: Śiva-fire cool, thick with highest nectar.
To some Unequalled, all-devouring when the world burns — homage.
s02-v03.inference: Cool nectar-fire and world-burning Unequalled: both addressed.

s02-v04.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v04.question: By what names?
premises: Mahādeva, Rudra, Śaṅkara, Śiva — Great-Lord Thee — bow.
And to some mantra-bodied one — bow.
s02-v04.inference: Name-catalogue bowed; mantra-bodied kept indefinite (kasmai cid).

s02-v05.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v05.question: What unction?
premises: Śiva-fire: cut, sucked dry, three worlds' melted fat His unction.
Unequalled yet kind.
s02-v05.inference: Dread fuel, kind flame: the offering is the burnt world.

s02-v06.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v06.question: What marks Him?
premises: Whose mark is this alone — that no marks meet.
To God, to gracious some Śambhu — homage.
s02-v06.inference: Marklessness marked: His sign is no-sign.

s02-v07.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v07.question: What of Veda and Āgama?
premises: Against Veda and Āgama, maker of Veda and Āgama, their true essence.
To the hidden Master — bow.
s02-v07.inference: Veda-foe and Veda-maker at once; hidden mastery bowed.

s02-v08.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v08.question: What of the round?
premises: Sole maker of the world-round, sole unmaker.
Round-shaped, round-free — gracious Śambhu, bow.
s02-v08.inference: Cause and foe of saṃsāra in one breath.

s02-v09.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v09.question: What of root, middle, tip?
premises: Root, middle, tip; shaped as all three; tip-middle-root outworn.
To the Full, gracious Śambhu — bow.
s02-v09.inference: Triad stated and outworn; Fullness bowed.

s02-v10.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v10.question: What of the Name?
premises: Bow: Name-taking even once IS merit-heaps ripened.
To hard-to-win Śiva Thee.
s02-v10.inference: One utterance ripens merit-heaps; difficulty bowed with ease.

s02-v11.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v11.question: What play?
premises: Amid heaped moving-unmoving crowds, ever playing for Thee, the One.
Knowing-shaped, skull-wearing.
s02-v11.inference: Crowd-play for the One; skull-wearing knowing bowed.

s02-v12.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v12.question: What contrarieties?
premises: Trickster, pure; hidden, self-shown; fine, all-shaped — bow.
To wonder-variegated Śambhu.
uncertainties: citra holds wonder and variegated at once; kept double.

s02-v13.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v13.question: Whose sport unmakes?
premises: All-might, whose sport unmakes Brahmā-Indra-Viṣṇu-arrayed world.
Wonder to be worked — bow.
s02-v13.inference: Gods' array unmade in sport; wonder bowed.

s02-v14.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v14.question: Who wins powers?
premises: Powers won by shore-roamers only — roamers of His shores.
Bow to fathomless Hara-sea.

s02-v15.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v15.question: What lotus?
premises: Mud-dwelling in Māyā-thick world — unsmeared.
Bow to shining hundred-petalled Śambhu-lotus.

s02-v16.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v16.question: What sequence?
premises: Kind, pure; treasure; self-adorned; dear; last-real; highest.
To Thee — bow.

s02-v17.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v17.question: Bound or free?
premises: Ever-bound, ever sharing freedom; lacking bond and freedom both.
To some Śambhu even — bow.
s02-v17.inference: Bondage and freedom both held and dropped.

s02-v18.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v18.question: What of the jeering world?
premises: Three-world all, whose stuff is jeering.
To Thee alone, secondless, ever bliss-throned — bow.
s02-v18.inference: Jeering world set against bliss-throned Secondless.

s02-v19.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v19.question: What rites?
premises: Right-rite's heart, left-rite's lover; all-rite, Śarva, rite-free.
To Thee — bow.

s02-v20.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v20.question: Which god?
premises: Be it how it may — whoever worshipped, wherever honored, whichever god.
To him homage: to Thee.
s02-v20.inference: All worship lands on Thee, whoever named.

s02-v21.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v21.question: What giving?
premises: Release-hungers served; thief of every fever; loveliness at choicest.
Boon-giver — bow.
uncertainties: vara puns choicest and boon-giver; hārin kept as thief.

s02-v22.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v22.question: What feast?
premises: Always three worlds brimmed with unbroken bliss-sap.
Bow, Master of the never-ending feast.
uncertainties: parvan kept as feast-day: festival as ontology.

s02-v23.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v23.question: What of His powers?
premises: Whatever courts Thee indeed, through pleasure-first tastes, enjoying.
To that dread power-ring of Thine — homage.
s02-v23.inference: The verse turns: from Him to His dread ring.
uncertainties: bhaj kept as court: powers court Him, we bow to them.

s02-v24.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v24.question: Who holds Him?
premises: Past even sages' knowing.
Yet love-yoked gesture-holders hold Him fast. To some Becoming — bow.
s02-v24.inference: Turn: from knowing to embracing; sages outpaced, lovers holding.

s02-v25.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v25.question: What nectar?
premises: Highest-nectar's sheath, highest-nectar's heap.
Reached past beyond and no-beyond — to Becoming — bow.

s02-v26.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v26.question: What form praised?
premises: Mantra through and through — I praise Thy form.
Clear, cool, lovely with unheard joy, lush with highest-nectar sap.

s02-v27.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v27.question: What teaching?
premises: On oneness-fame's wide canvas, freedom-nectar-grounded.
Where wonder isn't — that I praise: Thy teaching.
uncertainties: paṭa read as painter's canvas; pūrṇatvāt as its ground.

s02-v28.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v28.question: What road?
premises: Thunderbolt to doubts, doomsday-fire to ill-lucks, aeon-end to joylessness.
We bow the Great-Lord road.
uncertainties: Lakshmanjoo: alakṣmī as ill-luck/poverty; numaḥ kept plural — our bowing is the path.

s02-v29.speaker: Utpaladeva (bowing voice)
s02-v29.question: What shelter?
premises: Hail God! Bow on bow; all world leans on Thee.
Worlds' high Lord, One supreme — I am come for shelter.

s03-v01.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v01.question: What beyond being and non-being?
premises: Things run double — being, unbeing, the two-yoked course.
Leap it. To the Third — bow to wondrous Śambhu.
s03-v01.inference: Leap the pair; bow the Third.

s03-v02.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v02.question: Who is free?
premises: Gods, seers, men — this triple world unfree.
But free are they who live off Thee alone, O Free — Thy hangers-on.
s03-v02.inference: Freedom contagious: Thy dependents share Thy freedom.

s03-v03.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v03.question: What medicine?
premises: Thy body, gem-set with the whole world — remembering it.
The one medicine for existence-pain. Who hold it, sit easy.

s03-v04.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v04.question: Who is high Lord?
premises: Whose white parasol is the moon, lit with its own light.
Whose whisk is heaven-river's rush — He alone is high Lord.

s03-v05.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v05.question: What glance begged?
premises: Bright, cool, single, pure — like a moon-sliver.
Deal me a glance, Lord, any at all, nectar-flowing.

s03-v06.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v06.question: Why not sweet?
premises: Drops fallen from Thy knowing-bliss sea — these knowings.
Why, Lord, in my mouth not nectar-sweet, not lovely?
s03-v06.inference: Dryness interrogated: why don't sea-drops taste sweet?

s03-v07.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v07.question: Whose hearts?
premises: Hearts undipped in Thy love-sap, Lord — whose are so, Master,
are heartless, nothing else: such are contempt's seat.

s03-v08.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v08.question: Who holds powers?
premises: Whose heart has met with Thine, Lord —
he, he alone, holds the ruling Ladies' powers: their one high vessel.

s03-v09.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v09.question: What floods?
premises: Drowner of joys, then sorrows — all, alike.
Thy thought-nectar in flood, over low ground, as water seeks it.
s03-v09.inference: Meditation floods high and low alike.

s03-v10.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v10.question: What do unparted eyes hold?
premises: What would their eyes not hold, brimmed with joy-stores —
they who, by more than life, Lord, nowhere ever leave Thee?

s03-v11.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v11.question: What of arrival?
premises: I thunder — ah! — I dance: my mind-chariots ride full,
for my Master is won — since Thou utterly delightest.
s03-v11.inference: Arrival roared and danced: Master won.

s03-v12.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v12.question: What else is there?
premises: No other known for doing, no other yoke for knowing.
And yet, what of knowing? Thou — all-one-full Knowing — unfoldest.
s03-v12.inference: Others cancelled: only all-one Knowing unfolds.

s03-v13.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v13.question: What routs pain?
premises: Hard, endless pains — suddenly out of their grip, fled.
From whom? Those in whose speech rings ever the Śiva-din.
s03-v13.inference: Śiva-din in speech routs hard pains.

s03-v14.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v14.question: Is there another?
premises: Is there another high One, marked by remaining Thine?
Thou alone art the great Person — shelter of persons, none left out.
s03-v14.inference: No second Person: sole shelter proclaimed.

s03-v15.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v15.question: What of His slaves?
premises: They win — Thy slaves, honored by the world, O world-pervader.
For whom this very passing-sea is a play-lake.
s03-v15.inference: Slaves win: ocean shrunk to play-lake.

s03-v16.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v16.question: What of miseries?
premises: Let other miseries sit a while.
Here, for Thy partakers, appear plain, Thou — by that alone they are shamed.

s03-v17.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v17.question: What of beads?
premises: 'Naught beyond me' — yet even there I tell my beads, one with that.
In truth: 'murmur on' — with bead-strand Thou pointest onward.
s03-v17.inference: Beads told inside supremacy; onward pointed.

s03-v18.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v18.question: What is He — being, unbeing?
premises: From being, needs must, highest being — and being past even that, Lord.
And Thou — other than being, other than unbeing — so art Thou being-unbeing-stuff.
s03-v18.inference: Knot tied: other than both, stuff of both.

s03-v19.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v19.question: Why unseen?
premises: Purer-bright than a thousand suns raying up.
Yet Thou, though through all worlds spread, art not seen.

s03-v20.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v20.question: Where is the knower?
premises: Knowing-shaped in the dead world, they say.
Knower inside the known; mighty in the measured: since Thou art so — highest of all, Lord.

s03-v21.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s03-v21.question: What remains to cry?
premises: Enough of other wailings — just this, before the Lord: I keen aloud.
For, Lord, I swoon, knowing even so.
s03-v21.inference: Close: keen and swoon in knowing.

s04-v01.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v01.question: What of the fickle mind?
premises: Mind — though fickle — even so praised.
Since it worships the refuge of refuges, worlds' teacher, Ambikā's husband.
s04-v01.inference: Fickleness no bar: refuge-worship praises the mind.

s04-v02.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v02.question: What of low ground?
premises: Stairs of sundry gods climbed past, Śiva's feet reached and held.
Yet the low ground I keep even today. Strange — I quit it not.
s04-v02.inference: Arrival confessed with lowliness kept: strange humility.

s04-v03.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v03.question: What road?
premises: Show Thine own road, shutter all world-doings tight.
While I am, Lord, Thy servant now, ever risen.
s04-v03.inference: One road asked, world-doings shuttered; risen servanthood.

s04-v04.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v04.question: What fortune?
premises: Śiva! Śiva! Śambhu! Śaṅkara! O lover of comers-for-shelter — pity, and swift!
Who bends on remembering Thy paired lotus-feet — fortunes, not far.
s04-v04.inference: Name-cry and swiftness begged; remembering nears fortunes.

s04-v05.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v05.question: Who laughs?
premises: Dissolved in Thy foot-lotus seat, making the world to taste.
They laugh at Viriñci, office-smeared, unmastered by himself, Lord.
s04-v05.inference: Throned tasters laugh at office-stained Brahmā.

s04-v06.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v06.question: How near?
premises: Naught can show apart from Thy light-body.
So, Lord, art Thou ever already won, Master, though far by nature.
s04-v06.inference: Light-body everywhere: already won despite far-nature.

s04-v07.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v07.question: How tasted?
premises: Thy foot-lotus sap — some sup as overnight-stale difference-fare.
But some taste it fresh-poured: shining, whole-bodied, void of two.
s04-v07.inference: One sap, two tastings: stale-difference or fresh nondual.

s04-v08.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v08.question: What of the mind?
premises: Lord, like daybreak lightning shines my nectar-smeared.
Would she hold but steadier, then art Thou duly worshipped. What more?
s04-v08.inference: Nectar-smeared mind prayed steady; steady worship suffices.
uncertainties: Feminine subject unexpressed in Sanskrit (mānasī/mati implied); kept bare per Bar 6.

s04-v09.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v09.question: What beyond?
premises: 'Thing or unthing — is aught beyond this?'
Thus with high discernment resolved: as Thou art, be Thou bare to me.
s04-v09.inference: Beyond-thing questioned; bareness begged as Thou art.

s04-v10.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v10.question: Why folk-like?
premises: By Thine own will alone, Lord, on Thine own road I was set walking.
By the Lord Himself. Why then walk I mere folk-like, kenning naught worthy of Thy feet?

s04-v11.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v11.question: What blooms?
premises: Some god of Thine blooms in their hearts — a lovely high mood.
Thy story-cloud's thunder — its cātakas, by it made lovely, long.
s04-v11.inference: Heart-bloom and cloud-longing: god grown, thunder thirsted.

s04-v12.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v12.question: How fattened?
premises: Thy partakers — by some play in Thee this love has grown fat.
On parting-ground, talk, remembrance too, fruit a union-feast.
s04-v12.inference: Play-fattened love fruits union-feast from parting-ground.

s04-v13.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v13.question: How fresh?
premises: Grown by strange-sap watering — 'Śaṅkara!' hundredfold though uttered.
The word slips even into slant hearts, its errand ever fresh.
s04-v13.inference: Hundredfold Name stays fresh, slant hearts entered.

s04-v14.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v14.question: Who wins?
premises: They win on whose face-orbs circles ever the Śiva-din.
Which, moonlike, streaming from nectar's seat, trickles sweet supreme nectar.
s04-v14.inference: Śiva-din circlers win; moon-stream trickles nectar.

s04-v15.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v15.question: What knocking?
premises: The fierce world as if done; mind-stain melted thin.
Yet at Thy city, bolt-and-door, not one atom of knocking.
s04-v15.inference: World done, stain thinned — yet no knock at bolted door.

s04-v16.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v16.question: What gaze begged?
premises: Hungry for one gaze into Thy ever-bloom face-lotus's heart.
Do aught, Lord, the merest: flash Thou facing me.
s04-v16.inference: One facing-flash begged for face-lotus hunger.

s04-v17.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v17.question: Why wrong-road?
premises: What joy here but thought of Thy undifference — what other glory?
Why then does this slave of Thine go wrong-road, forsaking her?
uncertainties: 'Her' = matim (undifference-mind, v17a feminine); antecedent carried from line 1.

s04-v18.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v18.question: What fitness?
premises: Never for an instant here unfit for Thy serfdom may I be.
Unless I sip, loving, unceasing, Thy undifference-wine.

s04-v19.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v19.question: Why unheard?
premises: Folk see not, truly, Thy body — two-sight-dirtied. Yet Thou, all-knowing, shelter-tender.
Why hearest Thou not this wail of mine?
s04-v19.inference: Unseeing folk, all-knowing shelter: why unheard wail?

s04-v20.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v20.question: What wish?
premises: Rememberest Thou, Lord, e'er a sense-joy I wished — or e'er asked?
Give ever Thy body-beholding nectar — my one wish. Give it.
s04-v20.inference: Sense-joys disclaimed; one wish pressed: body-beholding nectar.

s04-v21.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v21.question: What more hunted?
premises: Since foot I've set, Great-Lord, on Thy Śiva-road — by Thy will.
Fair hundreds rose for me at once. What more hunt I from Thee, Master?
s04-v21.inference: Omens risen by will-walking: what more to hunt?

s04-v22.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v22.question: What night?
premises: Where sun goes down with moon and all their train.
What a Śiva-night reigns, self-light outspread and lustrous.
s04-v22.inference: Sun-moon set: Śiva-night of self-light reigns.

s04-v23.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v23.question: What of overlordship?
premises: Three worlds' overlordship won — yet, God-king, I reckon it sapless, all.
Wanting Thy foot-touch nectar-sap.
s04-v23.inference: Won worlds sapless beside foot-touch sap.

s04-v24.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v24.question: What bond?
premises: Alas, Lord — tough, this self-bond, Thy-unrecognition-made, tied by Thee alone.
Scorning Thee first of all, it slackens not one jot.

s04-v25.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s04-v25.question: What shape stands?
premises: God-king — though worshipped by the great, ever Thou standest worshiper-shaped alone.
Seen without, within, here, Thou flashest in seer-bodies — ever.
s04-v25.inference: Worshipped, Thou standest worshiper: seer-bodied flashing.
uncertainties: pūjakaikarūpa paradox kept (worshipped-yet-worshiper); not resolved.

s05-v01.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v01.question: What entry?
premises: Joined in enjoyment by mere touch-contact of Thy lotus-feet.
Bring me, Lord, by the neck into Thine own house.

s05-v02.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v02.question: When dance?

uncertainties: budhaḥ vocative (O Wise One), not 'a sage instead' — fixed 2026-11.

s05-v06.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v06.question: Where dwell?
premises: Mind-mountain on earth, may I dwell anywhere, All.

s05-v07.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v07.question: What town?
premises: Where Thou standest with the Lady, many-shaped, from palace to gate-tower.

s05-v08.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v08.question: What rays?
premises: May Thy sun-rays sport, Lord, till this heart-lotus of mine opens.
For Thy worship.

s05-v09.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v09.question: What melting?
premises: Be gracious (prasīda), Lord.
That my mind, ever fallen at Thy feet, tasting this and that, melt as wax, run.

s05-v10.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v10.question: Whence shown?
premises: From joy though it blow pot-lids, or from sorrow.

s05-v11.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v11.question: What oozing?
premises: Without too, within too.
May that ever-oozing be mine: Thy foot-lotus-touch nectar, cool past cool.

s05-v12.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v12.question: What lake?
premises: Dived deep in Thy touch-nectar lake.
O what a joy past joys, leaping all enjoyment — be mine, ever.

s05-v13.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v13.question: What offering?
premises: Take the laid offering — passions and the rest, Lord, by me; take, nectarize, and feast.
With lover-folk, together.
s05-v13.inference: Passions offered, nectarized, feasted in company.

s05-v14.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v14.question: What glance?
premises: Ever sated on whole-world food, easy-seated.
Master, take among slaves one grace-glance-instant.

s05-v15.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v15.question: What worship?
premises: Half-eyed, chewing inner love-wonder.
'Bow to me, to Śiva' — worshiping with even straws may I be.

s05-v16.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v16.question: What unparting?
premises: Though Thy state be won — seeing the world my self-blaze.
By love-sap feastings may I stay unparted.
s05-v16.inference: Won state kept unparted by feasting.

s05-v17.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v17.question: What fitness?
premises: Since naught else is to be longed for, Lord.
Thine — secondless — fullness is but fit.

s05-v18.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v18.question: What place?
premises: Where 'tis laughed, 'tis danced.
Where hates-and-loves are eaten, love-nectar drunk — may I win that foot-place.

s05-v19.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v19.question: What perfume?
premises: That unheard-perfume — Thy-thought-blossoms' scent.
Harden in my mind, till ill-habit's stink is eaten.
s05-v19.inference: Unheard perfume prayed hardening till stink eaten.

s05-v20.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v20.question: What taught?
premises: Where, pray, love among passions —
and where loving 'mid Hara's foot-lotuses? So teach my clash-fond heart its good, Deathless.
s05-v20.inference: Clash-heart taught its good: passions vs foot-lotuses.

s05-v21.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v21.question: What only?
premises: Roaming yoga-states even, turned from sense-things even.
Thy-thought-wine's frenzy liquifying my heart — only that may I be.

s05-v22.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)

premises: Speech, mind-thoughts, sense-wrought body-moves.
Everywhere, ever, may love-sap run vanguard before me.
s05-v22.inference: Love-sap vanguard begged for all doings.

s05-v23.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)

premises: 'Śiva Śiva Śiva' — Thy name muttered without end, Lord.
Tasting may I be some great unre-said sap.
s05-v23.inference: Unre-said sap tasted in endless muttering.

s05-v24.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)

premises: Vast flashing endless knowing-self — dull roads all drunk dry.
Ramparts uncounted, knowing-made — may I roam, by Thee honored.
s05-v24.inference: Vast knowing roamed, honored, past drunk-dry roads.

s05-v25.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)
s05-v25.question: What thought?
premises: Standing in self-body, clear-shining, everlasting.
Naught else avails. Firm be this thought. Yet — Thy foot-lotus dust, O Pure.

s05-v26.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee voice)

premises: Something, Lord, sometime flashes in mind.
Touchers of Thy foot-sole, where this whole melts — in nectar's lake show me this world, ever.
s05-v26.inference: Flashed something shown: sole-touchers where whole melts.
uncertainties: Genitive plurals kept literal (sole-touchers); unexpressed head noun left open per Bar 6.

s08-v01.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s08-v01.question: When will the grace-devotion pair take root?
premises: Grace-drop (prasādalava) stationed in the Lord (īśvarasthito); devotion (bhakti) come as if to meet me (iva mām upeyuṣī).
The pair (tau) joined (parasparasamanvitau) — when will they take root (rūḍhim eṣyataḥ) in such a body (tādṛśe vapuṣi)?
The verse poses the meeting as a question, not an assertion: the devotee does not claim the upsurge has happened.
s08-v01.inference: The grace-devotion pair is posed as a question: when will they take root? The devotee does not claim the upsurge; he asks for it.
uncertainties: Whether 'prasādalava' means 'drop of grace' or 'grace's drop' (genitive) is unresolved.
Whether 'tādṛśe vapuṣi' refers to the devotee's body or the Lord's body is unresolved.

s08-v02.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s08-v02.question: What is the first fruit of chewing His lordship?
premises: Born of chewing His lordship (tvatprabhutvaparicarvaṇajanmā): may some inner joy-juice (paritoṣaraso) rise ('ntaḥ udetu).
Here always be supreme for me (sarvakālam iha me param astu) — knowledge-yoga's glories far off (jñānayogamahimādi vidūre).
The verse converts chewing (carvaṇa) into a method: rumination produces joy-juice, displacing metaphysics.
s08-v02.inference: Chewing His lordship produces inner joy-juice; knowledge-yoga's glories are far off. Rumination displaces metaphysics.
uncertainties: Whether 'ko 'pi' (some) refers to joy-juice or to a person is unresolved.
Whether 'param' (supreme) modifies 'astu' or 'me' is unresolved.

s08-v03.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s08-v03.question: How is worldly thirst redirected?
premises: Like the worldly (lokavad), let my thirst for objects swell (sphīta eva bhagavanparitarṣaḥ).
Only seeing them as Your body (tava śarīratayaitān lokayeyam), unconstructed (astavikalpaḥ).
The verse keeps worldly thirst but redirects it: thirst for objects becomes thirst for seeing them as His body.
s08-v03.inference: Worldly thirst kept, unconstructed sight required: thirst for objects becomes thirst for seeing them as His body.
uncertainties: Whether 'bhagavanparitarṣaḥ' means 'thirst for You, Lord' or 'thirst, O Lord' is unresolved.
Whether 'astavikalpaḥ' means 'unconstructed' or 'without alternative' is unresolved.

s08-v04.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s08-v04.question: Where is plainness demanded?
premises: In body-grounds (dehabhūmiṣu) and in mind (manasi), Lord (tvaṃ), and in breath's course (prāṇavartmani) where difference (bhedam) has come (upete) —
and in those consciousness-paths (saṃvidaḥ pathiṣu teṣu ca) — by Yourself (tena svātmanā) be plain (sphuṭarūpaḥ) to me (mama).
Plainness demanded in both registers: body-grounds and consciousness-paths.
s08-v04.inference: Plainness demanded in both registers: body-grounds and consciousness-paths. By Yourself, be plain to me.
uncertainties: Whether 'sphuṭarūpaḥ' means 'plain' or 'manifest' is unresolved.
Whether 'tena' refers to Yourself or to the path is unresolved.

s08-v05.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s08-v05.question: What is the one fear?
premises: May these thrilled faculties (imāḥ karaṇavṛttaya ullasitā) fall into their own seats (nijanijeṣu padeṣu patantv).
Never, Lord (kṣaṇamapīśa), even slightly (manāg api), the daring of non-difference-rupture (tvadavibhedarasakṣatisāhasam).
One fear named: rupture of non-difference. The faculties self-seat; the daring is refused.
s08-v05.inference: Faculties self-seat; one fear named — rupture of non-difference. The daring is refused.
uncertainties: Whether 'kṣaṇamapīśa' means 'never, Lord, even for a moment' or 'Lord, even for a moment' is unresolved.
Whether 'tvadavibhedarasa' means 'the rasa of non-difference' or 'the non-difference-rasa' is unresolved.

s08-v06.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s08-v06.question: What exceeds transaction?
premises: Light, soft, white-pure, cool (laghumasṛṇasitācchaśītalaṃ) — contemplating (bhāvayan) by possession-force (bhavadāveśavaśena) a body (vapur).
May I exceed (ativartayeya) those dealings (vyavahārān) of the all-thing-road (akhilapadārthapaddhater).
Possession-body exceeds transaction: the world is left, not refuted.
s08-v06.inference: Possession-body exceeds transaction: the world is left, not refuted. May I exceed those dealings.
uncertainties: Whether 'laghumasṛṇasitācchaśītalaṃ' describes the body or the contemplation is unresolved.
Whether 'vyavahāra' means transaction or worldly dealing is unresolved.

s08-v07.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s08-v07.question: What becomes untellable?
premises: May my self-body bloom (vikasatu svavapur) as You (bhavadātmakaṃ).
May worlds join (samupayāntu) my limbs (mamāṅgatām).
May all this duality-sport (sarvam idaṃ dvayavalgitaṃ), even recalled (smṛtipathopagame 'py), become untellable (anupākhyatām).
s08-v07.inference: Blooming, joining, untellability: the duality-sport becomes untellable even when recalled.
uncertainties: Whether 'dvayavalgitaṃ' means 'duality-sport' or 'the sport of duality' is unresolved.
Whether 'anupākhyatām' means 'untellable' or 'unnameable' is unresolved.

s08-v08.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s08-v08.question: What fills the dread gorge?
premises: May there rise (samudiyād), looking at such Yours (tādṛśatāvakānana viloka), a flood of supreme nectar (parāmṛtasamplavaḥ).
So my filling (ghaṭeta) of non-duality's dread gorge (bhavadadvayāprathanaghoradarīparipūraṇam) happens (mama).
The abyss is flooded: non-duality's dread gorge filled by supreme nectar.
s08-v08.inference: The abyss is flooded: non-duality's dread gorge filled by supreme nectar. Looking at His, the flood rises.
uncertainties: Whether 'tādṛśatāvakānana' means 'such Yours' or 'such a forest of Yours' is unresolved.
Whether 'ghoradarī' means 'dread gorge' or 'terrible cave' is unresolved.

s08-v09.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s08-v09.question: What is the wager?
premises: If ever (api kadācana) by the thinnest union-drops (tāvakasaṅgamāmṛtakaṇācchuraṇena tanīyasā) —
may I turn (parāṅmukho) from all world-pleasures (sakalalokasukheṣu); or shall I, fallen from both (ubhayacyuta eva), be...? (kim).
The wager: union-drops against world-pleasures, with double-fall risk named.
s08-v09.inference: The wager: union-drops against world-pleasures, with double-fall risk named. The devotee names the risk, not hiding it.
uncertainties: Whether 'ubhayacyuta' means 'fallen from both' or 'fallen from both sides' is unresolved.
Whether 'kim' is a question or a rhetorical exclamation is unresolved.

s08-v10.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s08-v10.question: How does devotion join?
premises: Ever (satatam) at Your lotus-feet (bhavaccaraṇāmbujākaracarasya), of me the best hamsa (hi haṃsavarasya) moving in the lake (me).
Above from root below (upari mūlatalād api), and from inside (cāntarād) — may devotion's lotus-stalk (bhaktimṛṇālikā) bend up (upanamatv), unborn (aja) Lord.
Hamsa-and-stalk botany: joining below, inside, above.
s08-v10.inference: Hamsa-and-stalk botany: devotion's lotus-stalk bends up from below, inside, above. Joining at every level.
uncertainties: Whether 'haṃsavarasya' means 'best hamsa' or 'swan-king' is unresolved.
Whether 'bhaktimṛṇālikā' means 'devotion's lotus-stalk' or 'the stalk of devotion' is unresolved.

s08-v11.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s08-v11.question: What is scope without seizure?
premises: May all things (samastavastūny api) come under thought's scope (cintāviṣayaṃ) and vision's footing (dṛśaḥ padaṃ ca) for me (mama).
May vision-thought-light-nectar-essences (darśanacintanaprakāśāmṛtasārāṇi) blaze supreme (paraṃ parisphurantu).
Scope, not seizure: all things under thought's scope without seizure.
s08-v11.inference: Scope, not seizure: all things under thought's scope and vision's footing; essences blaze supreme.
uncertainties: Whether 'cintāviṣayaṃ' means 'under thought's scope' or 'as thought's object' is unresolved.
Whether 'parisphurantu' means 'blaze' or 'manifest' is unresolved.

s08-v12.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s08-v12.question: What is practice for catastrophe?
premises: Lord (parameśvara), in crashing hardships (teṣu teṣu kṛcchreṣv api), as names bend down (nāmopanamatsv) —
may I be (ahaṃ bhaveyam), fear gone (na paraṃ gatabhīs) only while limb-joined (tvadaṅgasaṅgādupajātādhikasammado), exceeding-joy-mad ('pi yāvat).
Practice for catastrophe: fear gone only while limb-joined, exceeding-joy-mad.
s08-v12.inference: Practice for catastrophe: fear gone only while limb-joined, exceeding-joy-mad. Limb-joined, not doctrine.
uncertainties: Whether 'gatabhīs' means 'fear gone' or 'gone fear' is unresolved.
Whether 'yāvat' means 'while' or 'as long as' is unresolved.

s08-v13.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s08-v13.question: What is the closing epistemology?
premises: The universe (viśvam) woven (umbhitaṃ) in Your self (bhavadātmani), shown (prakāśyate) outside (bahiḥ) by You alone (bhavataivāpi) —
what stands firm-certain (yad dṛḍhaniścayopajuṣṭaṃ): may it now shine plain (tad idāniṃ sphuṭam eva bhāsatām).
Closing epistemology: woven in Him, shown by Him, certain — shine.
s08-v13.inference: Closing epistemology: woven in Him, shown by Him, firm-certain — may it now shine plain.

s12-v04.question: What do the sated do?
premises: Sated (sākṣatkṛta) with Your form-nectar (bhavadrūpaprasṛtāmṛtatarpitāḥ), thirst uprooted (unmūlitatṛṣo), drunk (mattā) — they wander (vicaranti) at will (yathāruci).
The sated wander free: thirst uprooted, drunk on form-nectar.
s12-v04.inference: The sated wander free: thirst uprooted by form-nectar, drunk, at will.

s12-v05.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v05.question: What is timeless vision?
premises: Not then (na tadā), not always (na sadā), not once (na caikadā) — where no time-thought (yatra na kāladhīr) is:
such is Your vision (bhavadīyadarśanaṃ), neither eternal (na ca nityaṃ) nor otherwise (na ca kathyate 'nyathā).
Timeless vision: neither eternal nor otherwise.
s12-v05.inference: Timeless vision: neither eternal nor otherwise. Where no time-thought is, Your vision stands.
uncertainties: Whether 'kāladhī' means 'time-thought' or 'thought of time' is unresolved.
Whether 'anyathā' means 'otherwise' or 'different' is unresolved.

s12-v06.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v06.question: How does one enter?
premises: May my mind (tvadvilokanasamutkacetaso), risen to see You, gain this yoga-fruit (yogasiddhir iyatī) always (sadāstu me).
To enter Your nectar-house (yad viśeyam abhisandhimātratas tvatsudhāsadanam) by mere resolve (abhisandhimātratas), for Your worship (arcanāya te).
Entering by resolve: mere resolve suffices for the nectar-house.
s12-v06.inference: Entering by resolve: mere resolve suffices to enter the nectar-house, for worship.
uncertainties: Whether 'abhisandhimātratas' means 'by mere resolve' or 'by resolve alone' is unresolved.
Whether 'yogasiddhir iyatī' means 'this yoga-fruit' or 'this much yoga-siddhi' is unresolved.

s12-v07.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v07.question: What shines plainly?
premises: The clear-minded (nirvikalpabhavadīyadarśanapraptiphullamanasāṃ) great ones' (mahātmanām) pure play (ullasanti vimalāni) and words (vacāṃsi ca) shine plainly (sphuṭam), playfully (helayā).
Pure play of the clear-minded: play and words shine plainly.
s12-v07.inference: Pure play of the clear-minded: play and words shine plainly, playfully.
uncertainties: Whether 'nirvikalpa' means 'clear-minded' or 'without alternative' is unresolved.
Whether 'helayā' means 'playfully' or 'with ease' is unresolved.

s12-v08.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v08.question: Where does one dwell fearlessly?
premises: Dwelling (nivasann) between Your feet (bhavanbhavadīyapādayor antara eva), fearless (nirbhayaḥ).
In those and those world-grounds (bhavabhūmiṣu tāsu tāsv ahaṃ) may I worship (prabhum arceyam) the Lord, unbarred in act (anargalakriyaḥ).
Fearless dwelling between His feet: worship unbarred.
s12-v08.inference: Fearless dwelling between His feet: worship the Lord, unbarred in act.
uncertainties: Whether 'antara eva' means 'between' or 'in the interior' is unresolved.
Whether 'anargalakriyaḥ' means 'unbarred in act' or 'unimpeded in action' is unresolved.

s12-v09.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v09.question: What is dissolved wandering?
premises: Dissolved (parilīno) in Your foot-lake (bhavadaṅghrisaroruhodare), melted seeking (galitaparaiṣaṇaḥ), honey-drunk to excess (atimātramadhūpayogataḥ).
May I roam (vicareyam) satisfied (paritṛpto), at will (icchayā).
Dissolved, drunk, wandering at will: the devotee melted in His foot-lake.
s12-v09.inference: Dissolved, drunk, wandering at will: the devotee melted in His foot-lake, roaming satisfied.
uncertainties: Whether 'paraiṣaṇa' means 'seeking' or 'desire' is unresolved.
Whether 'madhūpayoga' means 'honey-drunk' or 'honey-use' is unresolved.

s12-v10.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v10.question: Does pretense suffice?
premises: Whose resolve (yasya) to worship (bhavatpūjāsaṅkalpa) arose even from pretense (utthitaḥ tasyāpy avaśyam uditaṃ sannidhānaṃ tava) —
his presence (sannidhānaṃ) is assured (avaśyam), fitting (ucitam).
Even pretense suffices: the resolve to worship assures presence.
s12-v10.inference: Even pretense suffices: the resolve to worship assures His presence.
uncertainties: Whether 'dambhād iva' means 'even from pretense' or 'as if from pretense' is unresolved.
Whether 'ucitam' means 'fitting' or 'appropriate' is unresolved.

s12-v11.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v11.question: What is drinking to fullness?
premises: Lord (bhagavann), with one-taste mind (ekarasena cetasā) seeking nothing else (itarān apekṣiṇā nitarām) —
the all-laying Lord (sakalopaśāyinaṃ prabhum), easy (sulabhaṃ) — may I drink (ātṛpti pibeyam) to fullness (ātṛpti): am I what (asmi kim)?
Drinking to fullness: one-taste mind, nothing else sought.
s12-v11.inference: Drinking to fullness: one-taste mind seeking nothing else, the all-laying Lord, easy.
uncertainties: Whether 'ekarasena' means 'one-taste' or 'single-flavored' is unresolved.
Whether 'asmi kim' means 'am I what?' or 'what am I?' is unresolved.

s12-v12.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v12.question: What is the essence-extract?
premises: By You denied (tvayā nirākṛtam): all where You're absent (sarvaṃ heyam etat) is to be left (heyam).
Where it's You (tvanmayaṃ), to be taken (samupādeyam).
This is the essence-extract (ity ayaṃ sārasaṃgrahaḥ): the one portable rule.
s12-v12.inference: The essence-extract: what is without You is to be left; what is You is to be taken.
uncertainties: Whether 'nirākṛtam' means 'denied by You' or 'rejected by You' is unresolved.
Whether 'samupādeyam' means 'to be taken' or 'to be adopted' is unresolved.

s12-v13.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v13.question: How could outside non-being be worshipped?
premises: The world-born (bhavato 'ntaracāri bhāvajātaṃ) worshipped as chief (prabhuvanmukhyatayaiva pūjitaṃ) by being inside You.
How, Lord (katham īśān), could non-being outside (bhavato bahir apy abhāvamātrā) be worshipped (samarcyate), or by whom (vā)?
Inside worshipped, outside how: the puzzle of worship's ground.
s12-v13.inference: Inside worshipped, outside how: non-being outside cannot be worshipped. The puzzle of worship's ground.
uncertainties: Whether 'bhavato 'ntaracāri' means 'dwelling inside You' or 'moving inside You' is unresolved.
Whether 'abhāvamātrā' means 'mere non-being' or 'only non-being' is unresolved.

s12-v14.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v14.question: What faces everywhere?
premises: Facing everywhere (sakalataḥ) in agitation (vibhramamāṇāḥ) —
things coming and going (gatāgatā), may they shine (bhāntu) for me (me).
Facing everywhere in agitation: may things shine.
s12-v14.inference: Facing everywhere in agitation: may things, coming and going, shine.
uncertainties: Whether 'vibhramamāṇāḥ' means 'agitated' or 'bewildered' is unresolved.
Whether 'gatāgatā' refers to things or to the devotee is unresolved.

s12-v15.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v15.question: What is revealed?
premises: Reveal (prakāśaya) the abode (sadanaṃ) — Lord, Your city (tava puram).
May I see (paśyeyam) the abode where You dwell.
Reveal the abode: may I see where You dwell.
s12-v15.inference: Reveal the abode: may I see where the Lord dwells.
uncertainties: Whether 'prakāśaya' is imperative or optative is unresolved.
Whether 'sadanaṃ' means 'abode' or 'house' is unresolved.

s12-v16.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v16.question: Are those who flee unseen?
premises: Fled (palāyitāḥ) yet never unseen (tathāpi nādṛṣṭāḥ): they are always seen by You.
Even those who flee are never unseen by the Lord.
Fled yet never unseen: the Lord sees even those who flee.
s12-v16.inference: Fled yet never unseen: even those who flee are seen by the Lord.
uncertainties: Whether 'palāyitāḥ' means 'fled' or 'those who flee' is unresolved.
Whether 'nādṛṣṭāḥ' means 'never unseen' or 'not unseen' is unresolved.

s12-v17.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v17.question: What floods to joy?
premises: Flood (plāvitaḥ) to joy (ānanda): may I be flooded with joy.
The devotee is flooded with joy by the Lord's grace.
Flood to joy: the devotee flooded with joy.
s12-v17.inference: Flood to joy: the devotee flooded with joy by the Lord's grace.
uncertainties: Whether 'plāvitaḥ' means 'flooded' or 'overflowing' is unresolved.
Whether 'ānanda' modifies 'plāvitaḥ' or is separate is unresolved.

s12-v18.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v18.question: What is grain for worship-exchange?
premises: Grain (dhānya) for worship-exchange (pūjā): may I offer grain as worship-exchange.
The devotee offers grain as worship-exchange.
Grain for worship-exchange: offering grain as exchange.
s12-v18.inference: Grain for worship-exchange: the devotee offers grain as exchange.
uncertainties: Whether 'dhānya' means 'grain' or 'wealth' is unresolved.
Whether 'pūjā' means 'worship' or 'exchange' is unresolved.

s12-v19.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v19.question: What is seeing?
premises: Seeing each thing (sarvam), seeing You (tvām): seeing each thing is seeing You.
The devotee sees each thing as You.
Seeing each thing, seeing You: non-dual seeing.
s12-v19.inference: Seeing each thing is seeing You: non-dual seeing.
uncertainties: Whether 'sarvam' means 'all things' or 'everything' is unresolved.
Whether 'tvām' is accusative or dative is unresolved.

s12-v20.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v20.question: What is the unhaunting mind?
premises: Unhaunting mind (manas) questioned: may the mind be unhaunted.
The mind questioned, unhaunted.
Unhaunting mind: the mind questioned and freed.
s12-v20.inference: Unhaunting mind: the mind questioned and freed from haunting.
uncertainties: Whether 'unhaunting' means 'freed from haunting' or 'not haunting' is unresolved.
Whether 'questioned' is interrogative or declarative is unresolved.

s12-v21.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v21.question: Who sees?
premises: Ploughmen see (kṛṣakāḥ paśyanti): even ploughmen see.
The devotee sees through ploughmen's eyes.
Ploughmen see: even the simple see.
s12-v21.inference: Even ploughmen see: the simple see, not only the learned.
uncertainties: Whether 'kṛṣakāḥ' means 'ploughmen' or 'farmers' is unresolved.
Whether 'paśyanti' is present or imperative is unresolved.

s12-v22.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v22.question: Whose are thought and act, and what is the devotee's part?
premises: No thought rises unstained by Thy will (na sā matir udeti yā na bhavati tvadicchāmayī).
All performance is the Lord's, good or else (bhagavatā evam ācaryate).
Hence roaming as Thine-in-self, standing ceaseless at the unstopped feast of foot-worship.
s12-v22.inference: Thought and act are His; the devotee's part is the standing - ceaseless attendance at worship.

s12-v23.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v23.question: What is the triad?
premises: Insight (prajñā), power (śakti), unpausing worship (anargalapūjā): insight, power, unpausing worship.
The devotee has insight, power, unpausing worship.
Insight, power, unpausing worship: the devotee's triad.
s12-v23.inference: Insight, power, unpausing worship: the devotee's triad.
uncertainties: Whether 'prajñā' means 'insight' or 'wisdom' is unresolved.
Whether 'śakti' means 'power' or 'energy' is unresolved.

s12-v24.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v24.question: What is the sense-heap?
premises: Sense-heap (indriyagaṇa) as His limb (aṅga): the senses are His limb.
The devotee's senses are His limb.
Sense-heap as His limb: the senses are His.
s12-v24.inference: Sense-heap as His limb: the senses are His limb.
uncertainties: Whether 'indriyagaṇa' means 'sense-heap' or 'host of senses' is unresolved.
Whether 'aṅga' means 'limb' or 'part' is unresolved.

s12-v25.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v25.question: Roaming yet unswerving — how?
premises: Mind roaming wherever, by its own rhythm, in its fields (manasi svarasena yatra tatra pracaraty).
Yet spread out, unswerving, skilled in Thy service always (prasṛto 'py avilola eva yuṣmatparicaryācaturaḥ sadā bhaveyam).
s12-v25.inference: Roaming is the given; unswerving service inside it is the prayer.
uncertainties: Whether 'manas' means 'mind' or 'thought' is unresolved.
Whether 'sevā' means 'service' or 'worship' is unresolved.
Swamiji (Academy, ch12 v25): don't control the swift mind — skill within roaming, not restraint of it.

s12-v26.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v26.question: What is the paradox?
premises: Slave by His will (daśa), yet faceless (amukha): slave by His will, yet faceless.
The devotee is slave by His will, yet faceless.
Slave by His will, yet faceless: the devotee's paradox.
s12-v26.inference: Slave by His will, yet faceless: the devotee's paradox.
uncertainties: Whether 'daśa' means 'slave' or 'servant' is unresolved.
Whether 'amukha' means 'faceless' or 'without face' is unresolved.

s12-v27.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v27.question: What is wondered at?
premises: Opponents wondered at (pratyartharūpa): even opposition gets wondered at, not warned against.
The devotee wonders at opponents.
Opponents wondered at: even opposition is wondered at.
s12-v27.inference: Opponents wondered at: even opposition gets wondered at, not warned against.
uncertainties: Whether 'pratyartharūpa' means 'counter-form' or 'opponent-form' is unresolved.
Whether 'wondered at' means 'marveled' or 'amazed' is unresolved.

s12-v28.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v28.question: What are things?
premises: Things as things (bhāva) by His being (bhavatā): things are things by His being.
The devotee sees things as things by His being.
Things as things by His being: ontology becomes benediction.
s12-v28.inference: Things as things by His being: ontology becomes benediction.
uncertainties: Whether 'bhāva' means 'thing' or 'being' is unresolved.
Whether 'bhavatā' means 'by His being' or 'by His existence' is unresolved.

s12-v29.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s12-v29.question: What is the final rite?
premises: Nothing/something grammar of worship (śūnya/asti): the nothing/something pattern becomes the final rite.
The devotee worships with the nothing/something grammar.
Nothing/something grammar of worship: the final rite.
s12-v29.inference: Nothing/something grammar of worship: the final rite.
uncertainties: Whether 'śūnya' means 'nothing' or 'empty' is unresolved.
Whether 'asti' means 'something' or 'is' is unresolved.

s13-v01.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s13-v01.question: What is pain, what is pleasure?
premises: Pain defined as separation, pleasure as union: saṃgrahena sukhaduḥkhalakṣaṇaṃ māṃ prati sthitam idaṃ śṛṇu prabho.
Saukhyam eṣa bhavatā samāgamaḥ: just to be in Thy presence is pleasure.
Svāminā viraha eva duḥkhitā: being carried away from Thy presence brings deep pain.
The verse defines pain/pleasure before proving the definition across twenty moves.
s13-v01.inference: Pain = separation, pleasure = union. The definition precedes the proof.
uncertainties: Whether 'sukhaduḥkhalakṣaṇaṃ' means 'definition of pleasure and pain' or 'characteristic of pleasure and pain' is unresolved.
Whether 'viraha' means 'separation' or 'absence' is unresolved.
Swamiji: ch13+14 composed 'in his senses' (saṅgraha = sane summary) vs the gone/ecstatic chapters — the definition-verse is deliberate doctrine, not effusion.

s13-v02.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s13-v02.question: What blocks perception?
premises: Antar apy atitarām aṇīyasī yā tvadaprathanakālikāsti me: a minute impurity in the internal state, keeping me from perceiving You.
Tām apīśa parimṛjya sarvataḥ: remove that impurity completely.
Svaṃ svarūpam amalaṃ prakāśaya: reveal Your pure form.
The verse asks for removal of the subtle impurity (āṇavamala) that blocks perception.
s13-v02.inference: A minute impurity blocks perception; remove it completely and reveal Your pure form.
uncertainties: Whether 'aṇīyasī' means 'minute' or 'subtle' is unresolved.
Whether 'parimṛjya' means 'wiping away' or 'removing' is unresolved.
Swamiji (Hymns to Shiva ch13) reads the kālikā as the āṇavamala remnant — māyīya and kārma malas already gone, only the minute internal dirt blocking perception remains; minted as live L0 fork.

s13-v03.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s13-v03.question: What is the sole longing?
premises: Tāvake vapuṣi viśvanirbhare citsudhārasamaye niratyaye: residing in Your universal body, filled with supreme nectar of consciousness.
Tiṣṭhataḥ satatam arcataḥ prabhuṃ: residing, worshipping the Lord constantly.
Jīvitaṃ mṛtam athānyad astu me: let me die, let me go to hell or heaven — I don't care, so long as I have Your worship.
The verse states the devotee's sole longing: reside in Your body and worship, indifferent to life/death.
s13-v03.inference: Reside in Your universal body and worship constantly; life/death indifferent — worship is the sole longing.
uncertainties: Whether 'jīvitaṃ mṛtam' means 'let me live or die' or 'whether living or dead' is unresolved.
Whether 'anyad' means 'other' or 'anything else' is unresolved.
Swamiji: jīvitam/mṛtam/anyad spans hell, heaven, even mokṣa — all indifferent against constant worship; the verse's only desire is satatam arcana.

s13-v04.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s13-v04.question: When is ego appropriate?
premises: Īśvaro 'ham aham eva rūpavān paṇḍito 'smi subhago 'smi ko 'paraḥ: I am Īśvara, beautiful, learned, charming — who else is parallel?
Matsamo 'sti jagatīti śobhate mānitā tvadanurāgiṇaḥ param: this ego shines beautifully only in those devoted to You.
The verse presents the devotee's ego as appropriate only when devoted to You.
s13-v04.inference: Ego shines beautifully only in those devoted to You: 'I am Īśvara' is appropriate only with devotion.
uncertainties: Whether 'mānitā' means 'ego' or 'pride' is unresolved.
Whether 'param' means 'supreme' or 'ultimately' is unresolved.
Swamiji: this ego (mānitā) SHINES in devotees but damns the detached ('let them go to the dogs'); maxim: he who is attached to God is beautiful because love for God is charming.

s13-v05.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s13-v05.question: What makes worship possible?
premises: Devadeva bhavadadvayāmṛtākhyātisaṃharaṇalabdhajanmanā: O Lord of Lords, by the touch of oneness, senses nectarized.
Tad yathāsthitapadārthasaṃvidā māṃ kuruṣva caraṇārcanocitam: make me worthy of worshipping Your feet.
The verse asks for senses nectarized by oneness, so worship becomes possible.
s13-v05.inference: Senses nectarized by oneness: make me worthy of worshipping Your feet.
uncertainties: Whether 'labdhajanmanā' means 'born of' or 'attained through' is unresolved.
Whether 'yathāsthitapadārtha' means 'things as they stand' or 'things as they are' is unresolved.

s13-v06.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s13-v06.question: What is the sequence?
premises: Dhyāyate tad anu dṛśyate tataḥ spṛśyate ca parameśvaraḥ svayam: meditated, then seen, then touched — the Lord Himself.
Yatra pūjanamahotsavaḥ sa me sarvadāstu bhavato 'nubhāvataḥ: where worship-festival is, let it always be mine by Your grace.
The verse sequences meditation → vision → touch → festival.
s13-v06.inference: Meditation, then vision, then touch: the Lord Himself. Worship-festival always, by grace.
uncertainties: Whether 'dhyāyate' is passive or active is unresolved.
Whether 'anubhāvataḥ' means 'by grace' or 'by experience' is unresolved.

s13-v07.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s13-v07.question: What grounds what?
premises: Yady athāsthitapadārthadarśanaṃ yuṣmadarcanamahotsavaś ca yaḥ: if seeing things as they stand and worship-festival —
yugmam etad itaretarāśrayaṃ bhaktiśāliṣu sadā vijṛmbhate: this pair mutually grounds, always blooms in devotees.
Seeing and worship-festival mutually ground each other in devotees.
s13-v07.inference: Seeing things as they stand and worship-festival mutually ground each other in devotees.
uncertainties: Whether 'yugmam' means 'pair' or 'couple' is unresolved.
Whether 'itaretarāśraya' means 'mutually grounding' or 'reciprocal support' is unresolved.

s13-v08.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s13-v08.question: How is worship drunk?
premises: Tattadindriyamukhena santataṃ yuṣmadarcanarasāyanāsavam: through each sense, the worship-rasa-nectar.
Sarvabhāvacaṣakeṣu pūriteṣv āpibann api bhaveyam unmadaḥ: drinking, even, from filled cups of all things, may I be mad.
The verse asks to drink worship-rasa through every sense, becoming mad with it.
s13-v08.inference: Drink worship-rasa through every sense, from filled cups of all things — may I be mad with it.
uncertainties: Whether 'rasāyanāsava' means 'worship-rasa-nectar' or 'rasa-nectar of worship' is unresolved.
Whether 'unmadaḥ' means 'mad' or 'intoxicated' is unresolved.

s13-v09.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s13-v09.question: What is knowable?
premises: Anyavedyam aṇumātram asti na: no thing is knowable apart from You.
Svaprakāśam akhilaṃ vijṛmbhate: all shines by self-luminosity.
Yatra nātha bhavataḥ pure sthitaṃ tatra me kuru sadā tavārcituḥ: where You dwell, make me always Your worshipper.
The verse: nothing apart from You is knowable; all shines by self-luminosity; make me Your worshipper where You dwell.
s13-v09.inference: Nothing apart from You is knowable; all shines by self-luminosity; make me Your worshipper where You dwell.
uncertainties: Whether 'anyavedyam' means 'knowable apart' or 'known by another' is unresolved.
Whether 'pure' means 'city' or 'abode' is unresolved.

s13-v10.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s13-v10.question: What makes worthy?
premises: Dāsadhāmni viniyojito 'py ahaṃ svecchayaiva parameśvara tvayā: even deployed in the slave's abode, by Your will.
Darśanena na kim asmi pātritaḥ pādasaṃvahanakarmaṇāpi vā: am I not made worthy by seeing, or even by foot-massage?
The verse: even in the slave's abode, by Your will — am I not made worthy by seeing or foot-massage?
s13-v10.inference: Even in the slave's abode, by Your will — am I not made worthy by seeing or foot-massage?
uncertainties: Whether 'dāsadhāmni' means 'in the slave's abode' or 'in the servant's place' is unresolved.
Whether 'pātritaḥ' means 'made worthy' or 'qualified' is unresolved.

s13-v11.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice, first-person)
s13-v11.question: Why delay?

Adya māṃ prati kim āgataṃ yataḥ svaprakāśanavidhau vilambase: what has come to me today that You delay in self-manifestation?
The verse: grace-descent needs no investigation; why delay self-manifestation?
s13-v11.inference: Grace-descent needs no investigation; why delay self-manifestation?
uncertainties: Whether 'vicāraṇaṃ' means 'investigation' or 'deliberation' is unresolved.
Whether 'vilambase' means 'delay' or 'linger' is unresolved.

s13-v12.question: Where is You seen?

Tvāṃ jagattritayanirbharaṃ sadā lokayeya nijapāṇipūjitam: may I always see You, filling the three worlds, worshipped by my own hand.
The verse: see You filling all three worlds, worshipped by my own hand.
s13-v12.inference: See You filling all three worlds, inside and outside with Pārvatī, worshipped by my own hand.
uncertainties: Whether 'bahirvibhāty' means 'shines outside' or 'is manifest outside' is unresolved.
Whether 'nijapāṇipūjitam' means 'worshipped by my own hand' or 'worshipped by own hand' is unresolved.

s13-v13.question: How to ascend?

Syāṃ prasāda paramāmṛtāsavāpānakeliparilabdhanirvṛtiḥ: may I attain the bliss of the nectar-drinking play of grace.
The verse: ascend by mere resolve; attain the bliss of grace's nectar-drinking play.
s13-v13.inference: Ascend by mere resolve; attain the bliss of grace's nectar-drinking play.
uncertainties: Whether 'abhisandhimātrato' means 'by mere resolve' or 'by resolve alone' is unresolved.
Whether 'prasāda' means 'grace' or 'favor' is unresolved.

Tāṃ samarpayati tena te vapuḥ pūjayanty acalabhaktiśālinaḥ: offering that wonder, the devotees worship Your body.
The verse: touching beautiful things gives wonder; offering it, devotees worship Your body.
s13-v14.inference: Touching beautiful things gives wonder (camatkāra); offering it, devotees worship Your body.
uncertainties: Whether 'sparśamātravidhinā' means 'by mere touch' or 'by the method of touch' is unresolved.

s13-v15.question: How does the world dance?
premises: Sphārayasy akhilam ātmanā sphuran viśvam āmṛśasi rūpam āmṛśan: You spread all by Yourself, shining; You touch the form, touching.
Yat svayaṃ nijarasena ghurṇase tat samullasati bhāvamaṇḍalam: what You whirl by Your own rasa, that world-circle dances.
The verse: You spread all by Yourself; the world dances by Your rasa.
s13-v15.inference: You spread all by Yourself; the world dances by Your rasa.

s13-v16.question: Where is fear?

Svātmapakṣaparipūrite jagaty asya nityasukhinaḥ kuto bhayam: in a world filled with self-nature, where is fear for the eternally happy?

s16-v01.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s16-v01.question: Who blocks Thy veiling — folk or devotees?
premises: Nothing of folk stands against Thy veiling (na kiñcid eva lokānāṃ bhavadāvaraṇaṃ prati).
Nothing of devotees stands against it either (na kiñcid eva bhaktānāṃ bhavadāvaraṇaṃ prati).
The two lines are identical in form; only lokānāṃ/bhaktānāṃ changes.
s16-v01.inference: Veiling is unopposed from both sides: neither the world nor devotion blocks it.
uncertainties: GRETIL carries a \var alternate first quarter (yat kiṃ cid eva bhūtānāṃ) with a Nareśvaraparīkṣā cross-ref; cite cleaned to the main reading, variant logged here.
Whether the verse consoles (nothing you must fight) or accuses (not even devotion avails) is unresolved.

May I be, by devotion (bhaveyaṃ bhaktitaḥ prabho).
s16-v08.inference: States are indifferent; devotion is the constant.
uncertainties: Swamiji (Academy, ch16 v8): 'Let me be ... in crisis or peaceful, or miserable or happy ... by the intensity of Thy devotion ... I don't mind.'

s16-v27.inference: From knower and from knowable, on whose knowing-road there is no parting from You

s16-v28.inference: Embraced in saṃsāra's hall by some, You

s16-v29.inference: With Śivā who eats, decks, celebrates the world, festival-hurried
