s16-v30.question: Peerless overlordship wins, world-Lord, being subject-free
premises: Peerless overlordship wins, world-Lord, being subject-free
and so does Your otherness, by which this world shines as it does not
s16-v30.inference: Peerless overlordship wins, world-Lord, being subject-free
uncertainties: See C1 BOUNDARY for open questions.

s17-v01.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v01.question: What wins, and why do tears testify?
premises: The sweet worship-festival wins, somehow (aho ko 'pi jayaty eṣa svāduḥ pūjāmahotsavaḥ).
Tears give nectar-taste amply: grief itself turns sacramental.
s17-v01.inference: Victory belongs to worship; even tears prove it by tasting of nectar.
uncertainties: Whether ko 'pi (somehow) marks mystery or understatement is unresolved.

s17-v02.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v02.question: Which acts succeed, and what are devotees?
premises: All acts led by Thy worship grant success (vyāpārāḥ siddhidāḥ sarve ye tvatpūjāpuraḥsarāḥ).
Devotees made of Thee are themselves successes (tvanmayāḥ ... svayaṃ siddhaya eva).
s17-v02.inference: Worship converts acts into siddhis and agents into attainments.

s17-v03.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v03.question: Who are my gods?
premises: Those who worship Thee unceasing, all-formed, in all beings and states at once.
They — not temple images — are called my presiding gods (mamaite 'dhidevatāḥ).
s17-v03.inference: The worshippers are the deities: devotion divinizes the devotee.
uncertainties: Whether adhidevatāḥ ascribes literal divinity to devotees or honorific status is unresolved.

s17-v04.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v04.question: Which worship-rule does he ask for?
premises: The touch-festival, perfected by disregarding meditative effort (dhyānāyāsatiraskārasiddhas).
Famed as the rule of worship; may it be mine always.
s17-v04.inference: He asks not for method but for contact perfected by dropping method.
uncertainties: Where the long compound divides (dhyāna-āyāsa-tiraskāra) is unresolved; the sense — perfection through disregard of effort — is stable.

s17-v05.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v05.question: When is the devotees' moment?
premises: Always: the equinox-moment of equanimity-essence (samatāsāraviṣuvatsamayaḥ sadā).
Ever-worshipping with being-rasa-nectar.
s17-v05.inference: No season but equanimity; worship is the constant climate.

s17-v06.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v06.question: Whose is beginningless, timeless action?
premises: Action without beginning, end, or time-order (yasyānārambhaparyantau na ca kālakramaḥ).
That deed is Thine; its doers resort to Thee alone (kartāras tvajjuṣaḥ param).
s17-v06.inference: Timeless deed belongs to the Lord; agents participate only by resort.
uncertainties: Whether param is adverbial (merely, only) or adjectival (the Supreme) is unresolved.

s17-v07.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v07.question: Who is fortunate?
premises: Even Brahmā and the rest are fortunate (brahmādīnām apīśāste te ca saubhāgyabhāginaḥ).
In whose dream, even delusion, stands Thy worship-festival.
s17-v07.inference: Fortune is measured by worship persisting even into dream and delusion.

s17-v08.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v08.question: What bounds devotees' worship?
premises: Chanting, offering, bathing, meditating — and not only these (na ca kevalam).
Whenever, whatever, however much (yāvad yadā tadā): open correlatives with no apodosis.
s17-v08.inference: Worship exceeds its forms and its occasions alike.
uncertainties: The syntax trails off (correlatives without apodosis); L2 keeps the trailing form deliberately.

s17-v09.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v09.question: Who equals the enjoyers?
premises: Tasting worship-nectar-joy, enjoying (bhavatpūjāsudhāsvādasambhogasukhinaḥ).
Against Indra and the Brahmā-chiefs: who is equal (asti kaḥ samaḥ)?
s17-v09.inference: No god matches the devotee's enjoyment.

s17-v10.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v10.question: What is got at the world-shaking festival?
premises: The festival whose one cause shakes the world (jagatkṣobhaikajanake bhavatpūjāmahotsave).
What is got thereby — only devotees who get it know (bhaktā eva vidanti tat).
s17-v10.inference: The festival's yield is esoteric: known only by getting.

s17-v11.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v11.question: How is He always worshipped?
premises: Standing in Thy abode, consciousness-formed (tvaddhāmni cinmaye sthitvā).
With body-speech-mind acts of all 36 principles — the Trika system total as liturgy.
s17-v11.inference: The whole tattva system becomes the instrument of worship.

s17-v12.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v12.question: How should time pass?
premises: Of me enjoying union with Thy worship (bhavatpūjāmayāsaṅgasambhogasukhino mama).
May all time pass, even endless: this I pray.
s17-v12.inference: Endlessness itself is prayed for — time as the medium of enjoyment.

s17-v13.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v13.question: What should grow and fruit?
premises: Greed for worship-enjoyment-nectar (bhavatpūjāmṛtarasābhogalampaṭatā).
May it grow daily and fruit always for me.
s17-v13.inference: Greed (lampaṭatā), vice elsewhere, is the desired crop.

s17-v14.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v14.question: Where does he sit worshipping?
premises: In Thine ocean, full of world-play-born nectar-one-rasa (jagadvilayasañjātasudhaikarasanirbhare tvadabdhau).
Worshipping Thee, the great self, may I sit always.
s17-v14.inference: The ocean is both place and substance: nectar-water to sit in.

s17-v15.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v15.question: What do devotees offer?
premises: Mind, sweet, in Thy rite (mano nivedyate bhaktaiḥ svādu pūjāvidhau tava).
Ever simple with all desire-knots cut (aśeṣavāsanāgranthivicchedasaralam sadā).
s17-v15.inference: The offering is not a thing but the unknotted mind.

s17-v16.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v16.question: What do the senses send?
premises: Having taken stand on objects, the sense-courses (adhiṣṭhāyaiva viṣayān imāḥ karaṇavṛttayaḥ).
Send the nectar-wine for Thy worship (preṣayanti ... amṛtāsavam).
s17-v16.inference: The senses become couriers: objects the ground, worship-wine the dispatch.
uncertainties: The compound svatpūjārtham is obscure (tvat- for Thy worship?); kept as printed.

s17-v17.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v17.question: What liberates the agitated self-mastered?
premises: Agitated by devotion-heat, self-mastered (bhaktisaṃvegamahoṣmavivaśātmanām).
Nothing but drowning in worship-nectar liberates (ko 'nyo nirvāṇahetuḥ syāt tvatpūjāmṛtamajjanāt).
s17-v17.inference: Drowning is the only liberation: agitation cured by immersion, not by calming.

s17-v18.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v18.question: What should be his sole cause of grace?
premises: The perpetual foot-worship-nectar-drinking festival.
May it be my sole grace-getting cause (tvatprasādaikasamprāptihetur me kalpatām).
s17-v18.inference: One festival, one cause: worship-nectar alone fetches grace.

s17-v19.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v19.question: What is experienced moment by moment?
premises: Experiencing, Lord, moment by moment (anubhūyāsam īśāna pratikarma kṣaṇāt kṣaṇam).
Worship-nectar-drinking-madness-joy-great-joy.
s17-v19.inference: Experience itself is the content: each moment's madness-joy, not its object.

s17-v20.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v20.question: What is the seen point of the great undertaking?
premises: Seen is the point (dṛṣṭartha eva): they taste impossible joy.
The undertaking proves itself in tasting, not in doctrine.
s17-v20.inference: The rite's purpose is visible: impossible joy tasted here, not promised.

s17-v21.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v21.question: What counts as tasted happiness?
premises: Till worship-nectar-taste-festival is got (yāvan na labdhas tvatpūjāsudhāsvādamahotsavaḥ).
I count no drop of fortune's happiness tasted.
s17-v21.inference: All prior happiness is untasted: only worship-nectar counts as tasted.

s17-v22.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v22.question: How is Thy abode's abiding born?
premises: Without sense-seeking strain (viṣayanveṣābhāsāyāsād vinā).
No getting needed: only madness with worship (ayatnasiddhaṃ ... pūjāsu jāyate).
s17-v22.inference: Abiding is effortless-born: strain seeks senses, madness finds abode.

s17-v23.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v23.question: What is ungettable or hard for devotees?
premises: Nothing ungettable, nothing hard (na prāpyam asti ... nāpy eṣām asti durlabham).
They only roam, mad with worship.
s17-v23.inference: Omnipotence by roaming: madness with worship dissolves ungettable and hard.

s17-v24.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v24.question: Which worship-rule is praised?
premises: The devotees' heart-heavy worship-rule (bhaktibharodāracetasām ... pūjāvidhiḥ).
Praised — and unmarked by begging (yo na yācñākalaṃkitaḥ).
s17-v24.inference: The praised rule worships without asking: heart-heavy, begging-free.

s17-v25.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v25.question: What are beauty, joy, fortune, liberation — since He is worshipped?
premises: What beauty is not, what joy not, what fortune not, what liberation not (kā na śobhā na ko hlādaḥ ... ko vā na mokṣaḥ).
This Mahādeva — since He is worshipped (ko 'py eṣa mahādevo yad arcyate).
s17-v25.inference: Worship answers every what: beauty, joy, fortune, freedom are its modes.

s17-v26.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v26.question: What should this body be?
premises: Nourished within by welling bright devotion-nectar (antarullasadacchācchabhaktipīyūṣapoṣitam).
May this body be for Thy worship's use, always devoted.
s17-v26.inference: The body is refitted as worship-thing: fed within, used without.

s17-v27.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v27.question: Dependent yet self-willed — how?
premises: Dependent on enjoying Thy foot-worship (tvatpādapūjāsambhogaparatantraḥ sadā).
May I be the one self-willed in movement, O world-Lord (ekaḥ svacchandaceṣṭitaḥ).
s17-v27.inference: Dependence on worship is self-will: the only freedom that moves freely.

s17-v28.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v28.question: What quenches vision-touch-thirst?
premises: Thirst for seeing, touching, meditating Thee (tvaddhyānadarśanasparśatṛṣi).
Arises the cool sweet great lake of Thy worship (jāyate śītalasvādu bhavatpūjāmahāsaraḥ).
s17-v28.inference: Thirst summons its own lake: worship answers the very thirst it sharpens.

s17-v29.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v29.question: Who is a vessel of worship-enjoyment?
premises: As Thou alone art the world's worship-enjoyment-vessel (yathā tvam eva jagataḥ pūjāsambhogabhājanam).
So is the devotee a vessel of worship-enjoyment.
s17-v29.inference: Vessel mirrors vessel: the devotee holds what the Lord holds.

s17-v30.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v30.question: What wins, and what is agitated?
premises: Victor, Thy festival (ko 'py asau jayati ... bhavatpūjāmahotsavaḥ).
Even the 36 agitated by it — great day (ṣaṭtriṃśato 'pi tattvānāṃ kṣobho yatrollasaty alam).
s17-v30.inference: The festival conquers metaphysics too: even the 36 principles churn with it.

s17-v31.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v31.question: To whom the bow?
premises: To those whose worship-things are themselves worshipped (pūjyāny eva bhavanti tvatpūjopakaraṇāny api).
By devotion-nectar-water (bhaktipīyūṣavāriṇā).
s17-v31.inference: The bow passes through: devotees bowed because their implements are bowed.

s17-v32.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v32.question: Where do devotees rest at worship's start?
premises: At worship's start, meditating mantra-placed selfhood of Thee (dhyātvā mantrādheyāṃ tvadātmatām).
Devotees rest in supreme self, nowhere roaming, with joy.
s17-v32.inference: The start is the arrival: mantra-placed selfhood leaves nowhere to roam.

s17-v33.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v33.question: Who shares out the world?
premises: Kingdoms blooming (rājyalābhādivotphullaiḥ): festival-goers.
The whole world shared out in nectar-wine (sudhāsavena sakalā jagatī saṃvibhajyate).
s17-v33.inference: Festival-goers divide the world as nectar-wine: all is portioned joy.

s17-v34.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v34.question: What are they — gods, freed, or men?
premises: Whose moment-drink is worship-nectar (pūjāmṛtāpānamayo yeṣāṃ bhogaḥ pratikṣaṇam).
Are they gods, freed, or whatever people (kiṃ devā uta muktās te kiṃ vā ke 'py eva te janāḥ)?
s17-v34.inference: The drink dissolves kinds: god, freed, man become one question.

s17-v35.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v35.question: What is theirs — dignity or lightness?
premises: The world's dignity as worship-gear is theirs (pūjopakaraṇībhūtaviśvaveśena gauravam).
Ah, something of devotees — and just lightness (aho kim api bhaktānāṃ kim apy eva ca lāghavam).
s17-v35.inference: Both: cosmic dignity and mere lightness — devotees hold the pair.
uncertainties: Swamiji (Academy, ch17): worship no longer confined to ritual acts — the whole universe felt as the substance of worship itself; this verse is that doctrine in miniature.

s17-v36.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v36.question: What rises from worship's eye-throw agitation?
premises: From worship-made eye-throw agitation, nectar-rising for devotees.
As from the gods' milk-ocean churning (kṣīrajaladhikṣobhād iva divaukasām).
s17-v36.inference: Glances churn nectar as oceans did: the eyes do the gods' old work.

s17-v37.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v37.question: Wish-cow or inward milking?
premises: Some take worship as the wish-cow (dhenuṃ kāmadughām iva).
Others, inward-turned, milk the nectar-stream (sudhādhārādhikarasāṃ dhayanty antarmukhāḥ pare).
s17-v37.inference: Two economies: worship spent outward as wish-cow, drunk inward as nectar-stream.

s17-v38.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v38.question: What do even world-approved glances do?
premises: Even eye-throws, world-approved (akṣavikṣepo 'py eṣa saṃsārasaṃmataḥ).
Bring something within and feed the festival (upanīya kim apy antaḥ puṣṇāty arcāmahotsavam).
s17-v38.inference: No glance is wasted: even worldly looks feed the festival.

s17-v39.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v39.question: What is poverty's top fruit?
premises: By devotion-agitation, worship in self-become-Him (bhaktikṣobhavaśād ... svātmabhūte 'rcanaṃ tvayi).
Wonder: lowliness itself is poverty's top fruit (citraṃ ... dīnatāyāḥ paraṃ phalam) — not despite lowliness but as it.
s17-v39.inference: Lowliness outranks riches: poverty's highest fruit is being low.
uncertainties: Whether dainyāya (for wretchedness?) is dative of purpose or a text knot is unresolved; L2 follows the lowliness-fruit reading.

s17-v40.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v40.question: Step or spread?
premises: For some, rite is the attendance-step to His feet (upacārapadaṃ pūjā ... tvatpadāptaye).
For devotees, it is non-duality-bliss-spread (bhavadaikātmyanirvṛttiprasaras).
s17-v40.inference: Same rite, two grains: a step for some, a spread for devotees.

s17-v41.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v41.question: What gains a foothold in Thee?
premises: Spread by unbound mad devotion to the formless-seeming (apy asambaddharūpārcābhaktyunmādanirargalaiḥ vitanyamānā).
It gains some foothold in Thee (labhate pratiṣṭhāṃ tvayi kām api).
s17-v41.inference: Even unbound madness, spread wide, finds footing in Thee.

s17-v42.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v42.question: Who is worship's vessel, they say?
premises: Mind stunned by tasting sweet devotion-rasa-taste.
He alone as worship's vessel, they say (śambho tvam eva ... pūjānāṃ kila bhājanam).
s17-v42.inference: The stunned mind testifies: He alone holds worship.

s17-v43.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v43.question: What means does he ask for?
premises: Full, pure, steady, devoted means for His worship (paripūrṇāni śuddhāni bhaktimanti sthirāṇi ca ... sādhanāni).
May they be mine, Lord.
s17-v43.inference: He asks means, not ends: full pure steady devoted instruments.

s17-v44.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v44.question: What fortune blooms in the worship-treasure?
premises: In the whole worship-treasure, in Thy worship-rite (aśeṣapūjāsatkośe tvatpūjākarmaṇi).
What fortune of the organ-host blooms (aho karaṇavṛndasya kāpi lakṣmīr vijṛmbhate).
s17-v44.inference: The senses have a fortune too, blooming inside the rite.

s17-v45.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v45.question: Whose is this prettiness?
premises: This prettiness is seen to be Thine alone (eṣā peśalimā ... tavaiva kila dṛśyate).
Though Lord of all, worshipped by servants — and found (viśveśvaro 'pi bhṛtyair yad arcyase yaś ca labhyase).
s17-v45.inference: Prettiness belongs to Thee yet is found through servants' worship: lowly means, divine quality.

s17-v46.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v46.question: Whence should the festival rise?
premises: From formed or formless, being or non-being (sadāmurttād amūrttādvā bhāvād yad vāpy abhāvataḥ).
May my festival of the praised rise (uttheyān me ... bhavatpūjāmahotsavaḥ).
s17-v46.inference: No source disqualified: from form or void, being or not, let festival rise.

s17-v47.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)
s17-v47.question: Whom does He bow to, and with what is He pleased?
premises: Who always worship with lust, anger, pride made offering (kāmakrodhābhimānais tvām upaharīkṛtaiḥ sadā ye 'rcayanti).
Bow to them; of them I am pleased, in truth (namas tebhyas teṣāṃ tuṣṭo 'smi tattvataḥ).
s17-v47.inference: Even the poisons, offered, qualify: He bows to those who weaponize lust itself.

s17-v48.speaker: Utpaladeva (devotee's voice)

premises: Victor, Thy festival of devotees' supreme rule (jayaty eṣa bhavadbhaktibhājāṃ pūjāvidhiḥ paraḥ).
Though made with straw, yet furnished with jewels (yas tṛṇaiḥ kriyamāṇo 'pi ratnair evopakalpate).
s17-v48.inference: Straw work, jewel furniture: poverty of means, riches of rite.

s01-v01.plain_english: Of one who neither meditates nor chants, manifestation may come without any preparatory rule. Just so — O light of Śiva — we bow to him who possesses devotion.
s01-v01.sanskrit_cite: na dhyāyato na japataḥ syād yasyāvidhipūrvakam | evam eva śivabhāsas taṃ numo bhaktiśālinam

s01-v02.plain_english: My self stays young, drinking the nectar of Your devotion — though greyed as if with the dust of worldly journeying and its passions.
s01-v02.sanskrit_cite: ātmā mama bhavadbhaktisudhāpānayuvāpi san | lokayātrārajorāgāt palitair iva dhūsaraḥ

s01-v03.plain_english: For those who have gained that wealth — the possessors of devotion dwelling in Your city — even movement along worldly paths happens by that very expansion.
s01-v03.sanskrit_cite: labdhatatsaṃpadāṃ bhaktimatāṃ tvatpuravāsinām | saṃcāro lokamārge 'pi syāt tayaiva vijṛmbhayā

s01-v04.plain_english: Lord — where the whole world within worlds directly consists of You, what is not the devotee's field, and whose mantra does not succeed?
s01-v04.sanskrit_cite: sākṣādbhavanmaye nātha sarvasmin bhuvanāntare | kiṃ na bhaktimatāṃ kṣetram mantraḥ kvaiṣām na siddhyati

s01-v05.plain_english: Victory to those intoxicated with the finest wine of devotion's nectar-essence! Though non-dual, they are ever Your second, O Lord.
s01-v05.sanskrit_cite: jayanti bhaktipīyūṣarasāsavavaronmadāḥ | advitīyā api sadā tvaddvitīyā api prabho

s01-v06.plain_english: Lord of the ocean of endless bliss — only they know Your truth who are densely drenched in blissful devotion's nectar.
s01-v06.sanskrit_cite: anantānandasindhos te nātha tattvaṃ vidanti te | tādṛśa eva ye sāndrabhaktyānandarasāplutāḥ

s01-v07.plain_english: You alone, Lord of the self, are the nature of all, and all loves dwelling in the self. Knowing Your devotion as self-established, may a person conquer.
s01-v07.sanskrit_cite: tvam evātmeśa sarvasya sarvaś cātmani rāgavān | iti svabhāvasiddhāṃs tvadbhaktiṃ jānañ jayej janaḥ

s01-v08.plain_english: Lord — when the knowable is destroyed, by whom are You not seen, standing alone? Even amid the agitation of knower and knowable, You are easily seen by devotees.
s01-v08.sanskrit_cite: nātha vedyakṣaye kena na dṛśyo 'syekakaḥ sthitaḥ | vedyavedakasaṃkṣobhe 'py asi bhaktaiḥ sudarśanaḥ

s01-v09.plain_english: As the lake of endless bliss, the Goddess, the beloved, is inseparable from You — so may one devotion of mine be inseparable.
s01-v09.sanskrit_cite: anantānandasarasī devī priyatamā yathā | aviyuktāsti te tadvad ekā tvadbhaktir astu me

s01-v10.plain_english: O All-pervading — for devotees of devotion, everything is a cause of gaining You. This path of consciousness stands threefold — in joy, in suffering, in delusion.
s01-v10.sanskrit_cite: sarva eva bhavallābhahetur bhaktimatāṃ vibho | saṃvinmārgo 'yam āhlādaduḥkhamohais tridhā sthitaḥ

s01-v11.plain_english: What of knowledge — even its supreme state, from tasting Your devotion's nectar — is to me, O Lord, like vinegar-sourness after wine.
s01-v11.sanskrit_cite: bhavadbhaktyamṛtāsvādād bodhasya syāt parāpi yā | daśā sā māṃ prati svāmin nāsavasyeva śuktatā

s01-v12.plain_english: Those to whom the great knowledge of Your devotion has come through practice — they alone know truth, both knowledge and its absence.
s01-v12.sanskrit_cite: bhavadbhaktimahāvidyā yeṣām abhyāsam āgatā | vidyāvidyobhayasyāpi tā ete tattvavedinaḥ

s01-v13.plain_english: From the root, this creeper of speech, unfolding in due sequence — watered by the nectar of Your devotion, may it bear rasa-rich fruit for me.
s01-v13.sanskrit_cite: āmulād vāglatā seyaṃ kramavisphāraśālinī | tvadbhaktisudhayā siktā tadrasāḍhyaphalāstu me

s01-v14.plain_english: "Having become Śiva, let him worship" — so the devotee is said to have become. For You alone are the body's essence, purified by devotees through non-duality.
s01-v14.sanskrit_cite: śivo bhūtvā yajeteti bhakto bhūtveti kathyate | tvam eva hi vapuḥ sāraṃ bhaktair advayaśodhitam

s01-v15.plain_english: For devotees, what is not a means to accomplishment of non-duality with You? And for the low, what obstructions could there be to its failure?
s01-v15.sanskrit_cite: bhaktānāṃ bhavadadvaitasiddhyai kā nopapattayaḥ | tadasiddhyai nikṛṣṭānāṃ kāni nāvaraṇāni vā

s01-v16.plain_english: That You are attained sometime, somewhere, by yoga, O Lord — that is the deceit. Otherwise, how would You shine in all states for the possessors of devotion?
s01-v16.sanskrit_cite: kadācit kvāpi labhyo 'si yogenetīśa vañcanā | anyathā sarvakakṣyāsu bhāsi bhaktimatāṃ katham

s01-v17.plain_english: Untouched by withdrawal and the rest — this is the great distinction: that sharers of devotion stay composed even in emergence, beyond the yogins.
s01-v17.sanskrit_cite: pratyāhārādyasaṃspṛṣṭo viśeṣo 'sti mahānayam | yogibhyo bhaktibhājām yad vyutthāne 'pi samāhitāḥ

s01-v18.plain_english: No yoga is enjoined, no austerity, no procedure of worship at all. On this guileless path of Śiva, devotion alone is praised.
s01-v18.sanskrit_cite: na yogo na tapo nārcākramaḥ ko 'pi pranīyate | amāye śivamārge 'smin bhaktir ekā praśasyate

s01-v19.plain_english: My covering shattered by devotion's light shining from all sides — may even my thoughts, which face all real things, perish.
s01-v19.sanskrit_cite: sarvato vilasadbhaktitejodhvastāvṛter mama | pratyakṣasarvabhāvasya cintānām api naśyatu

s01-v20.plain_english: A wonder: that in devotees, with the single word "Śiva" standing always on the tongue's tip, there is the taste of every sense-object.
s01-v20.sanskrit_cite: śiva ity ekaśabdasya jihvāgre tiṣṭhataḥ sadā | samastaviṣayāsvādo bhakteṣv evāsti ko 'py aho

s01-v21.plain_english: In the calm-waved, cool, clear, sweet milk-ocean of devotion's nectar — in tasting its unworldly essence — who that stands firm there is counted low?

s01-v22.plain_english: Why would people like me not chew Your devotion's great medicine — whose after-taste, O Lord, is called liberation?
s01-v22.sanskrit_cite: sādṛśaiḥ kiṃ na carvyeta bhavadbhaktimahauṣadhiḥ | tādṛśī bhagavan yasyā mokṣākhyo 'nantaro rasaḥ

s01-v23.plain_english: Those alone are ultimately wealth, O Lord, in the judgement of the good — which nourish confident enjoyment of the taste of devotion to You.
s01-v23.sanskrit_cite: tā eva paramarthyante sampadaḥ sadbhir īśa yāḥ | tvad bhaktirasasambhogavisrambhaparipoṣikāḥ

s01-v24.plain_english: They have grasped something of Your devotion-nectar's essence who, though fallen into this mud of passion and the rest, are not smeared by it.
s01-v24.sanskrit_cite: bhavadbhaktisudhāsāras taiḥ kim apy upalakṣitaḥ | ye na rāgādi paṅke 'smiṃḷ lipyante patitā api

s01-v25.plain_english: From supernormal powers to liberation — fruit is named as a mere limb of the ripened creeper of Your devotion, for some.
s01-v25.sanskrit_cite: aṇimādiṣu mokṣānteṣv aṅgeṣv eva phalābhidhā | bhavadbhakter vipakvāyā latāyā iva keṣu cit

s01-v26.plain_english: A wonder, Lord: this mind, by nature pain's seed — watered by the essence of devotion to You, becomes liberation's great fruit.
s01-v26.sanskrit_cite: citraṃ nisargato nātha duḥkhabījam idaṃ manaḥ | tvadbhaktirasasaṃsiktam niḥśreyasamahāphalam

s02-v01.plain_english: To the many-formed, whose nature is consciousness — fire, moon, sun, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, moving and unmoving — bow.
s02-v01.sanskrit_cite: agnīṣomaravibrahmaviṣṇusthāvarajaṅgama | svarūpa bahurūpāya namaḥ saṃvinmayāya te

s02-v02.plain_english: To the great fire fed by the universe as fuel, smeared-pure with great ash, to the Becoming to whom the world is the sole oblation — bow.

s02-v03.plain_english: To Śiva-fire — cool, dense with supreme nectar — and to You, the unequalled devourer in the world's destruction — bow.
s02-v03.sanskrit_cite: paramāmṛtasāndrāya śītalāya śivāgnaye | kasmai cid viśvasaṃploṣaviṣamāya namo 'stu te

s02-v04.plain_english: To Mahādeva, to Rudra, to Śaṅkara, to Śiva, to You Maheśvara — and to someone mantra-bodied — bow.
s02-v04.sanskrit_cite: mahādevāya rudrāya śaṅkarāya śivāya te | maheśvarāyāpi namaḥ kasmai cin mantramūrtaye

s02-v05.plain_english: To Śiva-fire — cut, dried up, the three worlds' melted fat the oblation — unequalled, yet auspicious — bow.

s02-v06.plain_english: To the god — to gracious someone — for whom the meeting of all marks is itself the mark — bow.
s02-v06.sanskrit_cite: samastalakṣanāyoga eva yasyopalakṣaṇam | tasmai namo 'stu devāya kasmai cid api śambhave

s02-v07.plain_english: To the hidden Lord — Veda-and-Āgama-opposing, Veda-and-Āgama-making, their true essence, secret master — bow.
s02-v07.sanskrit_cite: vedāgamaviruddhāya vedāgamavidhāyine | vedāgamasatattvāya guhyāya svāmine namaḥ

s02-v08.plain_english: Sole cause of the wheel of births and deaths — and its sole opponent; saṃsāra-formed, saṃsāra-free — to gracious Śambhu, bow.
s02-v08.sanskrit_cite: saṃsāraikanimittāya saṃsāraikavirodhine | namaḥ samsārarūpāya niḥsaṃsārāya śambhave

s02-v09.plain_english: To root, to middle, to tip; embodied as root-middle-tip; with tip-middle-root exhausted — to the Full, gracious Śambhu — bow.
s02-v09.sanskrit_cite: mūlāya madhyāyāgrāya mūlamadhyāgramūrtaye | kṣīnāgramadhyamūlāya namaḥ pūrṇāya śambhave

s02-v10.plain_english: Even once — whosever taking of the Name — ripened heaps of merit. To You, Śiva, hard to attain — bow.
s02-v10.sanskrit_cite: namaḥ sukṛtasaṃbharavipākaḥ sakṛd apy asau | yasya nāmagrahas tasmai durlabhāya śivāya te

s02-v11.plain_english: To You alone — consciousness-formed, skull-bearing — ever sporting with heaped multitudes of moving-and-static forms — bow.
s02-v11.sanskrit_cite: namaścarācarākāraparetanicayaiḥ sadā | krīḍate tubhyam ekasmai cinmayāya kapāline

s02-v12.plain_english: To the magician, the pure, the hidden, the self-manifest; the subtle, the all-formed — to wondrous Śambhu — bow.
s02-v12.sanskrit_cite: māyāvine viśuddhāya guhyāya prakaṭātmane | sūkṣmāya viśvarūpāya namaś citrāya śambhave

s02-v13.plain_english: To all power — whose play destroys the world arrayed by Brahmā, Indra, Viṣṇu — wonder-working — bow.

s02-v14.plain_english: To You, the fathomless Hara-ocean — whose powers are gained by those wandering only its shores — bow.
s02-v14.sanskrit_cite: taṭeṣv eva paribhrāntaiḥ labdhās tās tā vibhūtayaḥ | yasya tasmai namas tubhyam agādhaharasindhave

s02-v15.plain_english: To the lovely hundred-petalled Śambhu-lotus, dwelling mid mud of the Māyā-made dense world, unsmeared, shining — bow.

s02-v16.plain_english: Auspicious, pure, treasure, self-ornamented; dear, ultimate-real, highest — to You — bow.
s02-v16.sanskrit_cite: maṅgalāya pavitrāya nidhaye bhūṣaṇātmane | priyāya paramārthāya sarvotkṛṣṭāya te namaḥ

s02-v17.plain_english: Ever bound, ever sharing liberation's portion; difference-free — to gracious someone Śambhu — bow.
s02-v17.sanskrit_cite: namaḥ satatabaddhāya nityanirmuktibhāgine | bandhamokṣavihīnāya kasmai ci d api śambhave

s02-v18.plain_english: In these three worlds whose essence is mockery alone — to You alone, secondless, ever-bliss-seated — bow.
s02-v18.sanskrit_cite: upahāsaikasāre 'sminn etāvati jagattraye | tubhyam evādvitīyāya namo nityasukhāsine

s02-v19.plain_english: Essence of right-observance yet desirer of left-observance; of all observances, to observance-free Śarva — bow.
s02-v19.sanskrit_cite: dakṣiṇācārasārāya vāmācārābhilāṣiṇe | sarvācārāya śarvāya nirācārāya te namaḥ

s02-v20.plain_english: Whoever is worshipped, however, wherever — and whoever, whatever god he be — to that god, bow.
s02-v20.sanskrit_cite: yathā tathāpi yaḥ pūjyo yatra tatrāpi yo 'rcitaḥ | yo 'pi vā so 'pi vā yo 'sau devas tasmai namo 'stu te

s02-v21.plain_english: Served by liberation-seekers, remover of all burning; of spread-out chosen loveliness — to You, boon-giver — bow.
s02-v21.sanskrit_cite: mumukṣujanasevyāya sarvasantāpahāriṇe | namo vitatalāvaṇyavarāya varadāya te

s02-v22.plain_english: To You, Lord of the ever-festival, whose three worlds brim with unbroken bliss-rasa — bow.
s02-v22.sanskrit_cite: sadā nirantarānandarasanirbharitākhila- | trilokāya namas tubhyaṃ svāmine nityaparvaṇe

s02-v23.plain_english: Whatever enjoys You through pleasure-first knowables — to that terrible host of Your powers — bow.
s02-v23.sanskrit_cite: sukhapradhānasaṃvedyasambhogair bhajate ca yat | tvām eva tasmai ghorāya śaktivṛndāya te namaḥ

s02-v24.plain_english: Even sages cannot know Him — yet those whose gestures love connects embrace Him. To that someone Becoming — bow.
s02-v24.sanskrit_cite: munīnām apy avijñeyaṃ bhaktisambandhaceṣṭitāḥ | āliṅganty api yaṃ tasmai kasmai cid bhavate namaḥ

s02-v25.plain_english: To the supreme-nectar sheath, the supreme-nectar heap; reachable beyond far and near — to Becoming — bow.

s02-v26.plain_english: I praise Your mantra-formed, clear-cool, unprecedentedly joyful, supreme-nectar-juicy form.
s02-v26.sanskrit_cite: mahāmantramayaṃ naumi rūpaṃ te svacchaśītalam | apūrvamodasubhagaṃ parāmṛtarasolvaṇam

s02-v27.plain_english: On oneness-fame's great cloth, full of immortality-nectar — where, Lord, there is no wonder — I praise Your teaching.
s02-v27.sanskrit_cite: svātantryāmṛtapūrṇatvad aikyakhyātimahāpaṭe | citraṃ nāsty eva yatreśa tan naumi tava śāsanam

s02-v28.plain_english: Thunderbolt to all doubt, world-end fire to all misfortune, world's-end to all joylessness — we bow the Māheśvara path.
s02-v28.sanskrit_cite: sarvāśaṅkāsaniṃ sarvālakṣmīkālānalaṃ tathā | sarvāmaṅgalyakalpāntaṃ mārgaṃ māheśvaraṃ numaḥ

s02-v29.plain_english: Victory, god! Bow upon bow to You; this whole world rests on You; of worlds You are supreme Lord; I am come to You for refuge, the One supreme.
s02-v29.sanskrit_cite: jaya deva namo namo 'stu te sakalaṃ viśvam idaṃ tavāśritam | jagatāṃ parameśvaro bhavān paramekaḥ śaraṇāgato 'smi te

s03-v01.plain_english: Of things, the two courses that go by being and non-being — leaping over them — to the third, the wondrous Śambhu — bow.
s03-v01.sanskrit_cite: sadasattvena bhāvānāṃ yuktā yā dvitayī gatiḥ | tām ullaṅghya tṛtīyasmai namaś citrāya śambhave

s03-v02.plain_english: Among gods, seers, and men in this unfree triple world — free are Your dependents, O Free One.
s03-v02.sanskrit_cite: āsurarṣijanād asminn asvatantre jagattraye | svatantrās te svatantrasya ye tavaivānujīvinaḥ

s03-v03.plain_english: Remembrance of Your body inlaid with the whole universe — the one medicine for world-pain; who have it sit happy.
s03-v03.sanskrit_cite: aśeṣaviśvakhacitabhavadvapur anusmṛtiḥ | yeṣām bhavarujām ekaṃ bheṣajaṃ te sukhāsinaḥ

s03-v04.plain_english: Whose white umbrella is the self-lit moon, whose fly-whisk the heaven-river's stream — He alone is Supreme Lord.
s03-v04.sanskrit_cite: sitātapatraṃ yasyenduḥ svaprabhāparipūritaḥ | cāmaraṃ svardhunīsrotaḥ sa ekaḥ parameśvaraḥ

s03-v05.plain_english: Grant me, Lord, a glance — luminous, cool, one, pure as a moon-digit, carrying nectar.
s03-v05.sanskrit_cite: prakāśāṃ śītalām ekāṃ śuddhāṃ śaśikalām iva | dṛśaṃ vitara me nātha kām apy amṛtavāhinīm

s03-v06.plain_english: Fallen from Your consciousness-bliss ocean — these knowings, these drops — why are they not nectar-sweet-beautiful to me, Lord?
s03-v06.sanskrit_cite: tvaccidānandajaladheś cyutāḥ saṃvittivipruṣaḥ | imāḥ kathaṃ me bhagavan nāmṛtāsvādasundarāḥ

s03-v07.plain_english: In Your love-rasa, Lord, hearts unmelted — the heartless alone — such deserve contempt.
s03-v07.sanskrit_cite: tvayi rāgarase nātha na magnaṃ hṛdayaṃ prabho | yeṣām ahṛdayā eva te 'vajñaspadam īdṛśāḥ

s03-v08.plain_english: Whose heart has met the Lord's — he alone is the vessel of ruling goddesses' powers.
s03-v08.sanskrit_cite: prabhuṇā bhavatā yasya jātaṃ hṛdayamelanam | prābhavīṇāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ paramekaḥ sa bhājanam

s03-v09.plain_english: Flooder alike of all joys and sorrows — Your meditation-nectar-flood, like lowlands filling.
s03-v09.sanskrit_cite: harṣāṇām atha śokānāṃ sarveṣāṃ plāvakaḥ samam | bhavaddhyānāmṛtāpūro nimnāṇimnabhuvām iva

s03-v10.plain_english: What would their look not be, happiness-provisions-full — who never part from You, more than self, Lord?
s03-v10.sanskrit_cite: keva na syād dṛśā teṣāṃ sukhasambhāranirbharā | yeṣām ātmādhikeneśa na kvāpi virahas tvayā

s03-v11.plain_english: I roar, I dance — my wishes are fulfilled, for my Lord is won, utterly charming.
s03-v11.sanskrit_cite: garjāmi bata nṛtyāmi pūrṇā mama manorathāḥ | svāmī mamaiṣa ghaṭito yat tvam atyantarocanaḥ

s03-v12.plain_english: Where no other knowable for action, no other yoga for knowing — yet what if knowledge? Consciousness alone, world-filled-one, expands.
s03-v12.sanskrit_cite: nānyad vedyaṃ kriyā yatra nānyo yogo vidā ca yat | jñānaṃ syāt kiṃ tu viśvaikapūrṇā cittvaṃ vijṛmbhate

s03-v13.plain_english: Suddenly fled from them — hard, endless sorrows — whose speech forever holds the Śiva-sound.
s03-v13.sanskrit_cite: durjayānām anantānām duḥkhānāṃ sahasaiva te | hastāt palāyitā yeṣāṃ vāci śaśvacchivadhvaniḥ

s03-v14.plain_english: Is there another, higher person, distinct by remaining Yours? You alone, great Person, support of all persons without remainder.
s03-v14.sanskrit_cite: uttamaḥ puruṣo 'nyo 'sti yuṣmaccheṣaviśeṣitaḥ | tvaṃ mahāpuruṣas tv eko niḥśeṣapuruṣāśrayaḥ

s03-v15.plain_english: Victorious, world-venerable, Your slaves, Lord — for whom this saṃsāra-ocean is a play-great-lake.
s03-v15.sanskrit_cite: jayanti te jagadvandyā dāsās te jagatāṃ vibho | saṃsārārṇava evaiṣa yeṣāṃ krīḍāmahāsaraḥ

s03-v16.plain_english: Let other miseries sit — for Your devotees, "You manifest Yourself" — by this alone they are shamed.
s03-v16.sanskrit_cite: āsatāṃ tāvad anyāni dainyānīha bhavajjuṣām | tvam eva prakaṭībhūyā ity anenaiva lajjyate

s03-v17.plain_english: "Nothing is beyond me" — yet therein I am a reciter, by that oneness; as truth, You point the rosary somewhere.
s03-v17.sanskrit_cite: matparaṃ nāsti tatrāpi jāpako 'smi tadaikyataḥ | tattvena japa ity akṣamālayā diśasi kvacit

s03-v18.plain_english: From being must come supreme being, and beyond that, Lord — and You are other than being and non-being both; hence You are being-non-being-formed.
s03-v18.sanskrit_cite: sato 'vaśyaṃ paramasat sac ca tasmāt paraṃ prabho | tvaṃ cāsataḥ sataś cānyas tenāsi sadasanmayaḥ

s03-v19.plain_english: Purer-shining than thousand-sun-ray-rise — yet You, all-worlds-pervading, are not seen.
s03-v19.sanskrit_cite: sahasrasūryakiraṇādhikaśuddhaprakāśavān | api tvaṃ sarvabhuvanavyāpako 'pi na dṛśyase

s03-v20.plain_english: Conscious-formed in the inert world, knower even in the known; great in the measured — hence You are the highest.
s03-v20.sanskrit_cite: jaḍe jagati cidrūpaḥ kila vedye 'pi vedakaḥ | vibhur mite ca yenāsi tena sarvottamo bhavān

s03-v21.plain_english: Enough with other cries — this alone, before the Lord: I cry sharp, Lord, I am bewildered, even knowing thus.
s03-v21.sanskrit_cite: alam ākranditair anyair iyad eva puraḥ prabhoḥ | tīvraṃ viraumi yan nātha muhyāmy evaṃ vidann api

s04-v01.plain_english: Mind — though fickle you are — even so you are praised, since you worship the refuge of refuges, the world's teacher, Ambikā's husband.
s04-v01.sanskrit_cite: capalam asi yad api mānasa tatrāpi ślāghyase yato bhajase | śaraṇānām api śaraṇaṃ tribhuvanagurum ambikākāntam

s04-v02.plain_english: Having crossed the ladder-steps of the many gods and resorted to Śiva's feet — yet a lower ground I do not quit even now. Strange.
s04-v02.sanskrit_cite: ullaṅghya vividhadaivatasopānakramam upeya śivacaraṇān | āśrityāpy adharatarāṃ bhūmiṃ nādyāpi citram ujjhāmi

s04-v03.plain_english: Reveal Your own path, hide all world-ways thoroughly — while I am, Lord, quickly Your ever-risen servant.
s04-v03.sanskrit_cite: prakaṭaya nijam adhvānaṃ sthagayatarām akhilalokacaritāni | yāvad bhavāmi bhagavaṃs tava sapadi sadodito dāsaḥ

s04-v04.plain_english: Śiva Śiva Śambhu Śaṅkara — swift pity on the refuge-seekers' lover! Fortune is near for whoever remembers Your lotus-feet-pair.
s04-v04.sanskrit_cite: śiva śiva śambho śaṅkara śaraṇāgatavatsalāśu kuru karuṇām | tava caraṇakamalayugalasmaraṇaparasya hi sampado 'dūre

s04-v05.plain_english: Those seated on Your foot-lotus-throne, making the world to taste — they laugh at Viriñci, office-stained, not-self-ruled.
s04-v05.sanskrit_cite: tāvakāṅghrikamalāsanalīnā ye yathāruci jagad racayanti | te viriñcim adhikāramalenāliptam asvavaśam īśa hasanti

s04-v06.plain_english: Nothing appears apart from Your light-body; so You are always already gained, Lord — though far by nature.
s04-v06.sanskrit_cite: tvatprakāśavapuṣo na vibhinnaṃ kiṃ cana prabhavati pratibhātum | tat sadaiva bhagavan parilabdho 'sīśvara prakṛtito 'pi vidūraḥ

s04-v07.plain_english: Some taste Your foot-lotus-juice as stale-difference-conduct; others instantly taste it as flawless, body-whole, duality-free.
s04-v07.sanskrit_cite: pādapaṅkajarasaṃ tava ke cid bhedaparyuṣitavṛttim upetāḥ | ke canāpi rasayanti tu sadhyo bhātam akṣatavapur dvayaśūnyam

s04-v08.plain_english: Lord, like lightning at dawn gleams my nectar-smeared — if it stayed steadier, You are worshipped duly — what else?
s04-v08.sanskrit_cite: nātha vidyud iva bhāti vibhāte yā kadā cana mamāmṛtadigdhā | sā yadi sthirataraiva bhavet tat pūjito 'si vidhivat kim utānyat

s04-v09.plain_english: Is there anything, thing or non-thing, apart from this? With great discernment decided here: as You are, so be plain to me.
s04-v09.sanskrit_cite: sarvam asyaparam asti na kiṃ cid vastv avastu yadi veti mahatyā | prajñāya vyavasito 'tra yathaiva tvaṃ tathaiva bhava suprakaṭo me

s04-v10.plain_english: By Your will alone, Lord, I was made to step on Your own path — then why do I behave just like a man, knowing nothing fit for Your feet?
s04-v10.sanskrit_cite: svecchayaiva bhagavan nijamārge kāritaḥ padam ahaṃ prabhunaiva | tat kathaṃ janavad eva carāmi tvatpadocitam avaimi na kiṃ cit

s04-v11.plain_english: Some god of Yours blooms in their hearts, a lovely supreme state — by whose story-thunder-cātakas they are long gladdened.
s04-v11.sanskrit_cite: ko 'pi deva hṛdi teṣu tāvako jṛmbhate subhagabhāva uttamaḥ | tvatkathāmbudaninādacātakā yena te 'pi subhagīkṛtāś ciram

s04-v12.plain_english: For Your devotees, by some play in You, this love has grown fat — so that separation-ground talk and memory fruit in union-festival.
s04-v12.sanskrit_cite: tvajjuṣāṃ tvayi kayāpi līlayā rāga eṣa paripoṣam āgataḥ | yad viyogabhuvi saṅkathā tathā saṃsmṛtiḥ phalati saṃgamotsavam

s04-v13.plain_english: The word, grown by strange-rasa-sprinkling, though uttered "Śaṅkara" hundreds of times — enters even sideways hearts, ever-fresh in purpose.
s04-v13.sanskrit_cite: yo vicitrarasasekavardhitaḥ śaṅkareti śataśo 'py udīritaḥ | śabda āviśati tiryagāśayeṣv apy ayaṃ navanavaprayojanaḥ

s04-v14.plain_english: Victorious are they on whose face-orbits the Śiva-sound ever revolves — which, moon-spread from nectar-source, trickles supreme nectar, sweet.
s04-v14.sanskrit_cite: te jayanti mukhamaṇḍale bhraman asti yeṣu niyataṃ śivadhvaniḥ | yaḥ śāśīva prasṛto 'mṛtāśayāt svādu saṃsravati cāmṛtaṃ param

s04-v15.plain_english: The fierce world as if finished; mind's impurity thinned to none — and yet not even the smallest knocking at Your city-door-bolt.
s04-v15.sanskrit_cite: parisamāptam ivogram idaṃ jagad vigalito 'viralo manaso malaḥ | tad api nāsti bhavatpurārgalakavāṭavighaṭṭanam aṇva pi

s04-v16.plain_english: Of minds eager for Your ever-blooming face-lotus-belly-gaze — do something, Lord, just a little, so You flash as facing me.
s04-v16.sanskrit_cite: satataphullabhavanmukhapaṅkajodaravilokanalālasacetasaḥ | kim api tat kuru nātha manāg iva sphurasi yena mamābhimukhasthitiḥ

s04-v17.plain_english: What happiness here apart from non-difference-mind, what other glory? So why does this servant's mind, abandoning her, go the wrong way?
s04-v17.sanskrit_cite: tvadavibhedamater aparaṃ nu kiṃ sukham ihāsti vibhūtir athāparā | tad iha tāvakadāsajanasya kiṃ kupatham eti manaḥ parihṛtya tām

s04-v18.plain_english: May I never for a moment be unfit for Your serfdom — unless constantly, reverently tasting non-difference-wine.
s04-v18.sanskrit_cite: kṣaṇam apīha na tāvakadāsatāṃ prati bhaveyam ahaṃ kila bhājanam | bhavadabhedarasāsavam ādarād avirataṃ rasayeyam ahaṃ na cet

s04-v19.plain_english: These people truly do not see Your body, dirtied by duality-sight — and yet, all-knowing refuge-lover, do You not hear MY cry?
s04-v19.sanskrit_cite: na kila paśyati satyam ayaṃ janas tava vapur dvayadṛṣṭimalīmasaḥ | tad api sarvavidāśritavatsalaḥ kim idam āraṭitaṃ na śṛṇoṣi me

s04-v20.plain_english: Do You remember, Lord, any desired sense-pleasure I ever asked? Give instead, always, Your body-vision-nectar as the only wish.
s04-v20.sanskrit_cite: smarasi nātha kadācid apīhitaṃ viṣayasaukhyam athāpi mayārthitam | satatam eva bhavadvapurīkṣaṇāmṛtamabhīṣṭamalaṃ mama dehi tat

s04-v21.plain_english: Since by Your will alone I stepped on Your Śiva-path, Lord — hundreds of good omens rose for me; what else should I seek from You?
s04-v21.sanskrit_cite: kila yadaiva śivādhvani tāvake kṛtapado 'smi maheśa tavecchayā | śubhaśatānyuditāni tadaiva me kim aparaṃ mṛgaye bhavataḥ prabho

s04-v22.plain_english: Where the sun sets with the moon and all — that unconquered Śiva-night shines, self-light-spread-lustrous.
s04-v22.sanskrit_cite: yatra so 'stam ayam eti vivasvāṃś candramaḥ prabhṛtibhiḥ saha sarvaiḥ | kāpi sā vijayate śivarātriḥ svaprabhāprasarabhāsvararūpā

s04-v23.plain_english: Even won rule in three worlds, O king of gods, I count tasteless — lacking Your foot-touch-nectar-rasa.
s04-v23.sanskrit_cite: apy upārjitam ahaṃ triṣu lokeṣv adhipatyam amareśvara manye | nīrasaṃ tad akhilaṃ bhavadaṅghrisparśanāmṛtarasena vihīnam

s04-v24.plain_english: Alas, Lord, strong is this self-bond, made of non-recognition of You, fashioned by You alone — first ignored by me, it never loosens a bit.
s04-v24.sanskrit_cite: bata nātha dṛḍho 'yam ātmabandho bhavadakhyātimayas tvayaiva kḷptaḥ | yad ayaṃ prathamānam eva me tvām avadhīrya ślathate na leśato 'pi

s04-v25.plain_english: Though worshipped by the great, O king of gods, You ever stay the one-worshipper-form — seen outside and in, You shine in the seers' bodies forever.
s04-v25.sanskrit_cite: mahatām amareśa pūjyamāno 'py aniśaṃ tiṣṭhasi pūjakaikarūpaḥ | bahirantarapīha dṛśyamānaḥ sphurasi draṣṭṛśarīra eva śaśvat

s05-v01.plain_english: Joined in enjoyment by mere touch-contact of Your lotus-feet — bring me, Lord, by the neck into Your house.

s05-v02.plain_english: Head hair dyed by Your foot-lotus-dust-redness — when shall I frantically begin to dance?

s05-v03.plain_english: You, sole Lord — this alone I always ask: dwelling inside You, may I be silent; not otherwise, O Wise One.
s05-v03.sanskrit_cite: tvad ekanātho bhagavann iyad evārthaye sadā | tvadantarvasatir mūko bhaveyaṃ mānyathā budhaḥ

s05-v04.plain_english: Ah nectar-ocean master! Ah sweet three-eyed One! Ah tasty deformed-eyed One! — thus may I dance, shouting.
s05-v04.sanskrit_cite: aho sudhānidhe svāminn aho mṛṣṭa trilocana | aho svādo virūpakṣety eva nṛtyeyam āraṭan

s05-v05.plain_english: Eyes half-closed by Your foot-lotus-touch — may I expand, reeling drunk on Your devotion-liquor-madness.

s05-v06.plain_english: May I dwell anywhere, O All-pervading, mind-mountain on earth, where that practice is — uninterrupted, great-rasa, made of Your prattle.
s05-v06.sanskrit_cite: cittabhūbhṛd bhuvi vibho vaseyaṃ kvāpi yatra sā | nirantaratvatpralāpamayī vṛttir mahārasā

s05-v07.plain_english: Where You stand with the Goddess, many-formed, from palace to gate-tower — in that city may I dwell.
s05-v07.sanskrit_cite: yatra devīsametas tvam āsaudhādā ca gopurāt | bahurūpaḥ sthitas tasmin vāstavyaḥ syām ahaṃ pure

s05-v08.plain_english: May Your sun-rays rejoice, Lord, until my heart-lotus blooms — for Your worship.
s05-v08.sanskrit_cite: samullasantu bhagavan bhavadbhānumarīcayaḥ | vikasatveṣa yāvan me hṛtpadmaḥ pūjanāya te

s05-v09.plain_english: Favor me, Lord, so that my mind, fallen ever at Your feet, tasting this and that — may it melt, may it flow.
s05-v09.sanskrit_cite: prasīda bhagavan yena tvatpade patitaṃ sadā | mano me tattadāsvādya kṣīved iva galed iva

s05-v10.plain_english: Whether from joy bursting pot-lids, or sorrow — from outside or inside feeling, appear to me, Lord.
s05-v10.sanskrit_cite: praharṣād vātha śokād vā yadi kuṅyād dhaṭād api | bāhyād athāntarād bhāvāt prakaṭībhava me prabho

s05-v11.plain_english: Outside too, inside too — may that ever-streaming, Your coolest foot-lotus-touch-nectar, be mine always.
s05-v11.sanskrit_cite: bahir apy antar api tat syandamānaṃ sadāstu me | bhavatpādāmbujasparśāmṛtam atyantaśītalam

s05-v12.plain_english: Plunging inside Your touch-nectar-lake — may that pleasure beyond all pleasures be mine always.
s05-v12.sanskrit_cite: tvatpādasaṃsparśasudhāsaraso 'ntarnimajjanam | ko 'py eṣa sarvasambhogalaṅghī bhogo 'stu me sadā

s05-v13.plain_english: Take what I offer — passion and the rest, Lord; make it nectar and eat it with devotees.
s05-v13.sanskrit_cite: niveditam upādatsva rāgādi bhagavan mayā | ādāya cāmṛtīkṛtya bhuṅkṣva bhaktajanaiḥ samam

s05-v14.plain_english: Ever-full on whole-world-food, happily seated — Master, cast Your grace-glance-moment on servants.
s05-v14.sanskrit_cite: aśeṣabhuvanāhāranityatṛptaḥ sukhāsanam | svāmin gṛhāṇa dāseṣu prasādālokanakṣaṇam

s05-v15.plain_english: Eyes half-closed, chewing inner devotion-wonder — "bow to me, to Śiva" — may I worship even straw.
s05-v15.sanskrit_cite: antarbhakticamatkāracarvaṇāmīlitekṣaṇaḥ | namo mahyaṃ śivāyeti pūjayam syāṃ tṛṇāny api

s05-v16.plain_english: Though I have gained Your being — seeing the world as my self-blaze — may I be unparted by devotion-rasa-enjoyments.
s05-v16.sanskrit_cite: api labdhabhavadbhāvaḥ svātmollāsamayaṃ jagat | paśyan bhaktirasābhogair bhaveyam aviyojitaḥ

s05-v17.plain_english: Since nothing else is to be desired, Lord — to You, the secondless, fullness is fitting.
s05-v17.sanskrit_cite: ākāmkṣaṇīyam aparaṃ yena nātha na vidyate | tava tenādvitīyasya yuktaṃ yat paripūrṇatā

s05-v18.plain_english: Where there is laughter, dancing, where passion-aversion are eaten, devotion-nectar drunk — may I reach that place.
s05-v18.sanskrit_cite: hasyate nṛtyate yatra rāgadveṣādi bhujyate | pīyate bhaktipīyūṣarasas tat prāpnuyāṃ padam

s05-v19.plain_english: May that unprecedented-joy-perfume of thought-flowers about You firm up in my mind — till bad-smell of bad-habit perishes.
s05-v19.sanskrit_cite: tat tad apūrvāmodatvaccintākusumavāsanā dṛḍhatām | etu mama manasi yāvann aśyatu durvāsanāgandhaḥ

s05-v20.plain_english: Where is love among passions, and where is loving at Hari's lotus-feet — thus teach my contradiction-loving heart what is good, O Deathless.
s05-v20.sanskrit_cite: kva nu rāgādiṣu rāgaḥ kva ca haracaraṇāmbujeṣu rāgitvam | itthaṃ virodharasikaṃ bodhaya hitam amara me hṛdayam

s05-v21.plain_english: Though wandering even through yogic states, though turned away from objects — may I be only heart-melted by Your-thought-liquor-madness.
s05-v21.sanskrit_cite: vicaran yogadaśāsv api viṣayavyāvṛttivartamāno 'pi | tvaccintāmadirāmadataralīkṛtahṛdaya eva syām

s05-v22.plain_english: In speech, mind-thoughts, body-gestures made by senses — everywhere, always, may bhakti-rasa go before me as leader.
s05-v22.sanskrit_cite: vāci manomatiṣu tathā śarīraceṣṭāsu karaṇaracitāsu | sarvatra sarvadā me puraḥsaro bhavatu bhaktirasaḥ

s05-v23.plain_english: While Your name "Śiva Śiva Śiva" is chanted endlessly, Lord — may I taste some great unrepeatable rasa.
s05-v23.sanskrit_cite: śivaśivaśiveti nāmani tava niravadhi nātha japyamāne 'smin | āsvādayan bhaveyaṃ kam api mahārasam apunaruktam

s05-v24.plain_english: In the vastness flashing as endless consciousness-self, where all dull paths are drunk up — may I roam Your worship, countless consciousness-made ramparts uncounted.
s05-v24.sanskrit_cite: sphuradanantacidātmakaviṣṭape parinipītasamastajaḍādhvani | agaṇitāparacinmayagaṇḍike pravicareyam ahaṃ bhavato 'rcitā

s05-v25.plain_english: For standing in self-body, clearly shining, eternal — nothing else is of use; firm be this thought — but the dust of Your pure feet.
s05-v25.sanskrit_cite: svavapuṣi sphuṭabhāsini śāśvate sthitikṛte na kim apy upayujyate | iti matiḥ sudṛḍhā bhavatāt paraṃ mama bhavaccaraṇābjarajaḥ śuceḥ

s05-v26.plain_english: Something flashes sometime in mind, touching Your feet — where this whole world melts — show it always, in the nectar-lake, Lord.
s05-v26.sanskrit_cite: kim api nātha kadācana cetasi sphurati tad bhavadaṃghritalaspṛśām | galati yatra samastamidaṃ sudhāsarasi viśvam idaṃ diśa me sadā

s06-v01.plain_english: Even a moment parted from You, Lord — of me burning dense always — may I be the ground of Your gaze.
s06-v01.sanskrit_cite: kṣaṇamātram apīśāna viyuktasya tvayā mama | nibiḍaṃ tapyamānasya sadā bhūyā dṛśaḥ padam

s06-v02.plain_english: In saṃsāra whose essence is parting — by You, dear Lord, may I be ever unparted, though parted from the world.
s06-v02.sanskrit_cite: viyogasāre saṃsāre priyeṇa prabhuṇā tvayā | aviyuktaḥ sadaiva syāṃ jagatāpi viyojitaḥ

s06-v03.plain_english: Wherever I go by body, speech, mind — all that is You alone: may this ultimate truth stand ever full for me.
s06-v03.sanskrit_cite: kāyavāṅmanasair yatra yāmi sarvaṃ tvam eva tat | ity eṣa paramārtho 'pi paripūrṇo 'stu me sadā

s06-v04.plain_english: As You are construction-free, great-bliss-full — so may my praise-speech become, just fitting.
s06-v04.sanskrit_cite: nirvikalpo mahānandapūrṇo yadvad bhavāṃs tathā | bhavatstutikarī bhūyād anurūpaiva vāṅ mama

s06-v05.plain_english: Possessed by You, seeing thing after thing as consisting of You — may I roam desireless, joy-filled.
s06-v05.sanskrit_cite: bhavadāveśataḥ paśyan bhāvaṃ bhāvaṃ bhavanmayam | vicareyaṃ nirākāṅkṣaḥ praharṣaparipūritaḥ

s06-v06.plain_english: May I see the whole world full of Your being, Lord — by that alone content; then do not toil.
s06-v06.sanskrit_cite: bhagavanbhavataḥ pūrṇam paśyeyam akhilaṃ jagat | tāvataivāsmi santuṣṭas tato na parikhidyase

s06-v07.plain_english: May things shine for me always, melting into You alone like cloud-bits in sky, moving toward ever-purer courses.
s06-v07.sanskrit_cite: vilīyamānās tvayy eva vyomni meghalavā iva | bhāvā vibhāntu me śaśvat kramanairmalyagāminaḥ

s06-v08.plain_english: May there blaze for me, from Your middle, some jewel of Being — its self-light-spread destroying the endless dark-series.
s06-v08.sanskrit_cite: svaprabhāprasaradhvastāparyantadhvāntasantatiḥ | santataṃ bhātu me ko 'pi bhavamadhyād bhavanmaṇiḥ

s06-v09.plain_english: What stage do You not rule, what could there be that is not Your body? Tired — by effortlessness may I reach You everywhere.
s06-v09.sanskrit_cite: kāṃ bhūmikāṃ nādhiśeṣe kiṃ tat syād yan na te vapuḥ | śrāntas tenāprayāsena sarvatas tvām avāpnuyām

s06-v10.plain_english: May limb-embrace-enjoyment with You happen to me by mere will — this much gained, Lord, what have I not won?
s06-v10.sanskrit_cite: bhavadaṅgapariṣvaṅgasambhogaḥ svecchayaiva me | ghaṭatām iyati prāpte kiṃ nātha na jitaṃ mayā

s06-v11.plain_english: Appear! We, Thine, tormented by no other prayers — fainting, we seek only You.
s06-v11.sanskrit_cite: prakaṭībhava nānyābhiḥ prārthanābhiḥ kadarthanāḥ | kurmas te nātha tāmyantas tvām eva mṛgayāmahe

s07-v01.plain_english: Having come to even-taste in You, bliss-river — may my mind drop at once this difference-based great disaster.
s07-v01.sanskrit_cite: tvayy ānandasarasvati samarasatām etya nātha mama cetaḥ pariharatu sakṛd iyantaṃ bhedādhīnaṃ mahānartham

s07-v02.plain_english: "This is mine, not this" — on passion-aversion's firm-nailed root may the axe fall inside: the certainty of oneness-with-You-made.
s07-v02.sanskrit_cite: etan mama na tv idam iti rāgadveṣādinigaḍadṛḍhamūle nātha bhavanmayataikyapratyayaparaśuḥ patatvantaḥ

s07-v03.plain_english: May the thought-stain-line melt; may unbarredness blaze in heart; bliss-rasa-flooded be my consciousness-body, Lord.
s07-v03.sanskrit_cite: galatu vikalpakalaṅkāvalī samullasatu hṛdi nirargalatā bhagavann ānandarasaplutāstu me cinmayī mūrtiḥ

s07-v04.plain_english: Me, rolled in the passion-made world-egg — may devotion-thought-mother feed me with rasas, till, wing-grown, I am a bird.
s07-v04.sanskrit_cite: rāgādimayabhavāṇḍakaluṭhitaṃ tvadbhaktibhāvanāmbikā tais taiḥ āpyāyayatu rasair māṃ pravṛddhapakṣo yathā bhavāmi khagaḥ

s07-v05.plain_english: May this mind of mine gain skill in tasting the essence of Your foot-thought-nectar-rasa — ending all object-poison-clinging-longing.

s07-v06.plain_english: By devotion-sun-ray-touch, may this mind-jewel release far away passion-kindled fire-drops.

s07-v07.plain_english: In that state may I praise You constantly, aloud — where even Hari, Indra, and Brahmā wait outside.
s07-v07.sanskrit_cite: tasmin pade bhavantaṃ satatam upaślokayeyam atyuccaiḥ hariharyaśvaviriñcā api yatra bahiḥ pratīkṣante

s07-v08.plain_english: By devotion-madness-born frenzy may I see with faculties unmaimed: the whole world as Śiva, and all acts as worship-stuff.
s07-v08.sanskrit_cite: bhaktimadajanitavibhramavaśena paśyeyam avikalaṃ karaṇaiḥ śivamayam akhilaṃ lokaṃ kriyāś ca pūjāmayī sakalāḥ

s07-v09.plain_english: My mind-boy, having taken Your-devotion-family-maiden, having borne aṇimā-etc. sons — may she, firm-rooted, harden the mine-thought.

s08-v01.plain_english: The grace-drop stationed in the Lord, and devotion come as if to meet me — when will the pair, joined, take root in such a body?
s08-v01.sanskrit_cite: yaḥ prasādalava īśvarasthito yā ca bhaktir iva mām upeyuṣī tau parasparasamanvitau kadā tādṛśe vapuṣi rūḍhim eṣyataḥ

s08-v02.plain_english: Born of chewing His lordship, may some inner joy-juice rise; here always be supreme for me — knowledge-yoga's glories far off.
s08-v02.sanskrit_cite: tvatprabhutvaparicarvaṇajanmā ko 'py udetu paritoṣaraso 'ntaḥ sarvakālam iha me param astu jñānayogamahimādi vidūre

s08-v03.plain_english: Like the worldly, let my thirst for objects swell — only seeing them as Your body, unconstructed.
s08-v03.sanskrit_cite: lokavadbhavatu me viṣayeṣu sphīta eva bhagavanparitarṣaḥ kevalaṃ tava śarīratayaitān+ lokayeyam aham astavikalpaḥ

s08-v04.plain_english: In body-grounds and in mind, Lord, and in breath's course where difference has come — and in those consciousness-paths — thereby, by Your own self, be plain to me.
s08-v04.sanskrit_cite: dehabhūmiṣu tathā manasi tvaṃ prāṇavartmani ca bhedam upete saṃvidaḥ pathiṣu teṣu ca tena svātmanā mama bhava sphuṭarūpaḥ

s08-v05.plain_english: May these thrilled faculties fall into their own seats — never, Lord, even slightly, the daring of non-difference-rupture.
s08-v05.sanskrit_cite: nijanijeṣu padeṣu patantv imāḥ karaṇavṛttaya ullasitā mama kṣaṇamapīśa manāg api maiva bhūt tvadavibhedarasakṣatisāhasam

s08-v06.plain_english: Light, soft, white-pure, cool — possessed by You, contemplating a body — may I exceed those dealings of the all-thing-road.
s08-v06.sanskrit_cite: laghumasṛṇasitācchaśītalaṃ bhavadāveśavaśena bhāvayan vapur akhilapadārthapaddhater vyavahārān ativartayeya tān

s08-v07.plain_english: May my self-body bloom as You; may worlds join my limbs; may all this duality-sport, even recalled, become untellable.
s08-v07.sanskrit_cite: vikasatu svavapur bhavadātmakaṃ samupayāntu jaganti mamāṅgatām vrajatu sarvam idaṃ dvayavalgitaṃ smṛtipathopagame 'py anupākhyatām

s08-v08.plain_english: May there rise, looking at such Yours, a flood of supreme nectar — so my filling of non-duality's dread gorge happens.
s08-v08.sanskrit_cite: samudiyād api tādṛśatāvakānana viloka parāmṛtasamplavaḥ mama ghaṭeta yathā bhavadadvayāprathanaghoradarīparipūraṇam

s08-v09.plain_english: If ever by the thinnest union-drops — may I turn from all world-pleasures; or shall I be fallen from both?
s08-v09.sanskrit_cite: api kadācana tāvakasaṅgamāmṛtakaṇācchuraṇena tanīyasā sakalalokasukheṣu parāṅmukho na bhavitāsmy ubhayacyuta eva kim

s08-v10.plain_english: Ever at Your lotus-feet, of me the best hamsa moving in the lake — from above, from the root-depths, and from inside, may devotion's lotus-stalk bend up, unborn Lord.
s08-v10.sanskrit_cite: satatam eva bhavaccaraṇāmbujākaracarasya hi haṃsavarasya me upari mūlatalād api cāntarād upanamatv aja bhaktimṛṇālikā

s08-v11.plain_english: May all things come under thought's scope and vision's footing for me; may vision-thought-light-nectar-essences blaze supreme.
s08-v11.sanskrit_cite: upayāntu vibho samastavastūny api cintāviṣayaṃ dṛśaḥ padaṃ ca mama darśanacintanaprakāśāmṛtasārāṇi paraṃ parisphurantu

s08-v12.plain_english: Lord, in crashing hardships, as names bend down, may I be — fear gone only while limb-joined, exceeding-joy-mad.
s08-v12.sanskrit_cite: parameśvara teṣu teṣu kṛcchreṣv api nāmopanamatsv ahaṃ bhaveyam na paraṃ gatabhīs tvadaṅgasaṅgādupajātādhikasammado 'pi yāvat

s08-v13.plain_english: The universe woven in Your self is shown outside by You alone — what stands firm-certain: may it now shine plain.
s08-v13.sanskrit_cite: bhavadātmani viśvam umbhitaṃ yad bhavataivāpi bahiḥ prakāśyate tat iti yad dṛḍhaniścayopajuṣṭaṃ tad idāniṃ sphuṭam eva bhāsatām

s09-v01.plain_english: When will my mind, eager to taste new-rasa-moist union, rush past all else to Your touch?
s09-v01.sanskrit_cite: kadā navarasārdrārdrasambhogāsvādanotsukam pravarteta vihāyānyan mama tvatsparśane manaḥ

s09-v02.plain_english: You-loving, worship-wealthy — when shall I, the eager one, see You face to face?
s09-v02.sanskrit_cite: tvadekaraktas tvatpādapūjāmātramahādhanaḥ kadā sākṣātkariṣyāmi bhavantam ayam utsukaḥ

s09-v03.plain_english: When, by thick love made needless-minded, shall I burst all great bolts with a crash and reach You?
s09-v03.sanskrit_cite: gāḍhānurāgavaśato nirapekṣībhūtamānaso 'smi kadā paṭapaṭiti vighaṭitākhilamahārgalas tvām upaiṣyāmi

s09-v04.plain_english: When, Lord, shall I subdue all gods — heart-seated in my own consciousness-essence — by devotion's power?
s09-v04.sanskrit_cite: svasaṃvitsārahṛdayādhiṣṭhānāḥ sarvadevatāḥ kadā nātha vaśīkuryāṃ bhavadbhaktiprabhāvataḥ

s09-v05.plain_english: When will my vast devotion-bliss-rasa festival be — where even distinction gets a name from beholding-joy?
s09-v05.sanskrit_cite: kadā me syād vibho bhūri bhaktyānandarasotsavaḥ yadālokasukhānandī pṛthaṅ nāmāpi lapsyate

s09-v06.plain_english: Having suddenly recognized the fearless, generous, full, causeless, self-hidden Lord — when shall I shame Your people?
s09-v06.sanskrit_cite: īśvaram abhayam udāraṃ pūrṇam akāraṇam apahnutātmānaṃ sahasābhijñāya kadā svāmijanaṃ lajjayiṣyāmi

s09-v07.plain_english: When, Lord, shall I attain whatever beloved-ness of Yours — that by which it would not befit You to flee from me anywhere?
s09-v07.sanskrit_cite: kadā kām api tāṃ nātha tava vallabhatām iyām yayā māṃ prati na kvāpi yuktaṃ te syāt palāyitum

s09-v08.plain_english: When shall I be bathed by the approving sight of all beings whose selves are Your worship?
s09-v08.sanskrit_cite: tattvato 'śeṣajantūnāṃ bhavatpūjāmayātmanām dṛṣṭyānumoditarasāplāvitaḥ syāṃ kadā vibho

s09-v09.plain_english: Devotion, the highest ground of knowledge, the highest state of yoga — when will my begging for it be full?
s09-v09.sanskrit_cite: jñānasya paramā bhūmir yogasya paramā daśā tvadbhaktir yā vibho karhi pūrṇa me syāt tadarthitā

s09-v10.plain_english: Seizing suddenly, holding hard, joy-overwhelmed — when shall I proclaim Your foot-treasure to all?
s09-v10.sanskrit_cite: sahasaivasādya kadā gāḍham avaṣṭabhya harṣavivaśo 'ham tvaccaraṇavaranidhānaṃ sarvasya prakaṭayiṣyāmi

s09-v11.plain_english: All-around pure-You-light-spread — when shall I so shine that no Māyā-shadow-cave is in me?
s09-v11.sanskrit_cite: paritaḥ prasaracchuddhatvadālokamayaḥ kadā syāṃ yatheśa na kiñcin me māyācchāyābilaṃ bhavet

s09-v12.plain_english: Having made all circles my own, need-free — when shall I be, Lord, leader of Your devotee-host?
s09-v12.sanskrit_cite: ātmasātkṛtaniḥśeṣamaṇḍalo nirvyapekṣakaḥ kadā bhaveyaṃ bhagavaṃs tvadbhaktagaṇanāyakaḥ

s09-v13.plain_english: Lord, You are the unprecedented ground of world-prides — when shall I be greatly proud, filled with Your devotion-rasa?
s09-v13.sanskrit_cite: nātha lokābhimānānām apūrvaṃ tvaṃ nibandhanam mahābhimānaḥ karhi syāṃ tvadbhaktirasapūritaḥ

s09-v14.plain_english: Well-set in never-object-empty glory-embrace — may I lie as if at Your cool lotus-feet pair — when?

s09-v15.plain_english: Of worship-wealth grown rich on devotion-liquor — when shall I reach the far shore, when be apt?
s09-v15.sanskrit_cite: bhaktyāsavasamṛddhāyās tvatpūjābhogasampadaḥ kadā pāraṃ gamiṣyāmi bhaviṣyāmi kadā kṛtī

s09-v16.plain_english: Tears first, stumbling, wandering, choked crying — laughing-lit face: when shall I get Your touch-rasa?

s09-v17.plain_english: Shaking off this beast-people-like conduct — when shall I, O Śambhu, taste the self-form fit for Your devotion?
s09-v17.sanskrit_cite: paśujanasamānavṛttām avadhūya daśām imāṃ kadā śambho āsvādayeya tāvakabhaktocitam ātmano rūpam

s09-v18.plain_english: Siddhis gained, all heat-fear melted — when shall I play, devoted to drinking Your devotion-rasa-medicine?

s09-v19.plain_english: Lord, when shall that cry of mine rise in speech — at which Your form flashes before me at once?
s09-v19.sanskrit_cite: nātha kadā sa tathāvidha ākrando me samuccared vāci yat samanantaram eva sphurati puras tāvakī mūrtiḥ

s09-v20.plain_english: Mind set on hugging Your tight-tight lotus-feet — when shall I see You, thing or non-thing, without effort?
s09-v20.sanskrit_cite: gāḍhagāḍhabhavadaṅghrisarojāliṅganavyasanatatparacetāḥ vastv avastv idam ayatnata eva tvāṃ kadā samavalokayitāsmi

s10-v01.plain_english: Surely intolerable to You, sole world-Lord: Your Maheśvaras and other world-folk on one level.
s10-v01.sanskrit_cite: na soḍhavyam avaśyam te jagadekaprabhor idam māheśvarāś ca lokānām itareṣāṃ samāś ca yat

s10-v02.plain_english: Who always follow Your feet with love — wherever gone, they enjoy certain pleasures.
s10-v02.sanskrit_cite: ye sadaivānurāgeṇa bhavatpādānugāminaḥ yatra tatra gatā bhogāṃs te kāṃś cid upabhuñjate

s10-v03.plain_english: Where He is husband and death-ender, whence sickness? Where His fortune is, what other fortune?
s10-v03.sanskrit_cite: bhartā kālāntako yatra bhavāṃs tatra kuto rujaḥ tatra cetarabhogāśā kā lakṣmīr yatra tāvakī

s10-v04.plain_english: By whose moment-pleasure the All is gained — for him all time fills with Your bliss.
s10-v04.sanskrit_cite: kṣanamātrasukhenāpi vibhur yenāsi labhyase tadaiva sarvaḥ kālo 'sya tvadānandena pūryate

s10-v05.plain_english: Moon: Your bliss-rasa drop fallen to earth; sun: Your destroyer-heat's spread spark.
s10-v05.sanskrit_cite: ānandarasabindus te candramā galito bhuvi sūryas tathā te prasṛtaḥ saṃhārī tejasaḥ kaṇaḥ

s10-v06.plain_english: Offering to this third eye of Yours, Lord — sole mark of some unworldly greatness.
s10-v06.sanskrit_cite: baliṃ yāmas tṛtīyāya netrāyāsmai tava prabho alaukikasya kasyāpi māhātmyasyaikalakṣmaṇe

s10-v07.plain_english: Seen by Him alone, one joys in Your vision-etc.; or whose joy somehow — by it You are seen.
s10-v07.sanskrit_cite: tenaiva dṛṣṭo 'si bhavaddarśanādyo 'tihṛṣyati kathañcid yasya vā harṣaḥ ko 'pi tena tvam īkṣitaḥ

s10-v08.plain_english: Those You're pleased with, whose hearts You've won — dragging from Your city, they've made the outer inner.
s10-v08.sanskrit_cite: yeṣām prasanno 'si vibho yair labdhaṃ hṛdayaṃ tava ākṛṣya tvatpurāttais tu bāhyam ābhyantarīkṛtam

s10-v09.plain_english: Apart from You the whole world looks same-eyed — but its Īśvara is You alone, the Uneven-eyed.
s10-v09.sanskrit_cite: tvad ṛte nikhilaṃ viśvaṃ samadṛgyātam īkṣyatām īśvaraḥ punar etasya tvam eko viṣamekṣaṇaḥ

s10-v10.plain_english: Leave aside: without Your power there is no being at all — and those whose denials of You don't stand without You.
s10-v10.sanskrit_cite: āstāṃ bhavatprabhāveṇa vinā sattaiva nāsti yat tvaddūṣaṇakathā yeṣām tvad ṛte nopapadyate

s10-v11.plain_english: If mind stood in You alone, barriers in-outside gone — what else would be needed, Lord?
s10-v11.sanskrit_cite: bāhyāntarāntarāyālīkevale cetasi sthitiḥ tvayi cet syān mama vibho kim anyad upayujyate

s10-v12.plain_english: Others wander, Lord, in the self itself, ill-placed; others wander in the self itself, well-placed.
s10-v12.sanskrit_cite: anye bhramanti bhagavann ātmany evātiduḥsthitāḥ anye bhramanti bhagavann ātmany evātisusthitāḥ

s10-v13.plain_english: Even untasted Your devotion-nectar, unseen You — by mere conduct with You, beings perfect.
s10-v13.sanskrit_cite: apītvāpi bhavadbhaktisudhām anavalokya ca tvām īśa tvatsamācāramātrāt siddhyanti jantavaḥ

s10-v14.plain_english: We are Your servants, Lord — so as You bear Yourself for three worlds, bear us too, fully.
s10-v14.sanskrit_cite: bhṛtyā vayaṃ tava vibho tena trijagatāṃ yathā bibharṣy ātmānam evaṃ te bharttavyā vayam apy alam

s10-v15.plain_english: Though seen in supreme-bliss-nectar, in the world-self — for touch-rasa with You I hunger exceedingly.
s10-v15.sanskrit_cite: parānandāmṛtamaye dṛṣṭo 'pi jagadātmani tvayi sparśarase 'tyantatarasutkaṇṭhito(?) 'smi te

s10-v16.plain_english: All sorrows even of worldlings — joined to Your ghee-self, become bearable.
s10-v16.sanskrit_cite: deva duḥkhāny aśeṣāṇi yāni saṃsāriṇām api ghṛtyākhyabhavadīyātmayutāny āyānti sahyatām

s10-v17.plain_english: With You — omniscient, omnipotent, consciousness-formed — somehow the world's show, though unreal, is fitting.
s10-v17.sanskrit_cite: sarvajñe sarvaśaktau ca tvayy eva sati cinmaye sarvathāpy asato nātha yuktāsya jagataḥ prathā

s10-v18.plain_english: Breathed by You, qualities throb — even clod-like — dancing wind-tossed like cotton fluff.
s10-v18.sanskrit_cite: tvatprāṇitāḥ sphurantīme guṇā loṣṭopamā api nṛtyanti pavanoddhūtāḥ kārpāsāḥ picavo yathā

s10-v19.plain_english: If self-pride in qualities were not — then by what would the world's show of sole-selfness with You be lost?
s10-v19.sanskrit_cite: yadi nātha guṇeṣv ātmābhimāno na bhavet tataḥ kena hīyeta jagatas tvadekātmatayā prathā

s10-v20.plain_english: Venerable even the dissolved great ones, purified by Your anger-fire-touch.
s10-v20.sanskrit_cite: vandyās te 'pi mahīyāṃsaḥ pralayopagatā api tvatkopapāvakasparśapūtā ye parameśvara

s10-v21.plain_english: With Your broad-light body standing plain — Lord, why do I spread in darkness on all sides?
s10-v21.sanskrit_cite: mahāprakāśavapuṣi vispaṣṭe bhavati sthite sarvato 'pīśa tat kasmāt tamasi prasarāmy aham

s10-v22.plain_english: You alone undivided, my nectar-nature — yet of mortal natures I alone am the seat.
s10-v22.sanskrit_cite: avibhāgo bhavān eva svarūpam amṛtaṃ mama tathāpi martyadharmāṇām aham evaikam āspadam

s10-v23.plain_english: Whose speech-ornament is the name "Maheśvara," whose head bears the bow-mark — he alone is powerful.
s10-v23.sanskrit_cite: maheśvareti yasyāsti nāmakaṃ vāgvibhūṣaṇam praṇāmāṅkaś ca śirasi sa evaikaḥ prabhāvitaḥ

s10-v24.plain_english: Since You are being and non-being — then effortlessly, by own tune, Lord, why is accomplishment not mine?
s10-v24.sanskrit_cite: sadasac ca bhavān eva yena tenāprayāsataḥ svarasenaiva bhagavaṃs tathā siddhiḥ kathaṃ na me

s10-v25.plain_english: Śiva's slave, Śiva-selfed — what joy would he not reach? I am sated by nectar-wines even of chief gods.
s10-v25.sanskrit_cite: śivadāsaḥ śivaikātmā kiṃ yan nāsādayet sukham tarpyo 'smi devamukhyānām api yenāmṛtāsavaiḥ

s10-v26.plain_english: Between heart and navel, beings' bile-bodied — You devour, great fire, all moving-unmoving.
s10-v26.sanskrit_cite: hṛnnābhyor antarālasthaḥ prāṇināṃ pittavigrahaḥ grasase tvaṃ mahāvahniḥ sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam

s11-v01.plain_english: This world, or friends, or kin — nothing is mine at all; but when You are all this, who else is mine?
s11-v01.sanskrit_cite: jagad idam athavā suhṛdo bandhujano vā na bhavati mama kim api tvaṃ punar etat sarvaṃ yadā tadā ko 'paro me 'stu

s11-v02.plain_english: "Master, Maheśvara, You directly — all the world is You alone" — may the thing itself succeed; and begging even in that is mere begging.
s11-v02.sanskrit_cite: svāmin maheśvaras tvaṃ sākṣāt sarvaṃ jagat tvam eveti vastv eva siddhim etv iti yācñā tatrāpi yācñaiva

s11-v03.plain_english: Even world-overlordship here seems straw to Your devotee; what fruit has good karma, Lord, without Your remembrance?
s11-v03.sanskrit_cite: tribhuvanādhipatitvam apīha yat tṛṇam iva pratibhāti bhavajjuṣaḥ kim iva tasya phalaṃ śubhakarmaṇo bhavati nātha bhavatsmaraṇād ṛte

s11-v04.plain_english: Since nothing at all is apart from You, world-cause — Your play is wondrous, yet no praise takes hold.
s11-v04.sanskrit_cite: yena naiva bhavato 'sti vibhinnaṃ kiñcanāpi jagatāṃ prabhavaś ca tvadvijṛmbhitam ato 'dbhutakarmasv apy udeti na tava stutibandhaḥ

s11-v05.plain_english: "I am Yours, worship-bound" — always, unceasing, even by own tune, and in dream — why am I not so?
s11-v05.sanskrit_cite: tvanmayo 'smi bhavadarcananiṣṭhaḥ sarvadāham iti cāpy avirāmam bhāvayann api vibho svarasena svapnago 'pi na tathā kim iva syām

s11-v06.plain_english: Who are touched even slightly by Your lotus-foot-born fragrance-dust — for them all enjoyed things, gods-sought, become rest.
s11-v06.sanskrit_cite: ye manāg api bhavaccaraṇābjodbhūtasaurabhalavena vimṛṣṭaḥ teṣu visram iva bhavati samastaṃ bhogajātam amarair api mṛgyam

s11-v07.plain_english: In heart nothing other than Thee; in word and deed wholly other, O Śambhu — yet whether grace or restraint from the truly Real: one work only.
s11-v07.sanskrit_cite: hṛdi te na tu vidyate 'nyad anyad vacane karmaṇi cānyad eva śaṃbho paramārthasato 'py anugraho vā yadi vā nigraha eka eva kāryaḥ

s11-v08.plain_english: Fool am I, suffering-laden, aging-fearful, powerless — Yours am I: Śambhu, so arrange that, past sorrow's road, I mount the highest yoke fast.
s11-v08.sanskrit_cite: mūḍho 'smi duḥkhakalito 'smi jarādidoṣabhīto 'smi śaktirahito 'smi tavāśrito 'smi śambho tathā kalaya śīghram upaimi yena sarvottamāṃ dhuram apojjhitaduḥkhamārgaḥ

s11-v09.plain_english: Lying at Your ear-place, my cries, trifling — become like water-drops in bamboo-joints turning pearl.
s11-v09.sanskrit_cite: tvatkarṇadeśama dhiśayya mahārghabhāvam ākranditāni mama tucchatarāṇi yānti vaṃśāntarālapatitāni jalaikadeśakhaṇḍāni mauktikamaṇitvam ivodvahanti

s11-v10.plain_english: What is not gained, alas, even by those — Lord — who even by deceit delight a moment in Your name?
s11-v10.sanskrit_cite: kim iva ca labhyate bata na tair api nātha janaiḥ kṣaṇam api kaitavād api ca ye tava nāmni ratāḥ śiśiramayūkhaśekhara tathā kuru yena mama kṣatamaraṇo 'ṇimādikam upaimi yathā vibhavam

s11-v11.plain_english: Śambhu Śarva moon-crested Śiva, three-eyed rosary-bearer, fierce-skulled, trident-armed, ocean of pity, world-builder by fierce power, blue-throated — destroy ill-fortune fast, give supreme success.
s11-v11.sanskrit_cite: śambho śarva śaśaṅkaśekhara śiva tryakṣākṣamālādhara śrīmann ugrakapālalāñchana lasadbhīmatriśūlāyudha kāruṇyāmbunidhe trilokaracanāśīlograśaktyātmaka śrīkaṇṭhāśu vināśayāśubhabharān ādhat svasiddhiṃ parām

s11-v12.plain_english: What would there be where the Lord does not make? What would the knower Śaṅkara destroys be? Thus, ever sheltered in Thee, O Lord of unwasted great power — in this saṃsāra, ceaseless in anguish, I suffer alone.
s11-v12.sanskrit_cite: tat kiṃ nātha bhaven na yatra bhagavān nirmātṛtām aśnute bhāvaḥ syāt kim u tasya cetanavato nāśāsti yaṃ śaṅkaraḥ itthaṃ te parameśvarākṣatamahāśakteḥ sadā saṃśritaḥ saṃsāre 'tra nirantarādhividhuraḥ kliśyāmy ahaṃ kevalam

s11-v13.plain_english: Though pains, age, death here are boon-givers most haughty, and approved sounds unstable — yet I long, ever-pleasure-hungering, to stand long tasting Your feet for life-drink.
s11-v13.sanskrit_cite: yady apy atra varapradoddhatatamāḥ pīḍājarāmṛtyava ete vā kṣaṇam āsatāṃ bahumataḥ śabdādir evāsthiraḥ tatrāpi spṛhayāmi santatasukhākāṅkṣī ciraṃ sthāsnave bhogāsvādayutatvadaṅghrikamaladhyānāgrya jīvātave

s11-v14.plain_english: O Lord skilled at destroying the bowed-down's pain, treasure of good, matted one — act now so that, living, I win unshakable attainments, Your-worship-bound.
s11-v14.sanskrit_cite: he nātha praṇatārtināśanapaṭo śreyonidhe dhūrjaṭe duḥkhaikāyatanasya janmamaraṇatrastasya me sāmpratam tac ceṣṭasva yathā manojñaviṣayāsvādapradā uttamā jīvann eva samaśnuve 'ham acalāḥ siddhīs tvadarcāparaḥ

s11-v15.plain_english: Bow to delusion-great-darkness-destroyer whose sole work is that, to over-bright light moon-marked.

s12-v01.plain_english: No helper is wanted at all, no hinderer is seen in Your vision — yet all is flooded by You alone: how is it even so that You do not see?
s12-v01.sanskrit_cite: sahakāri na kiñcid iṣyate bhavato na pratibandhakaṃ dṛṣi bhavataiva hi sarvam āplutaṃ katham adyāpi tathāpi nekṣase

s12-v02.plain_english: From things, senses, awareness-middle, ever self-born — may I see Him, world-veiled.
s12-v02.sanskrit_cite: api bhāvagaṇād apīndriyapracayād apy avabodhamadhyataḥ prabhavantam api svataḥ sadā paripaśyeyam apoḍhaviśvakam

s12-v03.plain_english: How could things come to be, and how reach Your path of vision, inlaid by what great nature-limb? Rising and rising, from land-water-grass on, You scatter nectar-floods of creation over all things.
s12-v03.sanskrit_cite: kathaṃ te jāyeran katham api ca te darśanapathaṃ vrajeyuḥ kenāpi prakṛtimahatāṅkena khacitaḥ tathotthāyotthāya sthalajalatṛṇāder akhilataḥ padārthadyānsṛṣṭisravadamṛtapūrair(?) vikirasi

s12-v04.plain_english: Sated with Your form-nectar, thirst uprooted, drunk — they wander at will.
s12-v04.sanskrit_cite: sākṣatkṛta bhavadrūpaprasṛtāmṛtatarpitāḥ unmūlitatṛṣo mattā vicaranti yathāruci

s12-v05.plain_english: Not then, not always, not once — where no time-thought is: such is Your vision, neither eternal nor otherwise.
s12-v05.sanskrit_cite: na tadā na sadā na caikadety api sā yatra na kāladhīr bhavet tad idaṃ bhavadīyadarśanaṃ na ca nityaṃ na ca kathyate 'nyathā

s12-v06.plain_english: May my mind, risen to see You, gain this yoga-fruit always: to enter Your nectar-house by mere resolve, for Your worship.
s12-v06.sanskrit_cite: tvadvilokanasamutkacetaso yogasiddhir iyatī sadāstu me yad viśeyam abhisandhimātratas tvatsudhāsadanam arcanāya te

s12-v07.plain_english: The clear-minded great ones' pure play and words shine plainly, playfully.
s12-v07.sanskrit_cite: nirvikalpabhavadīyadarśanapraptiphullamanasāṃ mahātmanām ullasanti vimalāni helayā ceṣṭitāni ca vacāṃsi ca sphuṭam

s12-v08.plain_english: Dwelling between Your feet, fearless — in those and those world-grounds may I worship the Lord, unbarred in act.
s12-v08.sanskrit_cite: bhavanbhavadīyapādayor nivasann antara eva nirbhayaḥ bhavabhūmiṣu tāsu tāsv ahaṃ prabhum arceyam anargalakriyaḥ

s12-v09.plain_english: Dissolved in Your foot-lake, melted seeking, honey-drunk to excess — may I roam satisfied, at will.
s12-v09.sanskrit_cite: bhavadaṅghrisaroruhodare parilīno galitaparaiṣaṇaḥ atimātramadhūpayogataḥ paritṛpto vicareyam icchayā

s12-v10.plain_english: Whose resolve to worship You arose even from pretense — to him too, assuredly, has arisen Thy fitting presence.
s12-v10.sanskrit_cite: yasya dambhād iva bhavatpūjāsaṅkalpa utthitaḥ tasyāpy avaśyam uditaṃ sannidhānaṃ tavocitam

s12-v11.plain_english: Lord, with one-taste mind seeking nothing else — the all-laying Lord, easy — may I drink my fill: what am I?
s12-v11.sanskrit_cite: bhagavann itarān apekṣiṇā nitarām ekarasena cetasā sulabhaṃ sakalopaśāyinaṃ prabhum ātṛpti pibeyam asmi kim

s12-v12.plain_english: By You denied: all where You're absent is to be left; where it's You, to be taken — this is the essence-extract.
s12-v12.sanskrit_cite: tvayā nirākṛtam sarvaṃ heyam etat tad eva tu tvanmayaṃ samupādeyam ity ayaṃ sārasaṃgrahaḥ

s12-v13.plain_english: The world-born, moving inside Thee, is worshipped as chief through its coming-forth — how, Lord, could mere non-being outside Thee be worshipped, and by whom?
s12-v13.sanskrit_cite: bhavato 'ntaracāri bhāvajātaṃ prabhuvanmukhyatayaiva pūjitaṃ tat bhavato bahir apy abhāvamātrā katham īśān bhavet samarcyate vā

s12-v14.plain_english: Noiseless, thought-free, undistracted, always — in agitation too, face to face: I see You alone everywhere, Three-eyed.
s12-v14.sanskrit_cite: niḥśabdaṃ nirvikalpaṃ ca nirvyākṣepam athānisam kṣobhe 'py adhyakṣamī kṣeyaṃ tryakṣa tvām eva sarvataḥ

s12-v15.plain_english: Reveal Your abode where You ever are with the Goddess; foot-dust-ranked servants — why do they look faithless?
s12-v15.sanskrit_cite: prakaṭaya nijadhāma deva yasmiṃs tvam asi sadā parameśvarīsametaḥ prabhucaraṇarajaḥsamānakakṣyāḥ kim aviśvāsapadaṃ bhānti bhṛtyāḥ

s12-v16.plain_english: Come to path's seeing yet fled — whence, Lord, to me Your servant? Never for a moment here are You not every being's sight-object.
s12-v16.sanskrit_cite: darśanapatham upayāto 'py apasarasi kuto mameśa bhṛtyasya kṣaṇamātrakam iha na bhavasi kasya na jantor dṛśor viṣayaḥ

s12-v17.plain_english: When, Lord, with oneness-nectar's pure unbroken stream wilt Thou flood me — that beyond the flood, bringing non-difference, I may gain Thee and my own body, joyfully?
s12-v17.sanskrit_cite: aikyasaṃvidamṛtācchadhārayā santataprasṛtayā kadā vibho plāvanāt paramabhedamānayaṃs tvāṃ nijaṃ ca vapur āpnuyāṃ mudam

s12-v18.plain_english: From my understanding fenced off from yonder world, a grain of world-establishment — that I be worshipped by You.
s12-v18.sanskrit_cite: aham ity amuto 'varuddhalokād bhavadīyāt pratipattisārato me aṇumātrakam eva viśvaniṣṭhaṃ ghaṭatāṃ yena bhaveyam arcitā te

s12-v19.plain_english: Seeing every thing each moment, O form beyond measure — may I see You well, my own Lord.
