Feast entered: pure-shine rounds, woven weddings, waxing greed, ocean sitting, knot severing, sense-field sending, helpless heats, grace-causes, deed-frenzies, ventured fruits (vv11-22).

Feast deepened: roaming madness, open hearts, unfound beauties, clear-fed frames, wedding-bonds, thirsting lakes, sole bowls, somehow-wins, bowed gear, mantra-laid starts, blooming kingdoms (vv23-34).

Feast sealed: god-or-freed feasters, weighted guises, churned nectar, wish-cow deeming, tossing glances, churned worship, treading courtesy, unbarred love, stilled minds, ruled means, treasuried senses, pretty thralls, formed feasts, lust-offerings, straw-and-jewel close (vv35-48).

sections.SUMMARY: The longest song is a catalogue proving nothing is outside the festival: tears tasting nectar (1); all acts succeeding, devotees as successes (2); all beings worshipping unceasing (3); touch perfected by meditation (4); equinox-moment always (5); beginningless deed, single resort (6); gods fortunate even in delusion (7); whenever-wherever worship (8); incomparable enjoyers (9); the festival known only by getting (10); worship with all 36 tattva-acts (11); time spent in joy (12); greed growing daily (13); dwelling in His ocean (14); mind offered as sweet (15); senses sent as errands (16); drowning as sole liberation-route (17); perpetual foot-festival as grace-cause (18); moment-by-moment tasting (19); seen fruit (20); untasted happiness till then (21); effortless abiding (22); omnicompetent madness (23); unbegging worship praised (24); everything-is (25); utensil-body (26); dependent self-will (27); thirst quenched into lake (28); devotee as vessel like Him (29); festival agitating the 36 (30); instruments worshipped (31); mantra-placement then rest (32); kingdoms blooming (33); gods-freed-or-someone unanswered (34); lightness and weight (35); milk-ocean churning (36); wish-cow vs inward milking (37); glances feeding (38); lowliness crowned (39); steps for some, spread for devotees (40); divine foothold through madness (41); stunned mind, He alone as vessel (42); full-steady-devoted means (43); organ-host fortune (44); prettiness found (45); rising from formed or formless (46); passions conscripted (47); straw-yet-jewel close (48).

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of festival (utsava); the vyabhicāri is joy (harṣa) at the catalogue of all beings worshipping. The rasa is the bliss of the festival — everything inside, nothing outside. Abhinava's rasa theory frames this as ānanda: the relish (camatkāra) of the Absolute's festival. Lakshmanjoo: the festival agitates the 36 tattvas; the devotee is a vessel like Him. Everything is inside the festival; nothing outside. The rasa is the bliss of the festival — all beings worshipping, all acts succeeding.

essence: Inside and outside winning: world-inside won, Bhavānī-facing station unsplit, smug slain, honoured feet, frame-dwelt burning (vv1-5).
Dwelling images: glued minds at aim-meets, pastured dealings, city roving, oozed nectar-floods, chant-tree woods, dawning shows, cake-built gladdening, honoured-rule seas (vv6-13).
Paradox and entry: bared truth unvesselled, calm unwanting, bowled minds, ring-turned winning, unsundered making, stained denial, plain entering, praiseless praise (vv14-21).

sections.SUMMARY: It watches the hidden become manifest without ceasing to be hidden: found inside the world, never far (1); He here, She everywhere, no division at the top (2); the ungrateful blind, the risen mind unseeing — ah, destroyed (3); needing nothing, I bow (4); burning world, make me worship-joy (5); spontaneity, touch, world-tour (6); things coming and going, may they shine (7); ever in His city, never defeated (8); cool nectar-floods of Your limb-touch filling all round (9); tree-shade, forest, self: three dwellings (10); appear before me, three-eyed, trident-graced (11); pride offered, devotion weighed (12); tasting everything everywhere (13); Your thing, Your truth — who can disclose (14); no desire for peace, no begging remembered (15); waking or beyond, festival in the ever-present mind (16); loosened yet unswerving (17); nothing unmade, yet all suffers — bow to the wonder (18); doubt-foe crushed, sight unbroken (19); enter me plainly, worship at speed (20); no one's is praise-power, yet it exists since You are beautiful — may I see unwearied (21).

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of manifesting (āviṣkāra); the vyabhicāri is wonder (camatkāra) at the hidden becoming manifest without ceasing to be hidden. The rasa is the tranquility of manifesting — the Absolute shown without being exhausted. Lakshmanjoo: revelation (āviṣkāra) — the hidden becomes manifest without ceasing to be hidden. Found inside the world, never far. The rasa is the tranquility of manifesting — the Absolute shown without being exhausted.

essence: Prayer grounds: past-grounds, one-hoard selves, knowing-frames, pain-thieved farings (vv1-4).
Face and melting: jewel-creeper blooming, face-orb drowning, glad shapes, unexcelled touches, bitter offerings, ray-licked fevers, blocked strands, brimmed piths (vv5-12).
Freedom and Master: death-lawed shining, speck-starved wings, clear begging, brimmed mindfulness, yonder father-eyed mother-roamed Master (vv13-17).

sections.SUMMARY: It stops praying for things and starts praying for Him: the wish-tree outgrows prayer-grounds (1), yet the self stays unjoined to the highest (2) though declared identical with the Lord (3); melt into His sight (4); when the amazement (5), the face (6), the flood (7), the soon (8); bring on everything including contradiction (9); rays face to face (10); thieves tamed (11); mind drowned (12); set the mortal on fitting ground (13); no siddhi-drop (14); I ask only this (15); feet blooming in mind (16); I have a Lord, a father, a mother — no second: I roam fulfilled (17).

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of revelation (udyota); the vyabhicāri is wonder (camatkāra) at praying for Him, not things. The rasa is the tranquility of revealed meaning — stopping prayer for things, starting prayer for Him. Lakshmanjoo: illumination (udyota) — stops praying for things, starts praying for Him. The wish-tree outgrows prayer-grounds. The rasa is the tranquility of revealed meaning — praying for Him, not things.

essence: Bow catalogue: catalogued Lord, dance-ready praise, Hara-housed fortunes, played lordship, honoured seat (vv1-5).
Paradox middle: Gauri-lover favoured, being-tree creepers, itch-born worship, gone roamings, begged riches, pang-joys, rooted sinking, speech-jewel, effortless ripening (vv6-13).
Closing seal: awaited light, slave-mouth Śiva, lit showings, guzzled breathers, sham ruin-ties, self-standing frames, night-dancing heroes, begun endless praise (vv14-21).

sections.SUMMARY: It chews everything a final time: icon adored (1–2), devotees bowed (3), play affirmed (4–5), couple celebrated (6), meditation rooted (7), itch scratched into pillar (8), ever-fed ever-playing ever-eating Lord (9), no going, His abode seen (10), wealth and poverty begging nothing (11), pain-pleasure-poison-nectar-saṃsāra-liberation transmuted (12), no suffering yet we sink — tell why (13), light begged even by others (14), no prayer, Name on lip (15), recognition as agency (16), all beings grasped (17), all-beyond-Me false by destruction-play (18), meditated form standing present (19), vetāla-roused night-dance (20), the limb-begun praise made unending (21).

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of chewing (carvaṇa); the vyabhicāri is joy (harṣa) at everything transmuted. The rasa is the bliss of final chewing — pain/pleasure/poison/nectar/saṃsāra/liberation all transmuted. Abhinava's rasa theory frames this as ānanda: the relish (camatkāra) of the Absolute chewed to the end. Lakshmanjoo: chewing (carvaṇa) — everything transmuted. Pain/pleasure/poison/nectar/saṃsāra/liberation all chewed. The rasa is the bliss of final chewing — the Absolute tasted to the end. Carvaṇa as a whole song (cf. Stotra 6).

lines: He neither sits in thought nor tells a bead — yet may it dawn for him, with no rule first.
Just so, just so — O Śiva's light — we bow to him who loves.
s01-v01.sanskrit_cite: na dhyāyato na japataḥ syād yasyāvidhipūrvakam | evam eva śivabhāsas taṃ numo bhaktiśālinam

lines: My self stays young, drinking Your love's nectar —
greyed as if with road-dust, dust that is passion.
s01-v02.sanskrit_cite: ātmā mama bhavadbhaktisudhāpānayuvāpi san | lokayātrārajorāgāt palitair iva dhūsaraḥ

lines: For those who've won that wealth — lovers homed in Your city —
may even their world-road walking be that same unfolding.
s01-v03.sanskrit_cite: labdhatatsaṃpadāṃ bhaktimatāṃ tvatpuravāsinām | saṃcāro lokamārge 'pi syāt tayaiva vijṛmbhayā

lines: Lord — where world within world stands face to face with You,
what is not the lover's ground? where does his prayer fail?
s01-v04.sanskrit_cite: sākṣādbhavanmaye nātha sarvasmin bhuvanāntare | kiṃ na bhaktimatāṃ kṣetram mantraḥ kvaiṣām na siddhyati

lines: They win — the drunk, high on love's nectar-wine!
Second to none, yet never without You beside them, Lord.
s01-v05.sanskrit_cite: jayanti bhaktipīyūṣarasāsavavaronmadāḥ | advitīyā api sadā tvaddvitīyā api prabho
notes: dvitīyāḥ holds both readings: predicative second and bahuvrīhi having-You-beside (live L0 fork); the couplet keeps both.

lines: Lord of the endless-bliss sea — Your truth is known by just such ones:
the flooded, thick-drenched in love's bliss-nectar.
s01-v06.sanskrit_cite: anantānandasindhos te nātha tattvaṃ vidanti te | tādṛśa eva ye sāndrabhaktyānandarasāplutāḥ

lines: You alone, self's Lord, are all men's nature, and all men love within the self — so this love stands on its own ground.
Who knows it, knowing by drowning — let him conquer.
s01-v07.sanskrit_cite: tvam evātmeśa sarvasya sarvaś cātmani rāgavān | iti svabhāvasiddhāṃs tvadbhaktiṃ jānañ jayej janaḥ
notes: samāveśayuktyā (Kṣemarāja: by immersion's means) carried as knowing by drowning; jayet kept optative.

lines: Lord — the known destroyed, who would not see You standing all alone?
Even in the known-knower churn, lovers find You easy.
s01-v08.sanskrit_cite: nātha vedyakṣaye kena na dṛśyo 'syekakaḥ sthitaḥ | vedyavedakasaṃkṣobhe 'py asi bhaktaiḥ sudarśanaḥ

lines: As the Goddess — endless-bliss lake, dearest — stands unparted from You,
so may one love of mine stand — unparted.
s01-v09.sanskrit_cite: anantānandasarasī devī priyatamā yathā | aviyuktāsti te tadvad ekā tvadbhaktir astu me

lines: O All — for lovers, everything causes the gaining of You.
This knowing-road stands threefold: by joy, by sorrow, by bewilderment.
s01-v10.sanskrit_cite: sarva eva bhavallābhahetur bhaktimatāṃ vibho | saṃvinmārgo 'yam āhlādaduḥkhamohais tridhā sthitaḥ

lines: From tasting Your love's nectar, Master — even knowing's highest state
turns in my mouth to unwine-sourness.
s01-v11.sanskrit_cite: bhavadbhaktyamṛtāsvādād bodhasya syāt parāpi yā | daśā sā māṃ prati svāmin nāsavasyeva śuktatā
notes: nāsava read as un-wine (vinegar as anti-wine), answering v05's wine.

lines: Those to whom Your love's great lore has come as practice —
they alone know the real: knowing, unknowing, both.
s01-v12.sanskrit_cite: bhavadbhaktimahāvidyā yeṣām abhyāsam āgatā | vidyāvidyobhayasyāpi tā ete tattvavedinaḥ

lines: This speech-creeper, from the root, opening in order —
sprinkled with Your love's nectar, may its fruit swell with that sap — for me.
s01-v13.sanskrit_cite: āmulād vāglatā seyaṃ kramavisphāraśālinī | tvadbhaktisudhayā siktā tadrasāḍhyaphalāstu me

lines: Be Śiva, then sacrifice — and the lover, become, is so declared.
For You alone are the body's pith, assayed by lovers in oneness.
s01-v14.sanskrit_cite: śivo bhūtvā yajeteti bhakto bhūtveti kathyate | tvam eva hi vapuḥ sāraṃ bhaktair advayaśodhitam
notes: Lakshmanjoo witness: activity-embrace, not shunning — yaj kept as sacrifice, body kept as pith.

lines: For lovers, what is not proof toward oneness with You?
And for the lowest, what but veils — heaped toward failure?
s01-v15.sanskrit_cite: bhaktānāṃ bhavadadvaitasiddhyai kā nopapattayaḥ | tadasiddhyai nikṛṣṭānāṃ kāni nāvaraṇāni vā

lines: Some time, some place, by yoga You may be got — Lord, that's the cheat.
Else how do You shine, here blazing, in every state, for lovers?
s01-v16.sanskrit_cite: kadācit kvāpi labhyo 'si yogenetīśa vañcanā | anyathā sarvakakṣyāsu bhāsi bhaktimatāṃ katham

lines: Untouched by breath-withdrawal and the rest — this is the great difference:
devotion's portion-takers stay gathered even waking — past the yogins.
s01-v17.sanskrit_cite: pratyāhārādyasaṃspṛṣṭo viśeṣo 'sti mahānayam | yogibhyo bhaktibhājām yad vyutthāne 'pi samāhitāḥ

lines: No yoga bidden, no self-burning, no rite-rule — none of it prescribed.
On this straight Śiva-road, love alone is praised.
s01-v18.sanskrit_cite: na yogo na tapo nārcākramaḥ ko 'pi pranīyate | amāye śivamārge 'smin bhaktir ekā praśasyate

lines: My cover fire-shattered from all sides by love's play of light —
I who face all things bare — may even my thoughts perish.
s01-v19.sanskrit_cite: sarvato vilasadbhaktitejodhvastāvṛter mama | pratyakṣasarvabhāvasya cintānām api naśyatu

lines: One word — Śiva — camped on the tongue-tip, always — and every sense-thing tasted.
In lovers only. Whatever that is — ah!
s01-v20.sanskrit_cite: śiva ity ekaśabdasya jihvāgre tiṣṭhataḥ sadā | samastaviṣayāsvādo bhakteṣv evāsti ko 'py aho

lines: In the calm-waved, cool, clear, sweet love-nectar sea — tasting its otherworld sap, steady —
who is counted a nobody?
notes: anāma read as of-no-account (a nobody); the crux is kept as status inversion, not resolved.

lines: Why would the likes of us not chew Your love's great herb —
such a one whose very next taste, Lord, is called freedom?
s01-v22.sanskrit_cite: sādṛśaiḥ kiṃ na carvyeta bhavadbhaktimahauṣadhiḥ | tādṛśī bhagavan yasyā mokṣākhyo 'nantaro rasaḥ

lines: Those alone count as wealth, Lord, by the good's measure —
whatever fattens trusted feasting on Your love's sap.
s01-v23.sanskrit_cite: tā eva paramarthyante sampadaḥ sadbhir īśa yāḥ | tvad bhaktirasasambhogavisrambhaparipoṣikāḥ

lines: They've caught some of love's nectar-pith who, fallen in this passion-mud and all the rest,
come up unsmeared.
s01-v24.sanskrit_cite: bhavadbhaktisudhāsāras taiḥ kim apy upalakṣitaḥ | ye na rāgādi paṅke 'smiṃḷ lipyante patitā api

lines: Powers down to freedom — fruit is just a limb-name on love's ripe creeper.
In some.
s01-v25.sanskrit_cite: aṇimādiṣu mokṣānteṣv aṅgeṣv eva phalābhidhā | bhavadbhakter vipakvāyā latāyā iva keṣu cit

lines: Strange, Lord: this mind, pain-seed by nature — sprinkled with Your love's sap,
ripens into freedom's great fruit.
s01-v26.sanskrit_cite: citraṃ nisargato nātha duḥkhabījam idaṃ manaḥ | tvadbhaktirasasaṃsiktam niḥśreyasamahāphalam

lines: Fire, moon, sun — Brahmā, Viṣṇu — still things, moving things: Your very stuff.
To the many-shaped — to You, shaped of knowing — bow.
s02-v01.sanskrit_cite: agnīṣomaravibrahmaviṣṇusthāvarajaṅgama | svarūpa bahurūpāya namaḥ saṃvinmayāya te

lines: To the great fire — universe for fuel, bright with great ash smeared pure —
to Thee, the Becoming, whose one offering is the world — bow.
To Śiva's fire — cool, thick with highest nectar —
and to some Unequalled, all-devouring when the world burns — homage be to Thee.
s02-v03.sanskrit_cite: paramāmṛtasāndrāya śītalāya śivāgnaye | kasmai cid viśvasaṃploṣaviṣamāya namo 'stu te

lines: To Mahādeva, Rudra, Śaṅkara, Śiva — to Thee, even as Great-Lord — bow.
And to some mantra-bodied one — bow.
s02-v04.sanskrit_cite: mahādevāya rudrāya śaṅkarāya śivāya te | maheśvarāyāpi namaḥ kasmai cin mantramūrtaye

lines: Bow — to Śiva's fire: cut, sucked dry, the three worlds' melted fat His unction —
unequalled though He be, yet kind.
Whose mark is this alone — that no marks meet —
to Him, to God, to gracious some Śambhu — homage be.
s02-v06.sanskrit_cite: samastalakṣanāyoga eva yasyopalakṣaṇam | tasmai namo 'stu devāya kasmai cid api śambhave

lines: To Him against Veda and Āgama, maker of Veda and Āgama, their true essence —
to the hidden Master — bow.
s02-v07.sanskrit_cite: vedāgamaviruddhāya vedāgamavidhāyine | vedāgamasatattvāya guhyāya svāmine namaḥ

lines: Sole maker of the world-round — and its sole unmaker;
round-shaped, round-free — to gracious Śambhu, bow.
s02-v08.sanskrit_cite: saṃsāraikanimittāya saṃsāraikavirodhine | namaḥ samsārarūpāya niḥsaṃsārāya śambhave

lines: To root, middle, tip; shaped as root-middle-tip; tip-middle-root outworn —
to the Full, gracious Śambhu — bow.
s02-v09.sanskrit_cite: mūlāya madhyāyāgrāya mūlamadhyāgramūrtaye | kṣīnāgramadhyamūlāya namaḥ pūrṇāya śambhave

lines: Bow — that taking of the Name, even once, IS merit-heaps ripened.
To Him, Śiva, hard to win — to Thee.
s02-v10.sanskrit_cite: namaḥ sukṛtasaṃbharavipākaḥ sakṛd apy asau | yasya nāmagrahas tasmai durlabhāya śivāya te

lines: Bow — amid heaped crowds of moving and unmoving shapes, ever playing for Thee, the One —
knowing-shaped, skull-wearing.
s02-v11.sanskrit_cite: namaścarācarākāraparetanicayaiḥ sadā | krīḍate tubhyam ekasmai cinmayāya kapāline

lines: To the trickster, the pure; the hidden, the self-shown; the fine, the all-shaped — bow —
to Śambhu, wonder-variegated.
s02-v12.sanskrit_cite: māyāvine viśuddhāya guhyāya prakaṭātmane | sūkṣmāya viśvarūpāya namaś citrāya śambhave
notes: citra holds wonder and variegated at once; kept double.

lines: To all-might — whose sport unmakes the world arrayed by Brahmā, Indra, Viṣṇu —
wonder to be worked — bow to Thee.
Those powers and powers are won by those who roam the shores only —
Bow to Thee — O fathomless Hara-sea.
s02-v14.sanskrit_cite: taṭeṣv eva paribhrāntaiḥ labdhās tās tā vibhūtayaḥ | yasya tasmai namas tubhyam agādhaharasindhave

lines: Dwelling deep in the mud of the Māyā-thick world — unsmeared —
bow to the shining hundred-petalled Śambhu-lotus.
To the kind, the pure; treasure; self-adorned; dear; last-real; highest —
to Thee — bow.
s02-v16.sanskrit_cite: maṅgalāya pavitrāya nidhaye bhūṣaṇātmane | priyāya paramārthāya sarvotkṛṣṭāya te namaḥ

lines: Bow to the ever-bound, ever sharing freedom; lacking bond and freedom both —
to some Śambhu even — bow.
s02-v17.sanskrit_cite: namaḥ satatabaddhāya nityanirmuktibhāgine | bandhamokṣavihīnāya kasmai ci d api śambhave

lines: In all this three-world, whose whole stuff is jeering —
to Thee alone, secondless, ever throned in bliss — bow.
s02-v18.sanskrit_cite: upahāsaikasāre 'sminn etāvati jagattraye | tubhyam evādvitīyāya namo nityasukhāsine

lines: Heart of right-rite, lover of left-rite; all-rite, Śarva, rite-free —
to Thee — bow.
s02-v19.sanskrit_cite: dakṣiṇācārasārāya vāmācārābhilāṣiṇe | sarvācārāya śarvāya nirācārāya te namaḥ

lines: Be it how it may — whoever is worshipped, wherever honored — whoever, whichever god that be —
to him let homage be: to Thee.
s02-v20.sanskrit_cite: yathā tathāpi yaḥ pūjyo yatra tatrāpi yo 'rcitaḥ | yo 'pi vā so 'pi vā yo 'sau devas tasmai namo 'stu te

lines: Served by release-hungers, thief of every fever; spread loveliness at its choicest —
boon-giver — bow to Thee.
s02-v21.sanskrit_cite: mumukṣujanasevyāya sarvasantāpahāriṇe | namo vitatalāvaṇyavarāya varadāya te
notes: vara puns choicest and boon-giver; hārin kept as thief.

lines: Always — three worlds brimmed with unbroken bliss-sap —
bow to Thee, Master of the feast that never ends.
s02-v22.sanskrit_cite: sadā nirantarānandarasanirbharitākhila- | trilokāya namas tubhyaṃ svāmine nityaparvaṇe
notes: parvan kept as feast-day: festival as ontology, not occasion.

lines: Whatever courts Thee — Thee indeed — through pleasure-first tastes, enjoying —
to that dread power-ring of Thine — homage to Thee.
s02-v23.sanskrit_cite: sukhapradhānasaṃvedyasambhogair bhajate ca yat | tvām eva tasmai ghorāya śaktivṛndāya te namaḥ
notes: bhaj kept as court: the powers court Him, we bow to them.

lines: Past even sages' knowing — yet those love-yoked in gesture hold Him fast.
To that some Becoming — bow.
s02-v24.sanskrit_cite: munīnām apy avijñeyaṃ bhaktisambandhaceṣṭitāḥ | āliṅganty api yaṃ tasmai kasmai cid bhavate namaḥ

lines: To highest-nectar's sheath, highest-nectar's heap;
reached past all beyond and no-beyond — to Becoming — bow.
Mantra through and through — I praise Thy form:
clear, cool, lovely with unheard joy, lush with highest-nectar sap.
s02-v26.sanskrit_cite: mahāmantramayaṃ naumi rūpaṃ te svacchaśītalam | apūrvamodasubhagaṃ parāmṛtarasolvaṇam

lines: On oneness-fame's wide canvas, grounded in freedom-nectar's fullness —
where, Lord, wonder simply isn't — that I praise: Thy teaching.
s02-v27.sanskrit_cite: svātantryāmṛtapūrṇatvad aikyakhyātimahāpaṭe | citraṃ nāsty eva yatreśa tan naumi tava śāsanam
notes: paṭa read as painter's canvas; pūrṇatvāt as its ground.

lines: Thunderbolt to every doubt, doomsday-fire to all ill-luck, aeon-end to joylessness —
we bow the Great-Lord road.
s02-v28.sanskrit_cite: sarvāśaṅkāsaniṃ sarvālakṣmīkālānalaṃ tathā | sarvāmaṅgalyakalpāntaṃ mārgaṃ māheśvaraṃ numaḥ
notes: Lakshmanjoo witness: alakṣmī as ill-luck/poverty; numaḥ kept plural — our bowing is the path.

lines: Hail, God! Bow on bow to Thee; all this world leans on Thee;
Thou — worlds' high Lord, One supreme — I am come to Thee for shelter.
s02-v29.sanskrit_cite: jaya deva namo namo 'stu te sakalaṃ viśvam idaṃ tavāśritam | jagatāṃ parameśvaro bhavān paramekaḥ śaraṇāgato 'smi te

lines: Things run double — being, unbeing, the two-yoked course.
Leap it. To the Third — bow to wondrous Śambhu.
s03-v01.sanskrit_cite: sadasattvena bhāvānāṃ yuktā yā dvitayī gatiḥ | tām ullaṅghya tṛtīyasmai namaś citrāya śambhave

lines: Gods, seers, men — this triple world unfree.
But free are they who live off Thee alone, O Free — Thy hangers-on.
s03-v02.sanskrit_cite: āsurarṣijanād asminn asvatantre jagattraye | svatantrās te svatantrasya ye tavaivānujīvinaḥ

lines: Thy body, gem-set with the whole world —
remembering it: the one medicine for existence-pain. Who hold it, sit easy.
s03-v03.sanskrit_cite: aśeṣaviśvakhacitabhavadvapur anusmṛtiḥ | yeṣām bhavarujām ekaṃ bheṣajaṃ te sukhāsinaḥ

lines: Whose white parasol is the moon, lit with its own light;
whose whisk is heaven-river's rush — He alone is high Lord.
s03-v04.sanskrit_cite: sitātapatraṃ yasyenduḥ svaprabhāparipūritaḥ | cāmaraṃ svardhunīsrotaḥ sa ekaḥ parameśvaraḥ

lines: Bright, cool, single, pure — like a moon-sliver —
deal me a glance, Lord, any at all, nectar-flowing.
s03-v05.sanskrit_cite: prakāśāṃ śītalām ekāṃ śuddhāṃ śaśikalām iva | dṛśaṃ vitara me nātha kām apy amṛtavāhinīm

lines: Drops fallen from Thy knowing-bliss sea — these knowings —
why, Lord, in my mouth not nectar-sweet, not lovely?
s03-v06.sanskrit_cite: tvaccidānandajaladheś cyutāḥ saṃvittivipruṣaḥ | imāḥ kathaṃ me bhagavan nāmṛtāsvādasundarāḥ

lines: Hearts undipped in Thy love-sap, Lord —
whose are so, Master, are heartless, nothing else: such are contempt's seat.
s03-v07.sanskrit_cite: tvayi rāgarase nātha na magnaṃ hṛdayaṃ prabho | yeṣām ahṛdayā eva te 'vajñaspadam īdṛśāḥ

lines: Whose heart has met with Thine, Lord —
he, he alone, holds the ruling Ladies' powers: their one high vessel.
s03-v08.sanskrit_cite: prabhuṇā bhavatā yasya jātaṃ hṛdayamelanam | prābhavīṇāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ paramekaḥ sa bhājanam

lines: Drowner of joys, then sorrows — all, alike —
Thy thought-nectar in flood, over low ground, as water seeks it.
s03-v09.sanskrit_cite: harṣāṇām atha śokānāṃ sarveṣāṃ plāvakaḥ samam | bhavaddhyānāmṛtāpūro nimnāṇimnabhuvām iva

lines: What would their eyes not hold, brimmed with joy-stores —
they who, by more than life, Lord, nowhere ever leave Thee?
s03-v10.sanskrit_cite: keva na syād dṛśā teṣāṃ sukhasambhāranirbharā | yeṣām ātmādhikeneśa na kvāpi virahas tvayā

lines: I thunder — ah! — I dance: my mind-chariots ride full, for my Master is won —
since Thou, Thou utterly delightest.
s03-v11.sanskrit_cite: garjāmi bata nṛtyāmi pūrṇā mama manorathāḥ | svāmī mamaiṣa ghaṭito yat tvam atyantarocanaḥ

lines: No other known for doing, no other yoke for knowing —
and yet, what of knowing? Thou — all-one-full Knowing — unfoldest.
s03-v12.sanskrit_cite: nānyad vedyaṃ kriyā yatra nānyo yogo vidā ca yat | jñānaṃ syāt kiṃ tu viśvaikapūrṇā cittvaṃ vijṛmbhate

lines: Hard, endless pains — suddenly out of their grip, fled —
from whom? Those in whose speech rings ever the Śiva-din.
s03-v13.sanskrit_cite: durjayānām anantānām duḥkhānāṃ sahasaiva te | hastāt palāyitā yeṣāṃ vāci śaśvacchivadhvaniḥ

lines: Is there another high One, marked by remaining Thine?
Thou alone art the great Person — shelter of persons, none left out.
s03-v14.sanskrit_cite: uttamaḥ puruṣo 'nyo 'sti yuṣmaccheṣaviśeṣitaḥ | tvaṃ mahāpuruṣas tv eko niḥśeṣapuruṣāśrayaḥ

lines: They win — Thy slaves, honored by the world, O world-pervader —
for whom this very passing-sea is a play-lake.
s03-v15.sanskrit_cite: jayanti te jagadvandyā dāsās te jagatāṃ vibho | saṃsārārṇava evaiṣa yeṣāṃ krīḍāmahāsaraḥ

lines: Let other miseries sit a while —
here, for Thy partakers, appear plain, Thou — by that alone they are shamed.
s03-v16.sanskrit_cite: āsatāṃ tāvad anyāni dainyānīha bhavajjuṣām | tvam eva prakaṭībhūyā ity anenaiva lajjyate

lines: 'Naught beyond me' — yet even there I tell my beads, one with that.
In truth: 'murmur on' — with bead-strand Thou pointest onward.
s03-v17.sanskrit_cite: matparaṃ nāsti tatrāpi jāpako 'smi tadaikyataḥ | tattvena japa ity akṣamālayā diśasi kvacit

lines: From being, needs must, highest being — and being past even that, Lord. And Thou —
other than being, other than unbeing — so art Thou being-unbeing-stuff.
s03-v18.sanskrit_cite: sato 'vaśyaṃ paramasat sac ca tasmāt paraṃ prabho | tvaṃ cāsataḥ sataś cānyas tenāsi sadasanmayaḥ

lines: Purer-bright than a thousand suns raying up —
yet Thou, though through all worlds spread, art not seen.
s03-v19.sanskrit_cite: sahasrasūryakiraṇādhikaśuddhaprakāśavān | api tvaṃ sarvabhuvanavyāpako 'pi na dṛśyase

lines: Knowing-shaped in the dead world, they say —
knower inside the known; mighty in the measured: since Thou art so — highest of all, Lord.
s03-v20.sanskrit_cite: jaḍe jagati cidrūpaḥ kila vedye 'pi vedakaḥ | vibhur mite ca yenāsi tena sarvottamo bhavān

lines: Enough of other wailings — just this, before the Lord: I keen aloud —
for, Lord, I swoon, knowing even so.
s03-v21.sanskrit_cite: alam ākranditair anyair iyad eva puraḥ prabhoḥ | tīvraṃ viraumi yan nātha muhyāmy evaṃ vidann api

lines: Fickle though thou be, mind —
praised even so, since thou courtst the refuge of refuges, worlds' teacher, Ambikā's husband.
s04-v01.sanskrit_cite: capalam asi yad api mānasa tatrāpi ślāghyase yato bhajase | śaraṇānām api śaraṇaṃ tribhuvanagurum ambikākāntam

lines: Stairs of sundry gods climbed past, Śiva's feet reached and held —
yet the low ground I keep even today. Strange — I quit it not.
s04-v02.sanskrit_cite: ullaṅghya vividhadaivatasopānakramam upeya śivacaraṇān | āśrityāpy adharatarāṃ bhūmiṃ nādyāpi citram ujjhāmi

lines: Show Thine own road, shutter all world-doings tight —
while I am, Lord, Thy servant now, ever risen.
s04-v03.sanskrit_cite: prakaṭaya nijam adhvānaṃ sthagayatarām akhilalokacaritāni | yāvad bhavāmi bhagavaṃs tava sapadi sadodito dāsaḥ

lines: Śiva! Śiva! Śambhu! Śaṅkara! O lover of comers-for-shelter —
pity, and swift! Who bends on remembering Thy paired lotus-feet — fortunes, not far.
s04-v04.sanskrit_cite: śiva śiva śambho śaṅkara śaraṇāgatavatsalāśu kuru karuṇām | tava caraṇakamalayugalasmaraṇaparasya hi sampado 'dūre

lines: Dissolved in Thy foot-lotus seat, making the world to taste —
they laugh at Viriñci, office-smeared, unmastered by himself, Lord.
s04-v05.sanskrit_cite: tāvakāṅghrikamalāsanalīnā ye yathāruci jagad racayanti | te viriñcim adhikāramalenāliptam asvavaśam īśa hasanti

lines: Naught can show apart from Thy light-body —
so, Lord, art Thou ever already won, Master, though far by nature.
s04-v06.sanskrit_cite: tvatprakāśavapuṣo na vibhinnaṃ kiṃ cana prabhavati pratibhātum | tat sadaiva bhagavan parilabdho 'sīśvara prakṛtito 'pi vidūraḥ

lines: Thy foot-lotus sap — some sup as overnight-stale difference-fare;
but some taste it fresh-poured: shining, whole-bodied, void of two.
s04-v07.sanskrit_cite: pādapaṅkajarasaṃ tava ke cid bhedaparyuṣitavṛttim upetāḥ | ke canāpi rasayanti tu sadhyo bhātam akṣatavapur dvayaśūnyam

lines: Lord, like daybreak lightning shines my nectar-smeared —
would she hold but steadier, then art Thou duly worshipped. What more?
s04-v08.sanskrit_cite: nātha vidyud iva bhāti vibhāte yā kadā cana mamāmṛtadigdhā | sā yadi sthirataraiva bhavet tat pūjito 'si vidhivat kim utānyat

lines: 'Thing or unthing —
is aught beyond this?' thus with high discernment resolved: as Thou art, be Thou bare to me.
s04-v09.sanskrit_cite: sarvam asyaparam asti na kiṃ cid vastv avastu yadi veti mahatyā | prajñāya vyavasito 'tra yathaiva tvaṃ tathaiva bhava suprakaṭo me

lines: By Thine own will alone, Lord, on Thine own road I was set walking —
by the Lord Himself. Why then walk I mere folk-like, kenning naught worthy of Thy feet?
s04-v10.sanskrit_cite: svecchayaiva bhagavan nijamārge kāritaḥ padam ahaṃ prabhunaiva | tat kathaṃ janavad eva carāmi tvatpadocitam avaimi na kiṃ cit

lines: Some god of Thine blooms in their hearts — a lovely high mood.
Thy story-cloud's thunder — its cātakas, by it made lovely, long.
s04-v11.sanskrit_cite: ko 'pi deva hṛdi teṣu tāvako jṛmbhate subhagabhāva uttamaḥ | tvatkathāmbudaninādacātakā yena te 'pi subhagīkṛtāś ciram

lines: Thy partakers — by some play in Thee this love has grown fat:
on parting-ground, talk, remembrance too, fruit a union-feast.
s04-v12.sanskrit_cite: tvajjuṣāṃ tvayi kayāpi līlayā rāga eṣa paripoṣam āgataḥ | yad viyogabhuvi saṅkathā tathā saṃsmṛtiḥ phalati saṃgamotsavam

lines: Grown by strange-sap watering — 'Śaṅkara!' hundredfold though uttered —
the word slips even into slant hearts, its errand ever fresh.
s04-v13.sanskrit_cite: yo vicitrarasasekavardhitaḥ śaṅkareti śataśo 'py udīritaḥ | śabda āviśati tiryagāśayeṣv apy ayaṃ navanavaprayojanaḥ

lines: They win on whose face-orbs circles ever the Śiva-din —
which, moonlike, streaming from nectar's seat, trickles sweet supreme nectar.
s04-v14.sanskrit_cite: te jayanti mukhamaṇḍale bhraman asti yeṣu niyataṃ śivadhvaniḥ | yaḥ śāśīva prasṛto 'mṛtāśayāt svādu saṃsravati cāmṛtaṃ param

lines: The fierce world as if done; mind-stain melted thin —
yet at Thy city, bolt-and-door, not one atom of knocking.
s04-v15.sanskrit_cite: parisamāptam ivogram idaṃ jagad vigalito 'viralo manaso malaḥ | tad api nāsti bhavatpurārgalakavāṭavighaṭṭanam aṇva pi

lines: Hungry for one gaze into Thy ever-bloom face-lotus's heart —
do aught, Lord, the merest: flash Thou facing me.
s04-v16.sanskrit_cite: satataphullabhavanmukhapaṅkajodaravilokanalālasacetasaḥ | kim api tat kuru nātha manāg iva sphurasi yena mamābhimukhasthitiḥ

lines: What joy here but thought of Thy undifference — what other glory?
Why then does this slave of Thine go wrong-road, forsaking her?
s04-v17.sanskrit_cite: tvadavibhedamater aparaṃ nu kiṃ sukham ihāsti vibhūtir athāparā | tad iha tāvakadāsajanasya kiṃ kupatham eti manaḥ parihṛtya tām

lines: Never for an instant here unfit for Thy serfdom may I be —
unless I sip, loving, unceasing, Thy undifference-wine.
s04-v18.sanskrit_cite: kṣaṇam apīha na tāvakadāsatāṃ prati bhaveyam ahaṃ kila bhājanam | bhavadabhedarasāsavam ādarād avirataṃ rasayeyam ahaṃ na cet

lines: Folk see not, truly, Thy body — two-sight-dirtied. Yet Thou, all-knowing, shelter-tender —
why hearest Thou not this wail of mine?
s04-v19.sanskrit_cite: na kila paśyati satyam ayaṃ janas tava vapur dvayadṛṣṭimalīmasaḥ | tad api sarvavidāśritavatsalaḥ kim idam āraṭitaṃ na śṛṇoṣi me

lines: Rememberest Thou, Lord, e'er a sense-joy I wished —
or e'er asked? Give ever Thy body-beholding nectar — my one wish. Give it.
s04-v20.sanskrit_cite: smarasi nātha kadācid apīhitaṃ viṣayasaukhyam athāpi mayārthitam | satatam eva bhavadvapurīkṣaṇāmṛtamabhīṣṭamalaṃ mama dehi tat

lines: Since foot I've set, Great-Lord, on Thy Śiva-road — by Thy will —
fair hundreds rose for me at once. What more hunt I from Thee, Master?
s04-v21.sanskrit_cite: kila yadaiva śivādhvani tāvake kṛtapado 'smi maheśa tavecchayā | śubhaśatānyuditāni tadaiva me kim aparaṃ mṛgaye bhavataḥ prabho

lines: Where sun goes down with moon and all their train —
what a Śiva-night reigns, self-light outspread and lustrous.
s04-v22.sanskrit_cite: yatra so 'stam ayam eti vivasvāṃś candramaḥ prabhṛtibhiḥ saha sarvaiḥ | kāpi sā vijayate śivarātriḥ svaprabhāprasarabhāsvararūpā

lines: Three worlds' overlordship won — yet, God-king, I reckon it sapless, all —
wanting Thy foot-touch nectar-sap.
s04-v23.sanskrit_cite: apy upārjitam ahaṃ triṣu lokeṣv adhipatyam amareśvara manye | nīrasaṃ tad akhilaṃ bhavadaṅghrisparśanāmṛtarasena vihīnam

lines: Alas, Lord — tough, this self-bond, Thy-unrecognition-made, tied by Thee alone:
scorning Thee first of all, it slackens not one jot.
s04-v24.sanskrit_cite: bata nātha dṛḍho 'yam ātmabandho bhavadakhyātimayas tvayaiva kḷptaḥ | yad ayaṃ prathamānam eva me tvām avadhīrya ślathate na leśato 'pi

lines: God-king — though worshipped by the great, ever Thou standest worshiper-shaped alone;
seen without, within, here, Thou flashest in seer-bodies — ever.
s04-v25.sanskrit_cite: mahatām amareśa pūjyamāno 'py aniśaṃ tiṣṭhasi pūjakaikarūpaḥ | bahirantarapīha dṛśyamānaḥ sphurasi draṣṭṛśarīra eva śaśvat

lines: Wedded in joy by mere brush of Thy lotus-feet —
take me by the scruff, Lord, into Thine own house.
My hair dyed red with Thy foot-lotus dust —
when shall I, in boundless frenzy, break into dance?
Thou my sole Lord — this much alone I beg, ever: dumb, dwelling inside Thee may I be —
never otherwise, O Wise One.
s05-v03.sanskrit_cite: tvad ekanātho bhagavann iyad evārthaye sadā | tvadantarvasatir mūko bhaveyaṃ mānyathā budhaḥ

lines: Ah, nectar-hoard, Master! Ah, sweet Three-eyed!
Ah, tasty Deformed-eyed! — so may I dance, yelling.
s05-v04.sanskrit_cite: aho sudhānidhe svāminn aho mṛṣṭa trilocana | aho svādo virūpakṣety eva nṛtyeyam āraṭan

lines: Eyes half-shut with Thy foot-lotus touch —
may I gape wide, reeling with Thy love-wine's drunkenness.
Mind-mountain on earth, may I dwell anywhere, All —
where that practice runs unbroken, deep-sapped, made of Thy babble.
s05-v06.sanskrit_cite: cittabhūbhṛd bhuvi vibho vaseyaṃ kvāpi yatra sā | nirantaratvatpralāpamayī vṛttir mahārasā

lines: Where Thou standest with the Lady, many-shaped, from palace to gate-tower —
in that town may I dwell.
s05-v07.sanskrit_cite: yatra devīsametas tvam āsaudhādā ca gopurāt | bahurūpaḥ sthitas tasmin vāstavyaḥ syām ahaṃ pure

lines: May Thy sun-rays sport, Lord, till this heart-lotus of mine opens —
for Thy worship.
s05-v08.sanskrit_cite: samullasantu bhagavan bhavadbhānumarīcayaḥ | vikasatveṣa yāvan me hṛtpadmaḥ pūjanāya te

lines: Be gracious, Lord —
that my mind, ever fallen at Thy feet, tasting this and that, melt as wax, run.
s05-v09.sanskrit_cite: prasīda bhagavan yena tvatpade patitaṃ sadā | mano me tattadāsvādya kṣīved iva galed iva

lines: From joy though it blow pot-lids, or from sorrow —
from outward feeling, inward feeling — show plain to me, Master.
s05-v10.sanskrit_cite: praharṣād vātha śokād vā yadi kuṅyād dhaṭād api | bāhyād athāntarād bhāvāt prakaṭībhava me prabho

lines: Without too, within too —
may that ever-oozing be mine: Thy foot-lotus-touch nectar, cool past cool.
s05-v11.sanskrit_cite: bahir apy antar api tat syandamānaṃ sadāstu me | bhavatpādāmbujasparśāmṛtam atyantaśītalam

lines: Dived deep in Thy touch-nectar lake —
O what a joy past joys, leaping all enjoyment — be mine, ever.
s05-v12.sanskrit_cite: tvatpādasaṃsparśasudhāsaraso 'ntarnimajjanam | ko 'py eṣa sarvasambhogalaṅghī bhogo 'stu me sadā

lines: Take the laid offering — passions and the rest, Lord, by me; take, nectarize, and feast —
with lover-folk, together.
s05-v13.sanskrit_cite: niveditam upādatsva rāgādi bhagavan mayā | ādāya cāmṛtīkṛtya bhuṅkṣva bhaktajanaiḥ samam

lines: Ever sated on whole-world food, easy-seated —
Master, take among slaves one grace-glance-instant.
s05-v14.sanskrit_cite: aśeṣabhuvanāhāranityatṛptaḥ sukhāsanam | svāmin gṛhāṇa dāseṣu prasādālokanakṣaṇam

lines: Half-eyed, chewing inner love-wonder —
'bow to me, to Śiva' — worshiping, may I be, even straws.
s05-v15.sanskrit_cite: antarbhakticamatkāracarvaṇāmīlitekṣaṇaḥ | namo mahyaṃ śivāyeti pūjayam syāṃ tṛṇāny api

lines: Though Thy state be won — seeing the world my self-blaze —
by love-sap feastings may I stay unparted.
s05-v16.sanskrit_cite: api labdhabhavadbhāvaḥ svātmollāsamayaṃ jagat | paśyan bhaktirasābhogair bhaveyam aviyojitaḥ

lines: Since naught else is to be longed for, Lord —
Thine — secondless — fullness is but fit.
s05-v17.sanskrit_cite: ākāmkṣaṇīyam aparaṃ yena nātha na vidyate | tava tenādvitīyasya yuktaṃ yat paripūrṇatā

lines: Where 'tis laughed, 'tis danced —
where hates-and-loves are eaten, love-nectar drunk — may I win that foot-place.
s05-v18.sanskrit_cite: hasyate nṛtyate yatra rāgadveṣādi bhujyate | pīyate bhaktipīyūṣarasas tat prāpnuyāṃ padam

lines: That unheard-perfume — Thy-thought-blossoms' scent —
harden in my mind, till ill-habit's stink is eaten.
s05-v19.sanskrit_cite: tat tad apūrvāmodatvaccintākusumavāsanā dṛḍhatām | etu mama manasi yāvann aśyatu durvāsanāgandhaḥ

lines: Where, pray, love among passions —
and where loving 'mid Hara's foot-lotuses? So teach my clash-fond heart its good, Deathless.
s05-v20.sanskrit_cite: kva nu rāgādiṣu rāgaḥ kva ca haracaraṇāmbujeṣu rāgitvam | itthaṃ virodharasikaṃ bodhaya hitam amara me hṛdayam

lines: Roaming yoga-states even, turned from sense-things even —
Thy-thought-wine's frenzy liquifying my heart — only that may I be.
s05-v21.sanskrit_cite: vicaran yogadaśāsv api viṣayavyāvṛttivartamāno 'pi | tvaccintāmadirāmadataralīkṛtahṛdaya eva syām

lines: Speech, mind-thoughts, sense-wrought body-moves —
everywhere, ever, may love-sap run vanguard before me.
s05-v22.sanskrit_cite: vāci manomatiṣu tathā śarīraceṣṭāsu karaṇaracitāsu | sarvatra sarvadā me puraḥsaro bhavatu bhaktirasaḥ

lines: 'Śiva Śiva Śiva' — Thy name muttered without end, Lord —
tasting may I be some great unre-said sap.
s05-v23.sanskrit_cite: śivaśivaśiveti nāmani tava niravadhi nātha japyamāne 'smin | āsvādayan bhaveyaṃ kam api mahārasam apunaruktam

lines: Vast flashing endless knowing-self — dull roads all drunk dry —
ramparts uncounted, knowing-made — may I roam, by Thee honored.
s05-v24.sanskrit_cite: sphuradanantacidātmakaviṣṭape parinipītasamastajaḍādhvani | agaṇitāparacinmayagaṇḍike pravicareyam ahaṃ bhavato 'rcitā

lines: Standing in self-body, clear-shining, everlasting —
naught else avails. Firm be this thought. Yet — Thy foot-lotus dust, O Pure.
s05-v25.sanskrit_cite: svavapuṣi sphuṭabhāsini śāśvate sthitikṛte na kim apy upayujyate | iti matiḥ sudṛḍhā bhavatāt paraṃ mama bhavaccaraṇābjarajaḥ śuceḥ

lines: Something, Lord, sometime flashes in mind —
touchers of Thy foot-sole, where this whole melts — in nectar's lake show me this world, ever.
s05-v26.sanskrit_cite: kim api nātha kadācana cetasi sphurati tad bhavadaṃghritalaspṛśām | galati yatra samastamidaṃ sudhāsarasi viśvam idaṃ diśa me sadā

lines: Though parted from Thee, Ruler, though it be a mere instant —
I ever thick-burning: may I be ground for Thy glance.
s06-v01.sanskrit_cite: kṣaṇamātram apīśāna viyuktasya tvayā mama | nibiḍaṃ tapyamānasya sadā bhūyā dṛśaḥ padam

lines: In parting-pithed passing — by Thee, dear Master —
may I be ever unparted, though from the world parted.
s06-v02.sanskrit_cite: viyogasāre saṃsāre priyeṇa prabhuṇā tvayā | aviyuktaḥ sadaiva syāṃ jagatāpi viyojitaḥ

lines: Body, speech, mind — where I go with them, all is Thou alone.
May this highest truth stand full for me, ever.
s06-v03.sanskrit_cite: kāyavāṅmanasair yatra yāmi sarvaṃ tvam eva tat | ity eṣa paramārtho 'pi paripūrṇo 'stu me sadā

lines: Thought-free as Thou, great-bliss-full as Thou —
so may my praise-making speech match, and only match.
s06-v04.sanskrit_cite: nirvikalpo mahānandapūrṇo yadvad bhavāṃs tathā | bhavatstutikarī bhūyād anurūpaiva vāṅ mama

lines: Held by Thee — seeing thing and thing Thou-made —
may I roam longing-free, joy-brimmed.
s06-v05.sanskrit_cite: bhavadāveśataḥ paśyan bhāvaṃ bhāvaṃ bhavanmayam | vicareyaṃ nirākāṅkṣaḥ praharṣaparipūritaḥ

lines: Lord, may I see the all-world full of Thy being —
with that alone content. Then — no more wearing.
s06-v06.sanskrit_cite: bhagavanbhavataḥ pūrṇam paśyeyam akhilaṃ jagat | tāvataivāsmi santuṣṭas tato na parikhidyase

lines: Melting in Thee alone — like cloud-shreds in sky —
may things shine for me, ever, step by step stainless.
s06-v07.sanskrit_cite: vilīyamānās tvayy eva vyomni meghalavā iva | bhāvā vibhāntu me śaśvat kramanairmalyagāminaḥ

lines: Self-light outspread, shattering the endless dark-train —
shine for me ever: some jewel of Thy being, from Thy middle.
s06-v08.sanskrit_cite: svaprabhāprasaradhvastāparyantadhvāntasantatiḥ | santataṃ bhātu me ko 'pi bhavamadhyād bhavanmaṇiḥ

lines: What ground rulest Thou not? What could it be, not Thy body? Weary —
thereby, by no-effort, may I win Thee everywhere.
s06-v09.sanskrit_cite: kāṃ bhūmikāṃ nādhiśeṣe kiṃ tat syād yan na te vapuḥ | śrāntas tenāprayāsena sarvatas tvām avāpnuyām

lines: Thy limb-embrace's joy — by my will alone may it befall me.
This much won — what, Lord, have I not won?
s06-v10.sanskrit_cite: bhavadaṅgapariṣvaṅgasambhogaḥ svecchayaiva me | ghaṭatām iyati prāpte kiṃ nātha na jitaṃ mayā

lines: Show plain! With no other prayers importune we Thee, Lord —
fainting, Thee alone we hunt.
s06-v11.sanskrit_cite: prakaṭībhava nānyābhiḥ prārthanābhiḥ kadarthanāḥ | kurmas te nātha tāmyantas tvām eva mṛgayāmahe

lines: Come to same-sap in Thee, bliss-river —
may my mind drop in one go, Lord, this great disaster of difference-dependence.
s07-v01.sanskrit_cite: tvayy ānandasarasvati samarasatām etya nātha mama cetaḥ pariharatu sakṛd iyantaṃ bhedādhīnaṃ mahānartham

lines: 'Mine this, not that' —
on passion-hate's fetter-hard root, Lord, may the axe fall within: certainty of Thee-made-oneness.
s07-v02.sanskrit_cite: etan mama na tv idam iti rāgadveṣādinigaḍadṛḍhamūle nātha bhavanmayataikyapratyayaparaśuḥ patatvantaḥ

lines: Melt, thought-stain-string; sport, unboltedness, in heart.
Bliss-sap-flooded be my knowing-made form, Lord.
s07-v03.sanskrit_cite: galatu vikalpakalaṅkāvalī samullasatu hṛdi nirargalatā bhagavann ānandarasaplutāstu me cinmayī mūrtiḥ

lines: Me, wallowing in passion's world-egg —
O Thy-love-thought Mother, plump me with sap on sap, that wing-grown I turn sky-goer.
s07-v04.sanskrit_cite: rāgādimayabhavāṇḍakaluṭhitaṃ tvadbhaktibhāvanāmbikā tais taiḥ āpyāyayatu rasair māṃ pravṛddhapakṣo yathā bhavāmi khagaḥ

lines: May this mind of mine win connoisseurship —
savoring Thy-foot-thought-nectar-sap's pith — till sense-poison-clinging hankers no more.
By Thy-love-sun's ray-touch may this mind-jewel
of mine shed far-off passion-kindled fire-sparks.
In that station may I hymn Thee ever, full-throated —
where Viṣṇu, Indra, Brahmā wait outside.
s07-v07.sanskrit_cite: tasmin pade bhavantaṃ satatam upaślokayeyam atyuccaiḥ hariharyaśvaviriñcā api yatra bahiḥ pratīkṣante

lines: By whirl born of love's whirl may I see, senses whole:
the all-world Śiva-made, all doings worship-made.
s07-v08.sanskrit_cite: bhaktimadajanitavibhramavaśena paśyeyam avikalaṃ karaṇaiḥ śivamayam akhilaṃ lokaṃ kriyāś ca pūjāmayī sakalāḥ

lines: My mind-lad has wed Thy-love-clan's lady; she has borne him power-sons.
Firm-rooted, may she harden the 'mine'-thought.
A grace-drop, Lord-abiding; devotion, as if, nearing me —
the two, each in other — when will they root in such a body?
s08-v01.sanskrit_cite: yaḥ prasādalava īśvarasthito yā ca bhaktir iva mām upeyuṣī tau parasparasamanvitau kadā tādṛśe vapuṣi rūḍhim eṣyataḥ

lines: Born of chewing Thy mastery whole —
may some contentment-sap rise within; ever here be highest for me — knowledge, yoga, glories far off.
s08-v02.sanskrit_cite: tvatprabhutvaparicarvaṇajanmā ko 'py udetu paritoṣaraso 'ntaḥ sarvakālam iha me param astu jñānayogamahimādi vidūre

lines: Worldlike be my thirst 'mid sense-things —
swollen full, utter, Lord. Only as Thy body may I behold them — I, thought-unbuilt.
s08-v03.sanskrit_cite: lokavadbhavatu me viṣayeṣu sphīta eva bhagavanparitarṣaḥ kevalaṃ tava śarīratayaitān+ lokayeyam aham astavikalpaḥ

lines: In body-grounds, in mind, Thou — where breath's run has met difference —
and on those knowing-paths: thereby, by Thine own self, be plain to me.
s08-v04.sanskrit_cite: dehabhūmiṣu tathā manasi tvaṃ prāṇavartmani ca bhedam upete saṃvidaḥ pathiṣu teṣu ca tena svātmanā mama bhava sphuṭarūpaḥ

lines: May these thrilled sense-plays of mine fall each to its own seat —
never, Lord, not an instant, not a jot, the outrage: wounding Thy undifference-sap.
s08-v05.sanskrit_cite: nijanijeṣu padeṣu patantv imāḥ karaṇavṛttaya ullasitā mama kṣaṇamapīśa manāg api maiva bhūt tvadavibhedarasakṣatisāhasam

lines: Light, soft, white, clear, cool — by Thy possession-force picturing a body —
may I stride past those dealings of the all-things' road.
s08-v06.sanskrit_cite: laghumasṛṇasitācchaśītalaṃ bhavadāveśavaśena bhāvayan vapur akhilapadārthapaddhater vyavahārān ativartayeya tān

lines: Bloom, my body, Thou-natured; come, worlds, to my limbhood. Pass, all this two-sport —
though on memory's road it come — to untellability.
s08-v07.sanskrit_cite: vikasatu svavapur bhavadātmakaṃ samupayāntu jaganti mamāṅgatām vrajatu sarvam idaṃ dvayavalgitaṃ smṛtipathopagame 'py anupākhyatām

lines: Rise — O glance at such a face of Thine! highest-nectar deluge —
befall me, till filled the dread gorge of Thy unshown oneness.
s08-v08.sanskrit_cite: samudiyād api tādṛśatāvakānana viloka parāmṛtasamplavaḥ mama ghaṭeta yathā bhavadadvayāprathanaghoradarīparipūraṇam

lines: If ever, dusted thinnest with Thy meeting-nectar-drops, I turn not from all world-joys —
or fallen from both — what then?
s08-v09.sanskrit_cite: api kadācana tāvakasaṅgamāmṛtakaṇācchuraṇena tanīyasā sakalalokasukheṣu parāṅmukho na bhavitāsmy ubhayacyuta eva kim

lines: I, choice hamsa, ever wading Thy foot-lotus-lake —
above, from root-depth, from within: bend up, love's lotus-stalk — O Unborn.
s08-v10.sanskrit_cite: satatam eva bhavaccaraṇāmbujākaracarasya hi haṃsavarasya me upari mūlatalād api cāntarād upanamatv aja bhaktimṛṇālikā

lines: Come, All, all things —
'neath thought's reach, 'neath sight's footing for me; sight-thought-shine-nectar-piths — shimmer supreme.
s08-v11.sanskrit_cite: upayāntu vibho samastavastūny api cintāviṣayaṃ dṛśaḥ padaṃ ca mama darśanacintanaprakāśāmṛtasārāṇi paraṃ parisphurantu

lines: High-Lord, in strait on strait, when names themselves bow down —
may I be not merely fear-gone, but, Thy limbs lending, joy-mad past measure.
s08-v12.sanskrit_cite: parameśvara teṣu teṣu kṛcchreṣv api nāmopanamatsv ahaṃ bhaveyam na paraṃ gatabhīs tvadaṅgasaṅgādupajātādhikasammado 'pi yāvat

lines: Woven in Thy self, the world — by Thee alone shown outside.
What hard resolve holds — now may it shine plain.
s08-v13.sanskrit_cite: bhavadātmani viśvam umbhitaṃ yad bhavataivāpi bahiḥ prakāśyate tat iti yad dṛḍhaniścayopajuṣṭaṃ tad idāniṃ sphuṭam eva bhāsatām

lines: When will my mind — keen to taste the wet-and-wet wedding of fresh sap —
rush past all else to Thy touch?
s09-v01.sanskrit_cite: kadā navarasārdrārdrasambhogāsvādanotsukam pravarteta vihāyānyan mama tvatsparśane manaḥ

lines: Dyed with Thee alone, rich only in Thy foot-worship —
when shall I face Thee face to face, I, keen?
s09-v02.sanskrit_cite: tvadekaraktas tvatpādapūjāmātramahādhanaḥ kadā sākṣātkariṣyāmi bhavantam ayam utsukaḥ

lines: By thick love's force past-caring grown —
when, crash! all great bolts burst, shall I near Thee?
s09-v03.sanskrit_cite: gāḍhānurāgavaśato nirapekṣībhūtamānaso 'smi kadā paṭapaṭiti vighaṭitākhilamahārgalas tvām upaiṣyāmi

lines: Heart-throned in my knowing's pith, all gods —
when, Lord, shall I bring 'neath my spell, by Thy love's might?
s09-v04.sanskrit_cite: svasaṃvitsārahṛdayādhiṣṭhānāḥ sarvadevatāḥ kadā nātha vaśīkuryāṃ bhavadbhaktiprabhāvataḥ

lines: When be mine, All, love-bliss-sap's teeming feast —
where apartness itself takes name from beholding-joy?
s09-v05.sanskrit_cite: kadā me syād vibho bhūri bhaktyānandarasotsavaḥ yadālokasukhānandī pṛthaṅ nāmāpi lapsyate

lines: The Lord — fearless, lavish, full, causeless, self-denied —
known in a flash: when shall I shame the Master's men?
s09-v06.sanskrit_cite: īśvaram abhayam udāraṃ pūrṇam akāraṇam apahnutātmānaṃ sahasābhijñāya kadā svāmijanaṃ lajjayiṣyāmi

lines: When, Lord, win I that, whatever, Thy belovedness —
whereby from me nowhere flight were fit for Thee?
s09-v07.sanskrit_cite: kadā kām api tāṃ nātha tava vallabhatām iyām yayā māṃ prati na kvāpi yuktaṃ te syāt palāyitum

lines: All breathing things — truth-told —
Thy-worship-made selves: by their applauding-glance-sap flooded may I be — when, All?
s09-v08.sanskrit_cite: tattvato 'śeṣajantūnāṃ bhavatpūjāmayātmanām dṛṣṭyānumoditarasāplāvitaḥ syāṃ kadā vibho

lines: Knowing's highest ground, yoga's highest pitch —
Thy love. All, when be my begging for it full?
s09-v09.sanskrit_cite: jñānasya paramā bhūmir yogasya paramā daśā tvadbhaktir yā vibho karhi pūrṇa me syāt tadarthitā

lines: Seizing sudden, gripping hard, joy-helpless I —
when shall Thy foot-treasure-choice to all be shown?
s09-v10.sanskrit_cite: sahasaivasādya kadā gāḍham avaṣṭabhya harṣavivaśo 'ham tvaccaraṇavaranidhānaṃ sarvasya prakaṭayiṣyāmi

lines: Round about Thy-pure-shine-spread —
when be I so, Ruler, no Māyā-shade-pit in me may be?
s09-v11.sanskrit_cite: paritaḥ prasaracchuddhatvadālokamayaḥ kadā syāṃ yatheśa na kiñcin me māyācchāyābilaṃ bhavet

lines: All circles made my own, past needing —
when, Lord, be I Thy lover-host's head?
s09-v12.sanskrit_cite: ātmasātkṛtaniḥśeṣamaṇḍalo nirvyapekṣakaḥ kadā bhaveyaṃ bhagavaṃs tvadbhaktagaṇanāyakaḥ

lines: Lord, of world-prides Thou the unheard ground —
great-pride when be I, Thy love-sap-filled?
s09-v13.sanskrit_cite: nātha lokābhimānānām apūrvaṃ tvaṃ nibandhanam mahābhimānaḥ karhi syāṃ tvadbhaktirasapūritaḥ

lines: Well-set in never-empty glory-embrace —
may I lie as at Thy cool foot-lotus-pair — when?
Thy worship-joy-wealth, rich with love-wine —
when fare I to its far shore, when be done?
s09-v15.sanskrit_cite: bhaktyāsavasamṛddhāyās tvatpūjābhogasampadaḥ kadā pāraṃ gamiṣyāmi bhaviṣyāmi kadā kṛtī

lines: Tears first, tripping, reeling, choked-wailing —
laughter-lit face: Thy touch-sap when win I?
This beast-folk-like state shaken off —
when, Kind One, taste I my self-shape, worthy Thy lovers?
s09-v17.sanskrit_cite: paśujanasamānavṛttām avadhūya daśām imāṃ kadā śambho āsvādayeya tāvakabhaktocitam ātmano rūpam

lines: Powers won, all fever-fear melted —
on Thy love-elixir-drink-play bent: when be I?
Lord, when shall that wail of mine ring so in speech —
Thy shape straightway flashing before me?
s09-v19.sanskrit_cite: nātha kadā sa tathāvidha ākrando me samuccared vāci yat samanantaram eva sphurati puras tāvakī mūrtiḥ

lines: Mind on clasping hard-hard Thy foot-lotuses, passion-bent —
thing, unthing, this — strainless, when full-behold I Thee?
s09-v20.sanskrit_cite: gāḍhagāḍhabhavadaṅghrisarojāliṅganavyasanatatparacetāḥ vastv avastv idam ayatnata eva tvāṃ kadā samavalokayitāsmi

lines: Surely past bearing for Thee, sole world-Lord —
this: Thy Great-One's men levelled with other world-folk.
s10-v01.sanskrit_cite: na soḍhavyam avaśyam te jagadekaprabhor idam māheśvarāś ca lokānām itareṣāṃ samāś ca yat

lines: Who trail Thy feet ever with love —
go where they go, certain joys they savor.
s10-v02.sanskrit_cite: ye sadaivānurāgeṇa bhavatpādānugāminaḥ yatra tatra gatā bhogāṃs te kāṃś cid upabhuñjate

lines: Where Thou art husband, death-ender —
whence ache? Where Thine own fortune stands — what care for other joys?
s10-v03.sanskrit_cite: bhartā kālāntako yatra bhavāṃs tatra kuto rujaḥ tatra cetarabhogāśā kā lakṣmīr yatra tāvakī

lines: By whom through a wink's joy the All is won —
at once all his time with Thy bliss is filled.
s10-v04.sanskrit_cite: kṣanamātrasukhenāpi vibhur yenāsi labhyase tadaiva sarvaḥ kālo 'sya tvadānandena pūryate

lines: Moon — Thy bliss-sap drop, fallen earthward. Sun likewise —
Thy forth-fared spark of world-burning heat.
s10-v05.sanskrit_cite: ānandarasabindus te candramā galito bhuvi sūryas tathā te prasṛtaḥ saṃhārī tejasaḥ kaṇaḥ

lines: Offering bear we to this third eye of Thine, Lord —
sole badge of some unworldly greatness.
s10-v06.sanskrit_cite: baliṃ yāmas tṛtīyāya netrāyāsmai tava prabho alaukikasya kasyāpi māhātmyasyaikalakṣmaṇe

lines: Seen by Him alone — who overjoys in Thy vision and the rest.
Or by whatever joy of his, somehow — thereby art Thou seen.
s10-v07.sanskrit_cite: tenaiva dṛṣṭo 'si bhavaddarśanādyo 'tihṛṣyati kathañcid yasya vā harṣaḥ ko 'pi tena tvam īkṣitaḥ

lines: Whom Thou favorest, All, who have won Thy heart —
dragging from Thy city, the outside they in-make.
s10-v08.sanskrit_cite: yeṣām prasanno 'si vibho yair labdhaṃ hṛdayaṃ tava ākṛṣya tvatpurāttais tu bāhyam ābhyantarīkṛtam

lines: Without Thee, let the all-world be seen gone same-eyed —
but this world's Ruler, Thou alone: Uneven-eyed.
s10-v09.sanskrit_cite: tvad ṛte nikhilaṃ viśvaṃ samadṛgyātam īkṣyatām īśvaraḥ punar etasya tvam eko viṣamekṣaṇaḥ

lines: Leave be: without Thy might, being itself is not —
and whose Thee-blaming talk without Thee holds not.
s10-v10.sanskrit_cite: āstāṃ bhavatprabhāveṇa vinā sattaiva nāsti yat tvaddūṣaṇakathā yeṣām tvad ṛte nopapadyate

lines: Stood my mind in Thee alone, lonely, outer-inner-hindrance-free —
what else, All, avails?
s10-v11.sanskrit_cite: bāhyāntarāntarāyālīkevale cetasi sthitiḥ tvayi cet syān mama vibho kim anyad upayujyate

lines: Others roam, Lord, in the self itself — ill-placed past measure.
Others roam, Lord, in the self itself — well-placed past measure.
s10-v12.sanskrit_cite: anye bhramanti bhagavann ātmany evātiduḥsthitāḥ anye bhramanti bhagavann ātmany evātisusthitāḥ

lines: Thy love-nectar undrunk, Thyself unseen even, Ruler —
by mere Thy-company alone souls ripen.
s10-v13.sanskrit_cite: apītvāpi bhavadbhaktisudhām anavalokya ca tvām īśa tvatsamācāramātrāt siddhyanti jantavaḥ

lines: Thy slaves are we, All —
as Thou bearest Thyself for three worlds, to-be-borne by Thee are we too — fully.
s10-v14.sanskrit_cite: bhṛtyā vayaṃ tava vibho tena trijagatāṃ yathā bibharṣy ātmānam evaṃ te bharttavyā vayam apy alam

lines: Seen even in Thee — high-bliss-nectar, world-self —
for touch-sap I hunger past-past, Thine.
s10-v15.sanskrit_cite: parānandāmṛtamaye dṛṣṭo 'pi jagadātmani tvayi sparśarase 'tyantatarasutkaṇṭhito(?) 'smi te

lines: God — all pains, even the passing-through's —
yoked to Thy ghee-named self, grow bearable.
s10-v16.sanskrit_cite: deva duḥkhāny aśeṣāṇi yāni saṃsāriṇām api ghṛtyākhyabhavadīyātmayutāny āyānti sahyatām

lines: Thou all-knowing, all-mighty, knowing-made —
somehow, Lord, this world's unreality-show is fit.
s10-v17.sanskrit_cite: sarvajñe sarvaśaktau ca tvayy eva sati cinmaye sarvathāpy asato nātha yuktāsya jagataḥ prathā

lines: By Thee breathed, these strands throb —
clod-like even — dancing wind-lifted, as cotton-fluff.
s10-v18.sanskrit_cite: tvatprāṇitāḥ sphurantīme guṇā loṣṭopamā api nṛtyanti pavanoddhūtāḥ kārpāsāḥ picavo yathā

lines: If, Lord, in strands no I-pride were —
whereby would the world lose its Thou-alone-self-show?
s10-v19.sanskrit_cite: yadi nātha guṇeṣv ātmābhimāno na bhavet tataḥ kena hīyeta jagatas tvadekātmatayā prathā

lines: Praised, even the great ones gone to dissolving —
Thy-anger-fire-touch-pure, High-Lord.
s10-v20.sanskrit_cite: vandyās te 'pi mahīyāṃsaḥ pralayopagatā api tvatkopapāvakasparśapūtā ye parameśvara
notes: nominal throughout, mirroring verbless SA (vandyāḥ … pūtāḥ)

lines: Thy great-light body standing plain —
on all sides, Ruler, why in dark range I?
s10-v21.sanskrit_cite: mahāprakāśavapuṣi vispaṣṭe bhavati sthite sarvato 'pīśa tat kasmāt tamasi prasarāmy aham

lines: Undivided, Thou alone —
my nectar-nature. Yet to mortal ways I am the one seat.
s10-v22.sanskrit_cite: avibhāgo bhavān eva svarūpam amṛtaṃ mama tathāpi martyadharmāṇām aham evaikam āspadam

lines: Whose speech-jewel is 'Great-Lord,' bow-brand on brow —
he alone is mighty.
s10-v23.sanskrit_cite: maheśvareti yasyāsti nāmakaṃ vāgvibhūṣaṇam praṇāmāṅkaś ca śirasi sa evaikaḥ prabhāvitaḥ

lines: Being, unbeing — Thou alone. So effortless, by own sap alone, Lord —
why is ripening not mine?
s10-v24.sanskrit_cite: sadasac ca bhavān eva yena tenāprayāsataḥ svarasenaiva bhagavaṃs tathā siddhiḥ kathaṃ na me

lines: Śiva's slave, Śiva-one-self — what joy wins he not?
Chief gods themselves I sate with drink — nectar-wines.
s10-v25.sanskrit_cite: śivadāsaḥ śivaikātmā kiṃ yan nāsādayet sukham tarpyo 'smi devamukhyānām api yenāmṛtāsavaiḥ

lines: Heart-navel-between, breathers' bile-bodied —
Thou eaterest, great fire, all still, all moving.
s10-v26.sanskrit_cite: hṛnnābhyor antarālasthaḥ prāṇināṃ pittavigrahaḥ grasase tvaṃ mahāvahniḥ sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam

lines: This world, or friends, or kin —
naught of mine. But Thou art all this again — then who else be mine?
s11-v01.sanskrit_cite: jagad idam athavā suhṛdo bandhujano vā na bhavati mama kim api tvaṃ punar etat sarvaṃ yadā tadā ko 'paro me 'stu

lines: 'Master, Great-Lord — Thou outright; all the world Thee alone' —
may the thing itself ripen: this the begging — and therein begging alone.
s11-v02.sanskrit_cite: svāmin maheśvaras tvaṃ sākṣāt sarvaṃ jagat tvam eveti vastv eva siddhim etv iti yācñā tatrāpi yācñaiva

lines: Three-worlds-lordship even here seems straw to Thy partaker.
What fruit has fair-deed, Lord, parted from remembering Thee?
s11-v03.sanskrit_cite: tribhuvanādhipatitvam apīha yat tṛṇam iva pratibhāti bhavajjuṣaḥ kim iva tasya phalaṃ śubhakarmaṇo bhavati nātha bhavatsmaraṇād ṛte

lines: Since naught of worlds nor world-birth is parted from Thee —
Thy unfolding: 'mid marvel-deeds even rises no praise-weaving of Thee.
s11-v04.sanskrit_cite: yena naiva bhavato 'sti vibhinnaṃ kiñcanāpi jagatāṃ prabhavaś ca tvadvijṛmbhitam ato 'dbhutakarmasv apy udeti na tava stutibandhaḥ

lines: 'Thine-made am I, Thy-worship-bound' —
ever, unceasing picturing, All, by own sap — dream-goer even: why am I not so?
s11-v05.sanskrit_cite: tvanmayo 'smi bhavadarcananiṣṭhaḥ sarvadāham iti cāpy avirāmam bhāvayann api vibho svarasena svapnago 'pi na tathā kim iva syām

lines: Brushed by a jot even — Thy-foot-lotus-born scent-speck —
for them rest-like turns all joy-kind, gods-hunted even.
s11-v06.sanskrit_cite: ye manāg api bhavaccaraṇābjodbhūtasaurabhalavena vimṛṣṭaḥ teṣu visram iva bhavati samastaṃ bhogajātam amarair api mṛgyam

lines: Heart: naught but Thee. Word and deed: wholly else, Kind One.
From the truly Real — grace or curb: one alone be wrought.
s11-v07.sanskrit_cite: hṛdi te na tu vidyate 'nyad anyad vacane karmaṇi cānyad eva śaṃbho paramārthasato 'py anugraho vā yadi vā nigraha eka eva kāryaḥ

lines: Dull am I, pain-laden am I, age-fearing am I, power-bare am I —
Thine-sheltered am I. Kind One, so ordain: swift I near the highest yoke, sorrow-road-forsaken.
s11-v08.sanskrit_cite: mūḍho 'smi duḥkhakalito 'smi jarādidoṣabhīto 'smi śaktirahito 'smi tavāśrito 'smi śambho tathā kalaya śīghram upaimi yena sarvottamāṃ dhuram apojjhitaduḥkhamārgaḥ

lines: Couched at Thy ear-place, my wails, most trifling, take high worth —
as reed-joint-fallen water-specks wear pearlhood.
s11-v09.sanskrit_cite: tvatkarṇadeśama dhiśayya mahārghabhāvam ākranditāni mama tucchatarāṇi yānti vaṃśāntarālapatitāni jalaikadeśakhaṇḍāni mauktikamaṇitvam ivodvahanti

lines: What, pray, is unwon, alas — even by such as dote a wink, by cheat even, on Thy name?
Cool-ray-crested, so act that I, death-wounded, may reach minuteness-and-the-rest as glory.
s11-v10.sanskrit_cite: kim iva ca labhyate bata na tair api nātha janaiḥ kṣaṇam api kaitavād api ca ye tava nāmni ratāḥ śiśiramayūkhaśekhara tathā kuru yena mama kṣatamaraṇo 'ṇimādikam upaimi yathā vibhavam

lines: Kind One! Śarva! Moon-crested! Śiva! Three-eyed rosary-wearing! Glorious! Fierce-skull-signed! Grim-trident-flashing! Pity-sea!
Worlds-weaving-natured! Fierce-power-formed! Fair-throated! — swift destroy ill-luck's loads; lay on high Thine own ripening.
s11-v11.sanskrit_cite: śambho śarva śaśaṅkaśekhara śiva tryakṣākṣamālādhara śrīmann ugrakapālalāñchana lasadbhīmatriśūlāyudha kāruṇyāmbunidhe trilokaracanāśīlograśaktyātmaka śrīkaṇṭhāśu vināśayāśubhabharān ādhat svasiddhiṃ parām

lines: What, Lord, would not be, where the Lord wins not makerhood? What being had the knower, unmade by Kind-Maker?
Thus ever sheltered in Thee — unwaning great power's High-Lord — here in passing, pang-thickened, I ail — alone.
s11-v12.sanskrit_cite: tat kiṃ nātha bhaven na yatra bhagavān nirmātṛtām aśnute bhāvaḥ syāt kim u tasya cetanavato nāśāsti yaṃ śaṅkaraḥ itthaṃ te parameśvarākṣatamahāśakteḥ sadā saṃśritaḥ saṃsāre 'tra nirantarādhividhuraḥ kliśyāmy ahaṃ kevalam

lines: Though pains, age, death here — haughtiest boon-lords — bide a wink; approved, sounds and the rest, unstable ever —
yet I hanker, ever-joy-hungering, to stand long for life-drink: joy-taste-yoked Thy-foot-lotus-thought, first.
s11-v13.sanskrit_cite: yady apy atra varapradoddhatatamāḥ pīḍājarāmṛtyava ete vā kṣaṇam āsatāṃ bahumataḥ śabdādir evāsthiraḥ tatrāpi spṛhayāmi santatasukhākāṅkṣī ciraṃ sthāsnave bhogāsvādayutatvadaṅghrikamaladhyānāgrya jīvātave

lines: O Lord — skilled smasher of the bent one's pangs, weal-hoard, Matted-haired —
of me, pain's sole seat, birth-death-frighted, now so act: living even, Thy-worship-bound, I win unshaken ripenings, sweet-sense-taste-yielding, high.
s11-v14.sanskrit_cite: he nātha praṇatārtināśanapaṭo śreyonidhe dhūrjaṭe duḥkhaikāyatanasya janmamaraṇatrastasya me sāmpratam tac ceṣṭasva yathā manojñaviṣayāsvādapradā uttamā jīvann eva samaśnuve 'ham acalāḥ siddhīs tvadarcāparaḥ

lines: Bow to delusion's great-gloom-smasher of no other work —
to all-light-outshining light, moon-badged.
No helper wanted for finding Thee, no bar to sight —
by Thee alone all is flooded. How, even now, still art Thou unseen?
s12-v01.sanskrit_cite: sahakāri na kiñcid iṣyate bhavato na pratibandhakaṃ dṛṣi bhavataiva hi sarvam āplutaṃ katham adyāpi tathāpi nekṣase

lines: From thing-throng, sense-heap, thought's middle even —
the ever self-arising may I full-behold: world-doffed.
s12-v02.sanskrit_cite: api bhāvagaṇād apīndriyapracayād apy avabodhamadhyataḥ prabhavantam api svataḥ sadā paripaśyeyam apoḍhaviśvakam

lines: How be things born, how walk Thy seeing-road — inlaid with what great nature-limb?
Rising and rising, from land, water, grass on, Thou scatterest creation's trickle-nectar-floods over all.
s12-v03.sanskrit_cite: kathaṃ te jāyeran katham api ca te darśanapathaṃ vrajeyuḥ kenāpi prakṛtimahatāṅkena khacitaḥ tathotthāyotthāya sthalajalatṛṇāder akhilataḥ padārthadyānsṛṣṭisravadamṛtapūrair(?) vikirasi

lines: Faced with Thy form-fared nectar, sated —
thirst uprooted, heady — they roam to taste.
s12-v04.sanskrit_cite: sākṣatkṛta bhavadrūpaprasṛtāmṛtatarpitāḥ unmūlitatṛṣo mattā vicaranti yathāruci

lines: Not then, not ever, not once even —
where no time-thought be: that, this Thy seeing — nor told eternal, nor else.
s12-v05.sanskrit_cite: na tadā na sadā na caikadety api sā yatra na kāladhīr bhavet tad idaṃ bhavadīyadarśanaṃ na ca nityaṃ na ca kathyate 'nyathā

lines: Mind risen to see Thee — be this much my yoga-ripe, ever:
that by bare resolve I enter Thy nectar-house, to worship Thee.
s12-v06.sanskrit_cite: tvadvilokanasamutkacetaso yogasiddhir iyatī sadāstu me yad viśeyam abhisandhimātratas tvatsudhāsadanam arcanāya te

lines: Mind-blown by winning Thy doubt-free seeing —
great souls: sport stainless their deeds and words, lightly, plain.
s12-v07.sanskrit_cite: nirvikalpabhavadīyadarśanapraptiphullamanasāṃ mahātmanām ullasanti vimalāni helayā ceṣṭitāni ca vacāṃsi ca sphuṭam

lines: Dwelling 'tween Thy feet, within indeed, fearless —
on being-grounds those and those may I worship the Lord, unbolted in deed.
s12-v08.sanskrit_cite: bhavanbhavadīyapādayor nivasann antara eva nirbhayaḥ bhavabhūmiṣu tāsu tāsv ahaṃ prabhum arceyam anargalakriyaḥ

lines: In Thy foot-lotus's belly dissolved, melted of other-longing —
honey-overmuch, sated, may I roam at will.
s12-v09.sanskrit_cite: bhavadaṅghrisaroruhodare parilīno galitaparaiṣaṇaḥ atimātramadhūpayogataḥ paritṛpto vicareyam icchayā

lines: Whose resolve to worship Thee rose from sham even —
for him too, needs must, dawns Thy fit nearness.
s12-v10.sanskrit_cite: yasya dambhād iva bhavatpūjāsaṅkalpa utthitaḥ tasyāpy avaśyam uditaṃ sannidhānaṃ tavocitam

lines: Lord — mind past others-hoping, one-sapped utterly —
the easy, all-outlying Lord to sating may I drink. What am I?
s12-v11.sanskrit_cite: bhagavann itarān apekṣiṇā nitarām ekarasena cetasā sulabhaṃ sakalopaśāyinaṃ prabhum ātṛpti pibeyam asmi kim

lines: By Thee unmade — all where Thou art not: leave it.
Thou-made: take it up. This, the pith-gist.
s12-v12.sanskrit_cite: tvayā nirākṛtam sarvaṃ heyam etat tad eva tu tvanmayaṃ samupādeyam ity ayaṃ sārasaṃgrahaḥ

lines: Thy in-dwelling thing-born — worshiped as chief by coming-forth.
Outside Thee, mere unbeing — how, Ruler, could it be, or be worshiped?
s12-v13.sanskrit_cite: bhavato 'ntaracāri bhāvajātaṃ prabhuvanmukhyatayaiva pūjitaṃ tat bhavato bahir apy abhāvamātrā katham īśān bhavet samarcyate vā

lines: Soundless, doubtless, distractionless —
ever. In churn even, face to face — Three-eyed, Thee alone, everywhere.
s12-v14.sanskrit_cite: niḥśabdaṃ nirvikalpaṃ ca nirvyākṣepam athānisam kṣobhe 'py adhyakṣamī kṣeyaṃ tryakṣa tvām eva sarvataḥ

lines: Show Thine own seat, God — where Thou art ever Goddess-joined.
Foot-dust-ranked with the Lord, why seem slaves unbelief's ground?
s12-v15.sanskrit_cite: prakaṭaya nijadhāma deva yasmiṃs tvam asi sadā parameśvarīsametaḥ prabhucaraṇarajaḥsamānakakṣyāḥ kim aviśvāsapadaṃ bhānti bhṛtyāḥ

lines: Come to seeing's road, yet Thou slippest —
whence from me, my Ruler, Thy slave? Not a wink here art Thou not each breather's sight-mark.
s12-v16.sanskrit_cite: darśanapatham upayāto 'py apasarasi kuto mameśa bhṛtyasya kṣaṇamātrakam iha na bhavasi kasya na jantor dṛśor viṣayaḥ

lines: By oneness-knowing-nectar's clear unbroken current —
when, All? From the flood, past it, undifference fetching — Thee and my own frame may I win, glad.
s12-v17.sanskrit_cite: aikyasaṃvidamṛtācchadhārayā santataprasṛtayā kadā vibho plāvanāt paramabhedamānayaṃs tvāṃ nijaṃ ca vapur āpnuyāṃ mudam

lines: 'I' — from the fenced-off world, from Thy realization-pith —
a grain even of world-groundedness befall me, whereby worshiped by Thee may I be.
s12-v18.sanskrit_cite: aham ity amuto 'varuddhalokād bhavadīyāt pratipattisārato me aṇumātrakam eva viśvaniṣṭhaṃ ghaṭatāṃ yena bhaveyam arcitā te

lines: Measureless-shaped — thing and thing, wink by wink beholding —
Thee alone, world-shaped, my own Lord, may I well behold.
s12-v19.sanskrit_cite: aparimitarūpam ahaṃ taṃ taṃ bhāvaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ paśyan tvām eva viśvarūpaṃ nijanāthaṃ sādhu paśyeyam

lines: Gone to Thy limbs — why roams not mind after liked thing for thing?
Nature unwronged — and my wish filled wholly supreme.
s12-v20.sanskrit_cite: bhavadaṅgagataṃ tam eva kasmān na manaḥ paryaṭatīṣṭam artham artham prakṛtikṣatir asti no tathāsya mama cecchā paripūryate paraiva

lines: Hundreds, they say, by Thy might, Lord —
who with this very eye, even plough-gaited roaming, full-behold Thy body ever before.
s12-v21.sanskrit_cite: śataśaḥ kila te tavānubhāvād bhagavan ke 'py amunaiva cakṣuṣā ye api hālikaceṣṭayā carantaḥ paripaśyanti bhavadvapuḥ sadāgre

lines: No thought rises unmade of Thy will; fair ever, or else, by the Lord so 'tis wrought.
So Thine-natured, earth-roaming as may be, standing ever at Thy unstopped stainless-foot-feast.
s12-v22.sanskrit_cite: na sā matir udeti yā na bhavati tvadicchāmayī sadā śubham athetarad bhagavataivam ācaryate ato 'smi bhavadātmako bhuvi yathā tathā sañcaran sthi to 'niśam abādhitatvadamalaṅghripūjotsavaḥ

lines: 'Mid Thy deep sayings may insight rise for me full, first —
then wrought power too, and Thy-worship-passion unpausing.
s12-v23.sanskrit_cite: bhavadīyagabhīrabhāṣiteṣu pratibhā samyag udetu me puro 'taḥ tadanuṣṭhitaśaktir apy atas tadbhavadarcāvyasanaṃ ca nirvirāmam

lines: On dealing-ground even, ever, may this thing-heap dawn for me as Thy limb —
not as self-worthy come.
s12-v24.sanskrit_cite: vyavahārapade 'pi sarvadā pratibhātv arthakalāpa eṣa mām bhavato 'vayavo yathā na tu svata evādaraṇīyatāṃ gataḥ

lines: Mind by own sap roaming where-go —
I in its ranges, strayed even, unswerving still, Thy-tending-skilled may I ever be.
s12-v25.sanskrit_cite: manasi svarasena yatra tatra pracaraty apy aham asya gocareṣu prasṛto 'py avilola eva yuṣmatparicaryācaturaḥ sadā bhaveyam

lines: Lord, by Thy will alone Thy slave am I born —
no other's force here. How then Thy face-orb see I never? Strange, this.
s12-v26.sanskrit_cite: bhagavan bhavadicchayaiva dāsas tava jāto 'smi parasya nātra śaktiḥ katham eṣa tathāpi vaktrabimbaṃ tava paśyāmi na jātu citram etat

lines: The keen toward Thee who behold Thee from counter-stance —
ah! what has drawn near them, what practice fruited?
s12-v27.sanskrit_cite: samutsukās tvāṃ prati ye bhavantaṃ pratyartharūpād avalokayanti teṣām aho kiṃ tadupasthitaṃ syāt kiṃ sādhanaṃ vā phalitaṃ bhavet tat

lines: Things be as things by Thy being, for me.
So be naught elsewise — naught but Thine.
s12-v28.sanskrit_cite: bhāvā bhāvatayā santu bhavadbhāvena me bhava tathā na kiñcid apy astu na kiñcid bhavato 'nyathā

lines: What is naught at all, be naught at all; something at all, be something indeed for me.
In all ways be — thereby Thou everywhere art won-and-worshiped.
s12-v29.sanskrit_cite: yan na kiñcid api tanna kiñcid apy astu kiñcid api kiñcid eva me sarvathā bhavatu tāvatā bhavān sarvato bhavati labdhapūjitaḥ

lines: In brief, Lord —
hear my pain-joy-mark: joy is this, meeting Thee; parted from the Master — pain.
s13-v01.sanskrit_cite: saṃgrahena sukhaduḥkhalakṣaṇaṃ māṃ prati sthitam idaṃ śṛṇu prabho saukhyam eṣa bhavatā samāgamaḥ svāminā viraha eva duḥkhitā

lines: Inside even, exceeding subtle — the Thee-unshowing spell in me:
her too, Ruler, wipe from all sides; Thine own stainless shape show.
s13-v02.sanskrit_cite: antar apy atitarām aṇīyasī yā tvadaprathanakālikāsti me tām apīśa parimṛjya sarvataḥ svaṃ svarūpam amalaṃ prakāśaya

lines: In Thy frame — world-filled, knowing-nectar-sapped, unending —
abiding, ever worshiping the Lord: live, die, else — be mine.
s13-v03.sanskrit_cite: tāvake vapuṣi viśvanirbhare citsudhārasamaye niratyaye tiṣṭhataḥ satatam arcataḥ prabhuṃ jīvitaṃ mṛtam athānyad astu me

lines: 'Lord am I — I shapely indeed, learned, loved —
who else? my like in the world?' — so shines pride, Thy lovers', highly.
s13-v04.sanskrit_cite: īśvaro 'ham aham eva rūpavān paṇḍito 'smi subhago 'smi ko 'paraḥ matsamo 'sti jagatīti śobhate mānitā tvadanurāgiṇaḥ param

lines: God of gods — birth won me from telling Thy non-dual nectar that swallows fame.
So by things-just-as-they-stand-knowing make me foot-worship-fit.
s13-v05.sanskrit_cite: devadeva bhavadadvayāmṛtākhyātisaṃharaṇalabdhajanmanā tad yathāsthitapadārthasaṃvidā māṃ kuruṣva caraṇārcanocitam

lines: Thought on, then seen, then touched — the High Lord Himself.
Where worship's high feast is, be mine ever, by Thy might.
s13-v06.sanskrit_cite: dhyāyate tad anu dṛśyate tataḥ spṛśyate ca parameśvaraḥ svayam yatra pūjanamahotsavaḥ sa me sarvadāstu bhavato 'nubhāvataḥ

lines: Things-as-they-stand-seeing and Thy-worship-high-feast —
this pair, each-other-grounded, in lovers ever unfolds.
s13-v07.sanskrit_cite: yady athāsthitapadārthadarśanaṃ yuṣmadarcanamahotsavaś ca yaḥ yugmam etad itaretarāśrayaṃ bhaktiśāliṣu sadā vijṛmbhate

lines: By each sense-mouth, ever, Thy-worship-sap-elixir-wine —
in all-thing-cups filled, drinking even, may I be mad.
s13-v08.sanskrit_cite: tattadindriyamukhena santataṃ yuṣmadarcanarasāyanāsavam sarvabhāvacaṣakeṣu pūriteṣv āpibann api bhaveyam unmadaḥ

lines: Other-known, grain even, is not; self-shown, all unfolds.
Where, Lord, in Thy city stands — there make me ever Thine honorer.
s13-v09.sanskrit_cite: anyavedyam aṇumātram asti na svaprakāśam akhilaṃ vijṛmbhate yatra nātha bhavataḥ pure sthitaṃ tatra me kuru sadā tavārcituḥ

lines: To slave-quarters posted even, by Thine own will, High Lord —
by beholding am I not vesseled, or by foot-rubbing work even?
s13-v10.sanskrit_cite: dāsadhāmni viniyojito 'py ahaṃ svecchayaiva parameśvara tvayā darśanena na kim asmi pātritaḥ pādasaṃvahanakarmaṇāpi vā

lines: At power's-fall time, weighing — come to it — Thou doest never, Ruler.
Today toward me what has come, that in self-showing-rite Thou lingerest?

lines: There and there, in things, shining without — within, high-Goddess-yoked —

lines: Whatever relish lies in all fair things — by the touch-bare rite —
offering that up, thereby worship Thy frame, O steady-loved.

lines: Thou widenest all by Thyself, flashing; the world Thou touchest, touching shape.

lines: Thee — bottomless, doubt-free, two-free, Thine own shape, all-thing-devouring —
entering, I, Umā's Lord, ever worship and high-praise.

lines: Before mine own master — victory-fortune's treasure —

lines: Hail: Rudra the One, Śiva the One, Great God, Great Lord —
Pārvatī's lover, Śarva, first-born of all gods.
s14-v02.sanskrit_cite: jayaikarudraikaśiva mahādeva maheśvara pārvatīpraṇayiñ śarva sarvagīrvāṇapūrvaja

lines: Hail: brow-eyed sole badge of the three-worlds' Lord. Hail: black-poison-throated —
who drank the pain-struck world's pain.
Hail: three-powers-bodied self, hundred-pike-bright-handed.
Hail: lotus-feet worship-worthy — aims ripened by will alone.
Hail: other-world-body-bearer, streaming hundred beauties.
Hail: single-topknotted — unwasting Ganges, rite-ash-seized.
Hail: smeared with milk-sea-spread moonlight shade.
Hail: jewel-darling-snow-decked — risen from the Lord's limb-touch.
Hail: shelter like the one undying cool-rayed digit.
Hail: all-lordship-anointed, ever-damp with Ganges.
Hail: whose low-limb-touch hallows cowherds.
Hail, ever-present where love-drunk gather.
Hail: who dupes the sillies, showing hot places at will.
Hail: fit vessel of Gauri-embrace-fortune.
Hail: greedy for love-gifts wet-and-wet with love-sap.
Hail: gladdened by lovers' word-dance — love-drunk and wild.
Hail: Brahmā-and-first-gods' might —
rise and fall. Hail: whose edict world-lord-rows bear on heads.
Hail: glory shown by self-seal set on all worlds.
Hail: All-Lord, Great Lord — down to self-gift.
Hail: matchless at three-worlds' creation-wish-moment.
Hail: with Goddess alone helping bear lordship's load.
Hail: who strode all three worlds with no step.
Hail, unsatirized Lord-din, sung from childhood.
Hail, inborn-high, past pity and the rest.
Hail, Bhairava before whom dread great Death is wrought.
Hail, unrivalled in world-burn's raging work.
Hail, hundred-weal-praised name-chant.
Hail, nectar-mine-sea spilt in play.
Hail, whose wink-anger parches the world-burn dry.
Hail, sole lamp of delusion-dark-blind breathing-folk.
Hail, wakeful high Person of the sleeping world.
Hail, life's-life warbling in the body-mountain-bower.
Hail, choice lake-bird sporting in true minds' sky.
Hail, mountain-lord born of high gold-vein.
Hail, moon rising blame-meteor-fall-portent over sinners.
Hail, unneared by pain-burnt sages and gods.
Hail, seen by love-mad-folk mounted on every state.
Hail, who leafs his own dependents, spreading Thine own wealth.
Hail, whose one use is petting surrender-folk.
Hail, sole bright deed of making, staying, unmaking.
Hail, high feast of play-lotuses swaying in love's headiness.
Hail, victory's vessel! Hail, birth-age-death-conqueror! Hail, world's eldest!
Hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail — Three-eyed!

lines: Stain-washing books there are, and their far-siders too; yogins, pundits stand hale —
Thy lovers alone, in truth.

love-ful — on the world's shore.

but — brimming-love-wine-sap-mad.

lines: In nectar-wet Thy-love though wallowing, yet climb-hungering —

keen-blooming Three-eyed's-bouquet-scents, fair, scent even cross-scented yogins, near-dwelling, all.

lines: Lovers' evenness-pith-equinox-tide, ever —
by Thy-state-sap-nectar-sap, their ever-worship.
Whose start-and-end are not, nor time-rank, Ruler —
worship-selved is that deed; its doers, Thy-partakers, merely.
s17-v06.sanskrit_cite: yasyānārambhaparyantau na ca kālakramaḥ prabho pūjātmāsau kriyā tasyāḥ kartāras tvajjuṣaḥ param

lines: Brahmā-and-first ones even — rulers, fortune-sharers —
in whose dream even, swoon even, stands Thy worship-feast.
s17-v07.sanskrit_cite: brahmādīnām apīśāste te ca saubhāgyabhāginaḥ yeṣāṃ svapne 'pi mohe 'pi sthitas tvatpūjanotsavaḥ

lines: Mutterers, offerers, bathers, thinkers —
and not barely: lovers' Thee-worship — ah! — as-far, when, then...
s17-v08.sanskrit_cite: japatāṃ juhvatāṃ snātāṃ dhyāyatāṃ na ca kevalam bhaktānāṃ bhavadabhyarcāmaho yāvad yadā tadā

lines: Thy-worship-nectar-taste-wedding-glad, ever —
'mid Indra-and-first, ay, Brahmā-chiefs: is who their match?
s17-v09.sanskrit_cite: bhavatpūjāsudhāsvādasambhogasukhinaḥ sadā indrādīnām atha brahmamukhyānām asti kaḥ samaḥ

lines: At Thy worship-high-feast, sole-born of world-churn —
what won is won, some: lovers alone ken it.
s17-v10.sanskrit_cite: jagatkṣobhaikajanake bhavatpūjāmahotsave yatprāpyaṃ prāpyate kiṃcid bhaktā eva vidanti tat

lines: In Thy knowing-made seat standing, by six-and-thirty-principle-deeds —
by body-speech-mind-stirs and the rest — worship I Thee ever, All.
s17-v11.sanskrit_cite: tvaddhāmni cinmaye sthitvā ṣaṭtriṃśattattvakarmabhiḥ kāyavākcittaceṣṭādyair arcaye tvāṃ sadā vibho

lines: Glad in Thy-worship-woven-clinging-wedding, of me —
fare, time, all, ay, endless. This I pray.
s17-v12.sanskrit_cite: bhavatpūjāmayāsaṅgasambhogasukhino mama prayātu kālaḥ sakalo 'py ananto 'pīyadarthaye

lines: Greed for Thy-worship-nectar-sap-feasting —
All! Wax day on day, and ever fruit, for me.
s17-v13.sanskrit_cite: bhavatpūjāmṛtarasābhogalampaṭata vibho vivardhatām anudinaṃ sadā ca phalatāṃ mama

lines: In Thine ocean — brimmed with world-play-born nectar-one-sap —
Thee, high-souled, worshiping may I sit, ever.
s17-v14.sanskrit_cite: jagadvilayasañjātasudhaikarasanirbhare tvadabdhau tvāṃ mahātmānam arcannāsīya sarvadā

lines: Ever plain by all-hankering-knot-severing —
mind is laid before Thee by lovers, sweet, in Thy worship-rule.
s17-v15.sanskrit_cite: aśeṣavāsanāgranthivicchedasaralaṃ sadā mano nivedyate bhaktaiḥ svādu pūjāvidhau tava

lines: Standing upon these sense-fields, sense-plays of lovers send —
for Thy-worship-sake — nectar-wine.
s17-v16.sanskrit_cite: adhiṣṭhāyaiva viṣayānimāḥ karaṇavṛttayaḥ bhaktānāṃ preṣayanti svatpūjārtham amṛtāsavam

lines: Lovers, love-surge-great-heat-helpless-souled —
what other freedom-cause, but drowning in Thy-worship-nectar?
s17-v17.sanskrit_cite: bhaktānāṃ bhaktisaṃvegamahoṣmavivaśātmanām ko 'nyo nirvāṇahetuḥ syāt tvatpūjāmṛtamajjanāt

lines: Ever, Thy-foot-honoring-nectar-drink-high-feast —
my Thy-grace-one-winning-cause, Ruler, may it avail.
s17-v18.sanskrit_cite: satataṃ tvatpadābhyarcāsudhāpānamahotsavaḥ tvatprasādaikasamprāptihetur me nātha kalpatām

lines: May I feel, Ruler, deed by deed, wink by wink —
Thy-worship-nectar-drink-frenzy-taste-high-glee.
Seen-fruited indeed is lovers' Thy-worship-high-venture: at once —
unthinkable joy they taste.
s17-v20.sanskrit_cite: dṛṣṭartha eva bhaktānāṃ bhavatpūjāmahodyamaḥ tadaiva yad asambhāvyaṃ sukham āsvādayanti te

lines: While unwon, Thy-worship-nectar-taste-high-feast —
