lines: Measureless-shaped — thing and thing, wink by wink beholding —
Thee alone, world-shaped, my own Lord, may I well behold.
s12-v19.sanskrit_cite: aparimitarūpam ahaṃ taṃ taṃ bhāvaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ paśyan tvām eva viśvarūpaṃ nijanāthaṃ sādhu paśyeyam

lines: Gone to Thy limbs — why roams not mind after liked thing for thing?
Nature unwronged — and my wish filled wholly supreme.
s12-v20.sanskrit_cite: bhavadaṅgagataṃ tam eva kasmān na manaḥ paryaṭatīṣṭam artham artham prakṛtikṣatir asti no tathāsya mama cecchā paripūryate paraiva

lines: Hundreds, they say, by Thy might, Lord —
who with this very eye, even plough-gaited roaming, full-behold Thy body ever before.
s12-v21.sanskrit_cite: śataśaḥ kila te tavānubhāvād bhagavan ke 'py amunaiva cakṣuṣā ye api hālikaceṣṭayā carantaḥ paripaśyanti bhavadvapuḥ sadāgre

lines: No thought rises unmade of Thy will; fair ever, or else, by the Lord so 'tis wrought.
So Thine-natured, earth-roaming as may be, standing ever at Thy unstopped stainless-foot-feast.
s12-v22.sanskrit_cite: na sā matir udeti yā na bhavati tvadicchāmayī sadā śubham athetarad bhagavataivam ācaryate ato 'smi bhavadātmako bhuvi yathā tathā sañcaran sthi to 'niśam abādhitatvadamalaṅghripūjotsavaḥ

lines: 'Mid Thy deep sayings may insight rise for me full, first —
then wrought power too, and Thy-worship-passion unpausing.
s12-v23.sanskrit_cite: bhavadīyagabhīrabhāṣiteṣu pratibhā samyag udetu me puro 'taḥ tadanuṣṭhitaśaktir apy atas tadbhavadarcāvyasanaṃ ca nirvirāmam

lines: On dealing-ground even, ever, may this thing-heap dawn for me as Thy limb —
not as self-worthy come.
s12-v24.sanskrit_cite: vyavahārapade 'pi sarvadā pratibhātv arthakalāpa eṣa mām bhavato 'vayavo yathā na tu svata evādaraṇīyatāṃ gataḥ

lines: Mind by own sap roaming where-go —
I in its ranges, strayed even, unswerving still, Thy-tending-skilled may I ever be.
s12-v25.sanskrit_cite: manasi svarasena yatra tatra pracaraty apy aham asya gocareṣu prasṛto 'py avilola eva yuṣmatparicaryācaturaḥ sadā bhaveyam

lines: Lord, by Thy will alone Thy slave am I born —
no other's force here. How then Thy face-orb see I never? Strange, this.
s12-v26.sanskrit_cite: bhagavan bhavadicchayaiva dāsas tava jāto 'smi parasya nātra śaktiḥ katham eṣa tathāpi vaktrabimbaṃ tava paśyāmi na jātu citram etat

lines: The keen toward Thee who behold Thee from counter-stance —
ah! what has drawn near them, what practice fruited?
s12-v27.sanskrit_cite: samutsukās tvāṃ prati ye bhavantaṃ pratyartharūpād avalokayanti teṣām aho kiṃ tadupasthitaṃ syāt kiṃ sādhanaṃ vā phalitaṃ bhavet tat

lines: Things be as things by Thy being, for me.
So be naught elsewise — naught but Thine.
s12-v28.sanskrit_cite: bhāvā bhāvatayā santu bhavadbhāvena me bhava tathā na kiñcid apy astu na kiñcid bhavato 'nyathā

lines: What is naught at all, be naught at all; something at all, be something indeed for me.
In all ways be — thereby Thou everywhere art won-and-worshiped.
s12-v29.sanskrit_cite: yan na kiñcid api tanna kiñcid apy astu kiñcid api kiñcid eva me sarvathā bhavatu tāvatā bhavān sarvato bhavati labdhapūjitaḥ

lines: In brief, Lord —
hear my pain-joy-mark: joy is this, meeting Thee; parted from the Master — pain.
s13-v01.sanskrit_cite: saṃgrahena sukhaduḥkhalakṣaṇaṃ māṃ prati sthitam idaṃ śṛṇu prabho saukhyam eṣa bhavatā samāgamaḥ svāminā viraha eva duḥkhitā

lines: Inside even, exceeding subtle — the Thee-unshowing spell in me:
her too, Ruler, wipe from all sides; Thine own stainless shape show.
s13-v02.sanskrit_cite: antar apy atitarām aṇīyasī yā tvadaprathanakālikāsti me tām apīśa parimṛjya sarvataḥ svaṃ svarūpam amalaṃ prakāśaya

lines: In Thy frame — world-filled, knowing-nectar-sapped, unending —
abiding, ever worshiping the Lord: live, die, else — be mine.
s13-v03.sanskrit_cite: tāvake vapuṣi viśvanirbhare citsudhārasamaye niratyaye tiṣṭhataḥ satatam arcataḥ prabhuṃ jīvitaṃ mṛtam athānyad astu me

lines: 'Lord am I — I shapely indeed, learned, loved —
who else? my like in the world?' — so shines pride, Thy lovers', highly.
s13-v04.sanskrit_cite: īśvaro 'ham aham eva rūpavān paṇḍito 'smi subhago 'smi ko 'paraḥ matsamo 'sti jagatīti śobhate mānitā tvadanurāgiṇaḥ param

lines: God of gods — birth won me from telling Thy non-dual nectar that swallows fame.
So by things-just-as-they-stand-knowing make me foot-worship-fit.
s13-v05.sanskrit_cite: devadeva bhavadadvayāmṛtākhyātisaṃharaṇalabdhajanmanā tad yathāsthitapadārthasaṃvidā māṃ kuruṣva caraṇārcanocitam

lines: Thought on, then seen, then touched — the High Lord Himself.
Where worship's high feast is, be mine ever, by Thy might.
s13-v06.sanskrit_cite: dhyāyate tad anu dṛśyate tataḥ spṛśyate ca parameśvaraḥ svayam yatra pūjanamahotsavaḥ sa me sarvadāstu bhavato 'nubhāvataḥ

lines: Things-as-they-stand-seeing and Thy-worship-high-feast —
this pair, each-other-grounded, in lovers ever unfolds.
s13-v07.sanskrit_cite: yady athāsthitapadārthadarśanaṃ yuṣmadarcanamahotsavaś ca yaḥ yugmam etad itaretarāśrayaṃ bhaktiśāliṣu sadā vijṛmbhate

lines: By each sense-mouth, ever, Thy-worship-sap-elixir-wine —
in all-thing-cups filled, drinking even, may I be mad.
s13-v08.sanskrit_cite: tattadindriyamukhena santataṃ yuṣmadarcanarasāyanāsavam sarvabhāvacaṣakeṣu pūriteṣv āpibann api bhaveyam unmadaḥ

lines: Other-known, grain even, is not; self-shown, all unfolds.
Where, Lord, in Thy city stands — there make me ever Thine honorer.
s13-v09.sanskrit_cite: anyavedyam aṇumātram asti na svaprakāśam akhilaṃ vijṛmbhate yatra nātha bhavataḥ pure sthitaṃ tatra me kuru sadā tavārcituḥ

lines: To slave-quarters posted even, by Thine own will, High Lord —
by beholding am I not vesseled, or by foot-rubbing work even?
s13-v10.sanskrit_cite: dāsadhāmni viniyojito 'py ahaṃ svecchayaiva parameśvara tvayā darśanena na kim asmi pātritaḥ pādasaṃvahanakarmaṇāpi vā

lines: At power's-fall time, weighing — come to it — Thou doest never, Ruler.
Today toward me what has come, that in self-showing-rite Thou lingerest?
s13-v11.sanskrit_cite: śaktipātasamaye vicāraṇaṃ prāptam īśa na karoṣi karhicit adya māṃ prati kim āgataṃ yataḥ svaprakāśanavidhau vilambase

lines: There and there, in things, shining without — within, high-Goddess-yoked —
Thee, three-worlds-filled, ever may I behold, by mine own hands worshiped.
s13-v12.sanskrit_cite: tatra tatra viṣaye bahirvibhāty antare ca parameśvarīyutam tvāṃ jagattritayanirbharaṃ sadā lokayeya nijapāṇipūjitam

lines: The Master's palace — by bare resolve, unbarred, climbed —
ever may I be rest, won in grace's high-nectar-wine-drink-sport.
s13-v13.sanskrit_cite: svāmisaudham abhisandhimātrato nirvibandham adhiruhya sarvadā syāṃ prasāda paramāmṛtāsavāpānakeliparilabdhanirvṛtiḥ

lines: Whatever relish lies in all fair things — by the touch-bare rite —
offering that up, thereby worship Thy frame, O steady-loved.
s13-v14.sanskrit_cite: yatsamastasubhagārthavastuṣu sparśamātravidhinā camatkṛtim tāṃ samarpayati tena te vapuḥ pūjayanty acalabhaktiśālinaḥ

lines: Thou widenest all by Thyself, flashing; the world Thou touchest, touching shape.
What of itself in Thine own sap whirls — that sports, the thing-ring.
s13-v15.sanskrit_cite: sphārayasy akhilam ātmanā sphuran viśvam āmṛśasi rūpam āmṛśan yat svayaṃ nijarasena ghurṇase tat samullasati bhāvamaṇḍalam

lines: Who doubt-free this thing-ring beholds, Ruler — all Thy frame —
in self-side-filled world, for him ever-glad, whence fear?
s13-v16.sanskrit_cite: yo 'vikalpam idam arthamaṇḍalaṃ paśyatīśa nikhilaṃ bhavadvapuḥ svātmapakṣaparipūrite jagaty asya nityasukhinaḥ kuto bhayam

lines: Throat-nook-nestled, Ruler, Thy black-poison even is high-nectar to me.
Taken nectar even — Thy frame in difference-mode — please me it does not.
s13-v17.sanskrit_cite: kaṇṭhakoṇaviniviṣṭam īśa te kālakūṭam api me mahāmṛtam apy upāttam amṛtaṃ bhavadvapur bhedavṛtti yadi rocate na me

lines: Lovely ditties made of Thy prattle —
mouth graced with fitting may I be; ever heart gone to what Thy worship-doing loves.
s13-v18.sanskrit_cite: tvatpralāpamayaraktagītikāni tya yuktavadanopaśobhitaḥ syām athāpi bhavadarcanakriyāpreyasīparigatāśayaḥ sadā

lines: Willed — ah! — of the High Lord, count it none can.
And my given nectar-teeming frame — drink it He sanctions not.
s13-v19.sanskrit_cite: īhitaṃ na bata pārameśvaraṃ śakyate gaṇayituṃ tathā ca me dattam apy amṛtanirbharaṃ vapuḥ svaṃ na pātum anumanyate tathā

lines: Thee — bottomless, doubt-free, two-free, Thine own shape, all-thing-devouring —
entering, I, Umā's Lord, ever worship and high-praise.
s13-v20.sanskrit_cite: tvām agādham avikalpam advayaṃ svaṃ svarūpam akhilārthaghasmaram āviśann aham umeśa sarvadā pūjayeyam abhisaṃstuvīya ca

lines: Before mine own master — victory-fortune's treasure —
may I taste a wink the victory-shout's nectar-sap.
s14-v01.sanskrit_cite: jayalakṣmīnidhānasya nijasya svāminaḥ puraḥ jayodghoṣaṇapīyūṣarasam āsvādaye kṣaṇam

lines: Hail: Rudra the One, Śiva the One, Great God, Great Lord —
Pārvatī's lover, Śarva, first-born of all gods.
s14-v02.sanskrit_cite: jayaikarudraikaśiva mahādeva maheśvara pārvatīpraṇayiñ śarva sarvagīrvāṇapūrvaja

lines: Hail: brow-eyed sole badge of the three-worlds' Lord. Hail: black-poison-throated —
who drank the pain-struck world's pain.
Hail: three-powers-bodied self, hundred-pike-bright-handed.
Hail: lotus-feet worship-worthy — aims ripened by will alone.
Hail: other-world-body-bearer, streaming hundred beauties.
Hail: single-topknotted — unwasting Ganges, rite-ash-seized.
Hail: smeared with milk-sea-spread moonlight shade.
Hail: jewel-darling-snow-decked — risen from the Lord's limb-touch.
Hail: shelter like the one undying cool-rayed digit.
Hail: all-lordship-anointed, ever-damp with Ganges.
Hail: whose low-limb-touch hallows cowherds.
Hail, ever-present where love-drunk gather.
Hail: who dupes the sillies, showing hot places at will.
Hail: fit vessel of Gauri-embrace-fortune.
Hail: greedy for love-gifts wet-and-wet with love-sap.
Hail: gladdened by lovers' word-dance — love-drunk and wild.
Hail: Brahmā-and-first-gods' might —
rise and fall. Hail: whose edict world-lord-rows bear on heads.
Hail: glory shown by self-seal set on all worlds.
Hail: All-Lord, Great Lord — down to self-gift.
Hail: matchless at three-worlds' creation-wish-moment.
Hail: with Goddess alone helping bear lordship's load.
Hail: who strode all three worlds with no step.
Hail, unsatirized Lord-din, sung from childhood.
Hail, inborn-high, past pity and the rest.
Hail, Bhairava before whom dread great Death is wrought.
Hail, unrivalled in world-burn's raging work.
Hail, hundred-weal-praised name-chant.
Hail, nectar-mine-sea spilt in play.
Hail, whose wink-anger parches the world-burn dry.
Hail, sole lamp of delusion-dark-blind breathing-folk.
Hail, wakeful high Person of the sleeping world.
Hail, life's-life warbling in the body-mountain-bower.
Hail, choice lake-bird sporting in true minds' sky.
Hail, mountain-lord born of high gold-vein.
Hail, moon rising blame-meteor-fall-portent over sinners.
Hail, unneared by pain-burnt sages and gods.
Hail, seen by love-mad-folk mounted on every state.
Hail, who leafs his own dependents, spreading Thine own wealth.
Hail, whose one use is petting surrender-folk.
Hail, sole bright deed of making, staying, unmaking.
Hail, high feast of play-lotuses swaying in love's headiness.
Hail, victory's vessel! Hail, birth-age-death-conqueror! Hail, world's eldest!
Hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail hail — Three-eyed!

s17-v21.sanskrit_cite: yāvan na labdhas tvatpūjāsudhāsvādamahotsavaḥ tāvan nāsvādito manye lavo 'pi sukhasampadaḥ

lines: Lovers' — without sense-hunt-shine-strain even:
strain-free-ripe, Thy-seat-standing in worships is born.
s17-v22.sanskrit_cite: bhaktānāṃ viṣayanveṣābhāsāyāsād vinaiva sā ayatnasiddhaṃ tvaddhāmasthitiḥ pūjāsu jāyate

lines: Naught to win is there for lovers, nor aught scarce to them.
Merely roam they — Thy-worship-wine-frenzy-mad.
s17-v23.sanskrit_cite: na prāpyam asti bhaktanāṃ nāpy eṣām asti durlabham kevalaṃ vicaranty ete bhavatpūjāmadonmadāḥ

lines: Ah! love-heavy-open-hearted — Boon-lord —
toward Thee: praised the worship-rule, somehow — by begging unstained.
s17-v24.sanskrit_cite: aho bhaktibharodāracetasāṃ varada tvayi slāghyaḥ pūjāvidhiḥ ko 'pi yo na yācñākalaṃkitaḥ

lines: What beauty is not, what glee not, what thrive not, or else —
what freedom not — since this Great God is worshiped.
s17-v25.sanskrit_cite: kā na śobhā na ko hlādaḥ kā samṛddhir na vāparā ko vā na mokṣaḥ ko 'py eṣa mahādevo yad arcyate

lines: Inward-sporting-clear-clear-love-nectar-fed —
for Thy-worship-use be this frame mine.
s17-v26.sanskrit_cite: antarullasadacchācchabhaktipīyūṣapoṣitam bhavatpūjopayogāya śarīram idam astu me

lines: Thy-foot-worship-wedding-bound ever, All —
may I be, worlds' Ruler, alone, free-stirring.
s17-v27.sanskrit_cite: tvatpādapūjāsambhogaparatantraḥ sadā vibho bhūyāsaṃ jagatām īśa ekaḥ svacchandaceṣṭitaḥ

lines: Thy-thought-seeing-touch-thirst — of some even, Ruler —
is born cool-sweet Thy-worship-high-lake.
s17-v28.sanskrit_cite: tvaddhyānadarśanasparśatṛṣi keṣām api prabho jāyate śītalasvādu bhavatpūjāmahāsaraḥ

lines: As Thou alone art the world's worship-wedding-bowl —
so, Ruler, the lover alone is worship-wedding-bowl.
s17-v29.sanskrit_cite: yathā tvam eva jagataḥ pūjāsambhogabhājanam tatheśa bhaktimān eva pūjāsambhogabhājanam

lines: Somehow wins — Master —
Thy worship-high-feast, where of six-and-thirty principles even churn sports amply.
s17-v30.sanskrit_cite: ko 'py asau jayati svāmin bhavatpūjāmahotsavaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśato 'pi tattvānāṃ kṣobho yatrollasaty alam

lines: Bow to them, All —
whose, by love-nectar-water, hallowed themselves turn Thy worship-gear even.
s17-v31.sanskrit_cite: namas tebhyo vibho yeṣāṃ bhaktipīyūṣavāriṇā pūjyāny eva bhavanti tvatpūjopakaraṇāny api

lines: At worship's start, All — thought on, mantra-laid Thy-selfness —
in self alone, high, lovers shine with glee — nowhither.
s17-v32.sanskrit_cite: pūjārambhe vibho dhyātvā mantrādheyāṃ tvadātmatām svātmany eva pare bhaktā mānti harṣeṇa na kvacit

lines: By kingdom-winning-and-the-rest-blooming ones at Thy worship-high-feast —
with nectar-wine the all-earth is shared out.
s17-v33.sanskrit_cite: rājyalābhādivotphullaiḥ kaiś cit pūjāmahotsave sudhāsavena sakalā jagatī saṃvibhajyate

lines: Worship-nectar-drink-made, whose feasting wink by wink —
are they gods? or freed? or whatever folk indeed?
s17-v34.sanskrit_cite: pūjāmṛtāpānamayo yeṣāṃ bhogaḥ pratikṣaṇam kiṃ devā uta muktās te kiṃ vā ke 'py eva te janāḥ

lines: By world-turned-worship-gear-guise, weight. Ah!
some of lovers — and some indeed lightness.
s17-v35.sanskrit_cite: pūjopakaraṇībhūtaviśvaveśena gauravam aho kim api bhaktānāṃ kim apy eva ca lāghavam

lines: From worship-made-glance-toss-churn alone, nectar-upcoming —
for lovers; as from milk-sea-churn for sky-dwellers.
Worship some deem a wish-cow.
Nectar-stream-over-sapped, suck the inward-faced others.
s17-v37.sanskrit_cite: pūjāṃ ke cana manyante dhenuṃ kāmadughām iva sudhādhārādhikarasāṃ dhayanty antarmukhāḥ pare

lines: Lovers' glance-toss even — this, passing-approved —
fetching some within, fattens the worship-high-feast.
s17-v38.sanskrit_cite: bhaktānām akṣavikṣepo 'py eṣa saṃsārasaṃmataḥ upanīya kim apy antaḥ puṣṇāty arcāmahotsavam

lines: By love-churn's force, Ruler — worship in Thee, self-become. Strange —
for abjectness? Nay — till abjectness's high fruit.
s17-v39.sanskrit_cite: bhaktikṣobhavaśād īśa svātmabhūte 'rcanaṃ tvayi citraṃ dainyāya no yāvad dīnatāyāḥ paraṃ phalam

lines: Courtesy-tread is worship, for some, to win Thy feet.
For lovers, Thine-one-self-bliss-spread is it.
s17-v40.sanskrit_cite: upacārapadaṃ pūjā keṣāṃ cit tvatpadāptaye bhaktānāṃ bhavadaikātmyanirvṛttiprasaras tu saḥ

lines: By unbound-mad-love's-unbarred — worship of unjoined-shape even —
spread out, it wins a stand in Thee, some.
s17-v41.sanskrit_cite: apy asambaddharūpārcābhaktyunmādanirargalaiḥ vitanyamānā labhate pratiṣṭhāṃ tvayi kām api

lines: Mind stilled by tasting sweet-love-sap — fallen. Kind One —
Thou alone, lovely, art worships' bowl, they say.
s17-v42.sanskrit_cite: svādubhaktirasāsvādastabdhībhūtamanaś cyutām śambho tvam eva lalitaḥ pūjānāṃ kila bhājanam

lines: Brimmed, pure, loving, steady —
in Thy worship-rule, Ruler, means be mine.
s17-v43.sanskrit_cite: paripūrṇāni śuddhāni bhaktimanti sthirāṇi ca bhavatpūjāvidhau nātha sādhanāni bhavantu me

lines: In all-worship's true-treasury, in Thy worship-work, Ruler —
ah! sense-throng's some fortune unfolds.
s17-v44.sanskrit_cite: aśeṣapūjāsatkośe tvatpūjākarmaṇi prabho aho karaṇavṛndasya kāpi lakṣmīr vijṛmbhate

lines: This prettiness, Ruler —
Thine alone, they say, is seen: All-Lord even, by slaves art Thou worshiped and won.
s17-v45.sanskrit_cite: eṣā peśalimā nātha tavaiva kila dṛśyate viśveśvaro 'pi bhṛtyair yad arcyase yaś ca labhyase

lines: From ever-formed or formless, from being or even unbeing —
may rise, mine, of the praised, Thy worship-high-feast.
s17-v46.sanskrit_cite: sadāmurttād amūrttādvā bhāvād yad vāpy abhāvataḥ uttheyān me praśastasya bhavatpūjāmahotsavaḥ

lines: With lust, anger, pride made offering ever —
who worship: bow to them. Of them pleased am I, in truth.
s17-v47.sanskrit_cite: kāmakrodhābhimānais tvām upaharīkṛtaiḥ sadā ye 'rcayanti namas tebhyas teṣāṃ tuṣṭo 'smi tattvataḥ

lines: Wins — this, Thy-love-sharers' worship-rule, high —
with straws wrought even, with jewels fitted.
s17-v48.sanskrit_cite: jayaty eṣa bhavadbhaktibhājāṃ pūjāvidhiḥ paraḥ yas tṛṇaiḥ kriyamāno 'pi ratnair evopakalpate

lines: From the world's inside, winning Thee — again, from Thine inside, they win this. World-Lord —
Thine alone, love-sharers: for naught of theirs here is from afar.
s18-v01.sanskrit_cite: jagato 'ntarato bhavantam āptvā punar etad bhavato 'ntarāl labhante jagadīśa tavaiva bhaktibhājo na hi teṣām iha dūrato 'sti kiñcit

lines: Here Thou, there Bhavānī — all-things'-rank-pregnant, first.
But at truth's station, neither Hers nor Thine, nor triple-world's, is split.
s18-v02.sanskrit_cite: kvacid eva bhavān kvacid bhavānī sakalārthakramagarbhiṇī pradhānā paramārthapade tu naiva devyā bhavato nāpi jatattrayasya bhedaḥ

lines: The smug know not the lovely even; though try-favored, all things indeed. But mind —
though risen this even — kens not self-shape here. Ah! then — ah! — I am slain.
s18-v03.sanskrit_cite: no jānate subhagam apy avalepavanto lokāḥ prayatnasubhagā nikhila hi bhāvāḥ cetaḥ punar yad idam udyatam apy avaiti naivātmarūpam iha hā tad aho hato 'smi

lines: Thy feet honored with full wealth, won by dwelling in Thee-made self —
who needs not food nor cloak ever: to him bowed am I.
s18-v04.sanskrit_cite: bhavanmayasvātmanivāsalabdhasampadbharābhyarcitayuṣmadaṅghriḥ na bhojanācchādanam apy ajasram apekṣate yas tam ahaṃ nato 'smi

lines: Ever in Thy-frame-dwelling hale, yet inside supremely burns this world.
By Thy will, so do for me that here, Thy-worship-joy-made, I be.
s18-v05.sanskrit_cite: sadā bhavaddehanivāsasvastho 'py antaḥ paraṃ dahyata eṣa lokaḥ tavecchayā tat kuru me yathātra tvadarcanānandamayo bhaveyam

lines: By own sap risen — Thy-lotus-feet-pair-worship-nectar-drink-glued-mind —
'mid all-aims'-gatherings may I be, touch-joy-alone for world-faring.
In all-dealings'-pasture, plain — within throbs, in Thee, Ruler.
They near and leave ever — my things, shine they ever.
s18-v07.sanskrit_cite: sakalavyavahāragocare sphuṭam antaḥ spurati tvayi prabho upayānty apayānti cāniśam mama vastūni vibhāntu sarvadā

lines: Ever in Thine own city — or cityless, roaming with Thee:
not a wink's crumb even be mine of defeat, forsooth, where Thee-made.
s18-v08.sanskrit_cite: satatam eva tavaiva pure 'thavāpy arahito vicareyam ahaṃ tvayā kṣaṇalavo 'py atha mā sma bhavet sa me na vijaye nanu yatra bhavanmayaḥ

lines: In Thy-limb-oozed well-cool-nectar-floods brimmed, all round even —
in Thy-worship-wealth here, Thy lovers in passing's lake within roam.
s18-v09.sanskrit_cite: bhavadaṅgaparisravatsuśītāmṛtapūrair bharite samantato 'pi bhavadarcanasampadeha bhaktās tava saṃsārasaro 'ntare caranti

lines: In great-chant-tree-shade-cool, in Thy high woods,
in mine own self ever, Ruler, may I dwell, Thy honorer.
s18-v10.sanskrit_cite: mahāmantratarucchāyāśītale tvanmahāvane nijātmani sadā nātha vaseyaṃ tava pūjakaḥ

lines: To each thing of all breathers Thou dawnest, dawn-made —
as. So, my Ruler, forth to show fare, three-eyes-trident-graced.
s18-v11.sanskrit_cite: prativastu samastajīvataḥ pratibhāsi pratibhāmayo yathā mama nātha tathā puraḥ prathāṃ vraja netratrayaśūlaśobhitaḥ

lines: From pride-cake-offering, by mine-love's-weight built —
gladdened, when wilt Thou be my eyes' ground everywhere?

lines: Dwelling in high-nectar-sea's middle, in Thy-honor-rule-alone sunk-mind —
all folk-faring may I ply, savoring, everywhere indeed, aught even.

name-shape-stir-and-the-rest-unequalled of Thine — takes. Taker art Thou, since.

lines: For calm, no joy-hunger a jot — in love-heaped-frenzies. Freedom-wooing's fruit even —
no begging minded, before the heart-thief.

lines: Wake-or-other-state, or high — whatever even, a jot of standing: for love-bowl-folk, all is —
Thou-lorded-mind's — high feast.
s18-v16.sanskrit_cite: jāgaretaradaśāthavā parā yāpi kācana manāg avasthiteḥ bhaktibhājanajanasya sākhilā tvatsanāthamanaso mahotsavaḥ

lines: O mind — eye-ring's turns, everywhere slack-turned even, they —
Thee winning, hard-long-knowing, Ruler — by love-hoard's heat? How?
s18-v17.sanskrit_cite: āmano 'kṣavalayasya vṛttayaḥ sarvataḥ śithilavṛttayo 'pi tāḥ tvām avāpya dṛḍhadīrghasaṃvido nātha bhaktidhanasoṣmaṇāṃ katham

lines: Nor sundered was unmade aught — yet unjoy here was never built.

lines: Thought-stain washed bright by splashed denial-blade-nectar-filling —

Plain, enter me — then may I enter, ever, Ruler — Thine am I, since.
With rush Thy frame itself — outright, high-neared — may I honor.
s18-v20.sanskrit_cite: sphuṭam aviśa mām athāviśeyaṃ satataṃ nātha bhavantamasmi yasmāt rabhasena vapus tavaiva sākṣāt paramāsattigataḥ samarcayeyam

lines: In Thee no praise-might is any one's — or is indeed, since passing-fair art Thou.

s18-v21.sanskrit_cite: tvayi na stutiśaktir asti kasyāpy athavāsty eva yato 'tisundaro 'si satataṃ punar arthitaṃ mamaitad yad aviśrānti vilokayeyam īśam

lines: Prayer-grounds-past, strange-fruit-giving —
wins, unheard-storied Śiva, true-wish-tree.
In all things, from one hoard, through self —
from Thee all, they say, is won. Yet this self of mine joins Thee not, Highest — her, never.
s19-v02.sanskrit_cite: sarvavastuni ca yaikanidhānāt svātmanas tvad akhilaṃ kila labhyam asya me punar asau nijā ātmā na tvam eva ghaṭase paramās tām
notes: tām (her) dangles in SA without a noun; kept dangling

lines: Knowing-doing-made knowing-frame, the self — in all ways High Lord alone may it be.

lines: By matchless pain-thieving fruit, by Thy-glance-natured —
melted, by the road, Lord — be mine Thy-made faring.
s19-v04.sanskrit_cite: viṣamārtimuṣānena phalena tvaddṛgātmanā abhilīya pathā nātha mamāstu tvanmayī gatiḥ

lines: Thy-stainless-feet-thought-jewel-creeper-decked —
when, ripening, perfect-folks'-minds'-wonder-birthing, befall me from Thee?

lines: When, Lord — stainless Thy face-orb —
shall I full-behold, which streams nectar-flood unheard, drowning the world whole?

lines: Thought-barely-glad Thy shape —
when, Lord, with high-nectar-floods fill my far gaps, named Thy-undifference-freedom, ever?

lines: By Thine unexcelled-sap-touch, restlessness dropped —
not yet today my mind, Lord. When be it? Be it soon.
s19-v08.sanskrit_cite: tvadīyānuttararasāsaṅgasaṃtyaktacāpalam nādyāpi me mano nātha karhi syād astu śīghrataḥ

lines: Not dry-bitter alone —
nay, all, ever, to Thee offered, won — clashes even rush me.
s19-v09.sanskrit_cite: mā śuṣkakaṭukāny eva paraṃ sarvāṇi sarvadā tavopahṛtya labdhāni dvandvāny apy āpatantu me

lines: Lord —
face-to-face come Thy stainless rays, till frame-mind-fever-glooms are licked away.
s19-v10.sanskrit_cite: nātha sāṃmukhyam āyāntu viśuddhās tava raśmayaḥ yāvat kāyamanastāpatamobhiḥ parilupyatām

lines: God, clear — till my Thy-road-blockers, truth-thieving, tamed be —
strand-thieves.
s19-v11.sanskrit_cite: deva prasīda yāvan me tvanmārgaparipanthikāḥ paramārthamuṣo vaśyā bhūyāsur guṇataskarāḥ

lines: With Thy love-nectar-piths be my mind brimmed — swift, All —
till these be carted off, flooded: sapless hankerings all.
s19-v12.sanskrit_cite: tvad bhaktisudhāsārair mānasam āpūryatāṃ mamāśu vibho yāvad imā uhyantāṃ niḥśeṣāsāravāsanāḥ plutvā

lines: In freedom's state, whence would love in Thee shine —
for death-lawed even? Nay. So, befitting, raise me to attainment-ground, Unborn.
s19-v13.sanskrit_cite: mokṣadaśāyāṃ bhaktis tvayi kuta iva martyadharmiṇo 'pi na sā rājati tato 'nurūpām āropaya siddhibhūmikām aja mām

lines: Greedy for ripening's speck-winning, me — with smugness settle not, All.
Starved, before Thy love's face, is freedom — beside sprouting wonder-wings.
s19-v14.sanskrit_cite: siddhilavalābhalubdhaṃ mām avalepena mā vibho saṃsthāḥ kṣāmas tvadbhaktimukhe prollasadaṇimādipakṣato mokṣaḥ

lines: On me Thy slave clear, Lord — this much alone forsooth I beg.
Giver, three-worlds' Lord — past such-as-me's sight.
s19-v15.sanskrit_cite: dāsasya me prasīdatu bhagavān etāvad eva nanu yāce dātā tribhuvananātho yasya na tanmādṛśāṃ dṛśo viṣayaḥ

lines: In mind brimmed with Thy-frame-mindfulness-nectar-sap —
Thy lotus-feet-pair in mine, blooming be it ever — honey-oozing, some, past-world.
s19-v16.sanskrit_cite: tvadvapuḥsmṛtisudhārasapūrṇe mānase tava padāmbujayugmam māmake vikasad astu sadaiva prasravanmadhu kim apy atilokam

lines: Mine is the Master, yonder — father, then Three-eyed, then mother Bhavānī.
No second here, whoever, mine is. Thus most-content may I roam.
s19-v17.sanskrit_cite: asti me prabhur asau janako 'tha tryambako 'tha jananī ca bhavānī na dvitīya iha ko 'pi mamāstīty eva nirvṛtatamo vicareyam

lines: Lord — three-worlds' Lord —
ash-pale, three-eyed, trident-wielding, snake-threaded, moon-digit-crested: I bow.

lines: I praise —
self-frame-forgetting, bite-torn-cloth-wrapped-white-garbed, sporting-skull-chaplet-timed-dance-feast-ready.
I bow to them —
whose godhead is Hara, whose stirs are Hara-fit, Hara-alone-bent breaths ever: fortune's houses.
s20-v03.sanskrit_cite: vande tān daivataṃ yeṣāṃ haraś ceṣṭā harocitāḥ haraikapravaṇāḥ prāṇāḥ sadā saubhāgyasadmanām

lines: Played, Thine — of great-lordship, behind. Other, this alone, as this:
'mid wished-barely-wrought bright deeds, by self I near the high means.
s20-v04.sanskrit_cite: krīḍitaṃ tava maheśvaratāyāḥ pṛṣṭhato 'nyad idam eva yathaitat iṣṭamātraghaṭiteṣv avadāneṣv ātmanā param upāyam upaimi

lines: In Thy world-honored seat, this play being —
Thine, Ruler — how great be bliss-sap's birth?
s20-v05.sanskrit_cite: tvaddhāmni viśvavandye 'sminn iyati krīḍane sati tava nātha kiyān bhūyānn ānandarasasambhavaḥ

lines: How be he not favored — who is Gauri's lover, Hara?
Though Hara He be — what then? Gauri's highest lover!
s20-v06.sanskrit_cite: kathaṃ sa subhago mā bhūdyo gauryā vallabho haraḥ haro 'pi mā bhūd atha kiṃ gauryāḥ paramavallabhaḥ

lines: Thought-nectar-made, self-rooted, undying —
knowing-creepers, so-shaped: his, some being-tree's.
s20-v07.sanskrit_cite: dhyānāmṛtamayaṃ yasya svātmamūlam anaśvaram saṃvillatās tathārūpās tasya kasyāpi sattaroḥ

lines: Love-itch at bliss-tide, High Lord —
great-touchstone-rock-pillar: worship itself is born.
s20-v08.sanskrit_cite: bhaktikaṇḍūsam ullāsāvasare parameśvara mahānikaṣapāṣāṇasthūṇā pūjaiva jāyate

lines: Ever to world-birthing-sport, ever to staying-joy-seated, ever to three-worlds'-food-sated Master —
bow.
s20-v09.sanskrit_cite: sadā srṣṭivinodāya sadā sthitisukhāsine sadā tribhuvanāhāratṛptāya svāmine namaḥ

lines: Nowhither gone, naught left —
who, just this, see Thy seat as blest-to-be — the blest: to them bow, bow.

lines: For love-fortune-rich, what else is begged?
